jobs.title: Staff Product Manager  – Digital Assets
jobs.description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
  
  
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
  
  
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
  
  
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.
  
  
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.
  
  
**About The Role**
Nium moves billions in payments every month for some of the world’s most demanding companies — banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms operating across 100+ countries. We built that on fiat rails. The next layer is digital currency: stablecoins, on/off-ramps, and card products that let customers spend, settle, and move value in USDC as naturally as they do in dollars or euros.
  
  
We’re hiring a Staff PM – Digital Assets to own that build. Not the strategy document — the actual product. If you’ve shipped a stablecoin wallet, a crypto-funded card, or a fiat-to-digital conversion flow and you understand what it takes to get that through compliance, engineering, and go-live in a regulated environment, this is your rol
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own stablecoin-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it
* Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line
* Design and ship on/off-ramp flows — fiat-to-digital and digital-to-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience
* Drive stablecoin-based cross-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production-grade
* Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy
* Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required
* You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck
* Strong payments foundation — cross-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it
* Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no-go decisions
* Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against
* Comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign-off

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins + payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
* Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin-funded card products
* On/off-ramp conversion rate and time-to-settlement
* Time-to-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
* Regulatory coverage: number of markets with compliant, live digital asset product

**What We Offer At Nium**
**We Value Performance:**
Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.
  
  
**We Care for Our Employees:**
The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our discretionary year-end shut down (dependant on company OKRs). We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).
  
  
**We Upskill Ourselves:**
We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.
  
  
**We Celebrate Together:**
We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!
  
  
**We Thrive with Diversity:**
Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.
  
  
**Beware of recruitment scams:**
Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites.
**Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**
. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Platforms, Director
Digital Channels Cash Product Lead
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* Own the Cash product agenda across the Digital channels, with strategic accountability for translating Cash and Payments priorities into scalable capabilities across Host-to-Host (H2H), SWIFT and Common Channel Services (CCS).
* Lead the development, prioritisation and commercialisation of channel capabilities and features, ensuring investment is anchored in clear client use cases, measurable commercial value, regulatory needs and end-to-end client outcomes.
* Lead and develop a team of Product Owners to convert strategy into an executable global roadmap and deliver consistent, secure and reusable Cash Digital capabilities across markets, client segments and connectivity models.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy, portfolio and business partnership**

* Own the global Cash channel strategy and roadmap across Web, H2H, SWIFT and CCS, aligning country, regional and global demand to business priorities.
* Act as the senior Channels counterpart to Cash Product heads and represent the portfolio in senior governance, investment and prioritisation forums.
* Partner with global, regional and country Cash Product heads to understand business, client and product priorities in every market.
* Manage senior stakeholders across global product and country management, Channels and Technology, setting expectations on scope, timing and trade-offs. Make transparent trade-offs across growth, client commitments, regulatory or scheme deadlines, resilience, simplification and platform modernisation.

**Product execution and prioritisation**

* Own the global Cash backlog for Channels and rank demand using commercial value, client impact, regulatory urgency, risk, effort and delivery feasibility.
* Lead the working relationship between Cash, country, Channel Product and Technology teams to agree scope, dependencies, release plans and accountable outcomes.
* Run one intake process for all demand, sorting each request, assess client requests tied to mandates /RFPs and implementation deadlines, track regulatory requirements against deadlines.
* Apply a clear prioritisation framework, ringfence capacity across regulatory, client driven scope on revenue and client priority, and sequence delivery. Spot common needs across markets to deliver them as global capabilities.
* Maintain executive oversight of multiple initiatives running in parallel across markets, products and channels, keep a portfolio view of status, risks, milestones and cross-channel dependencies, intervening early where delivery or value is at risk.

**Client insight, proposition and commercialisation**

* Build evidence-based country and client use cases covering target segments, revenue and volumes at stake, adoption barriers, competitive gaps and the cost of not acting.
* Define differentiated value propositions and commercialisation plans for new capabilities, partnering with Sales, Implementation, Onboarding and Client Service to drive launch readiness and adoption.
* Track adoption, transaction volumes, client feedback and realised benefits after launch, using insights to refine the proposition and roadmap.

**Cross-channel capability and solution leadership**

* Translate Cash and Payments needs into end-to-end capabilities spanning digital journeys, entitlements, approvals, connectivity, formats, payment status and reporting.
* Guide solutioning across H2H connectivity (SFTP, AS2 and HTTPS), SWIFT channels (FileAct, FIN and gpi), ISO 20022 messages and legacy or local clearing formats.
* Promote reusable components, standard formats and common services while safeguarding security, resilience, sanctions, fraud, accessibility and regulatory requirements.

**People and talent**

* Lead, coach and develop Product Owners, translating strategy into clear objectives and allocating capacity to the highest-value work.
* Build strategic, commercial, client and channel depth across the team, strengthening prioritisation, stakeholder management, product discipline and succession capacity.
* Role-model the Bank’s valued behaviours, sound risk judgement, constructive feedback, inclusion, wellbeing and accountability.

**Risk, controls and governance**

* Embed product, operational, information security, regulatory and conduct requirements throughout discovery, design, delivery, release and post-launch review.
* Ensure material decisions, exceptions, residual risks and control dependencies are appropriately governed and documented.
* Maintain accurate client-facing specifications, user guidance, release notes, testing support and migration plans for new or changed capabilities.

**Skills And Experience**
**Must-have Skills**

* Cash and Payments Product Strategy
* Digital Channels and Corporate Connectivity
* Product Commercialisation and Value Proposition

**Other Skills**

* Portfolio Prioritisation and Investment Discipline
* Client and Market Insight
* Senior Stakeholder Influence
* People Leadership and Product Team Development

**Motivations**

* Shaping client-channel strategy and turning complex Cash and Payments needs into scalable propositions with visible commercial and client value.
* Leading across business, product and technology boundaries to resolve competing priorities and deliver high-impact outcomes across markets.
* Building empowered Product Owner teams that combine deep channel expertise with strategic thinking, disciplined execution and strong client focus.

**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences**

* 15+ years of senior-level experience in Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Payments or enterprise digital channels, including product strategy, proposition development, commercialisation and execution.
* Deep experience in corporate connectivity and more than one client channel, with working knowledge of H2H, SWIFT, APIs and corporate Web banking.
* Strong Cash and Payments domain understanding across domestic and cross-border payments, real-time and bulk payments, payroll, receivables, liquidity, statements and reporting.
* Working command of ISO 20022 payment and reporting messages, legacy MT formats, local clearing formats, and ERP or treasury management system integration.
* Demonstrated experience building business cases, prioritising investments and managing multiple initiatives across countries, products and channels.
* Strong experience in Portfolio management at scale, running a large backlog with many initiatives in parallel, while sharing limited delivery capacity across countries and demand types.
* Proven leadership of Product Owners or Product Managers and senior-level influence across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Risk and Compliance.

**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory):**
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in business, finance, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. No role-specific certification is mandatory.
  
  
**Languages:**
English: professional fluency. Additional languages are advantageous where relevant to the role’s market coverage.
  
  
**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding

jobs.title: Product Management - Investments Advisory - Vice President
AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Jupiter**

Jupiter is a money app for people who are building their lives in India. From one app you can open a savings account with our partner bank, pay on UPI, save towards goals in Pots, borrow, buy insurance, invest, and see where your money actually goes. Our Edge+ CSB Bank RuPay credit card works on UPI and earns Jewels, our rewards currency, on the brands people already shop with.

We are a product company at heart. We obsess over small details, we read what customers tell us, and we would rather do fewer things properly than many things badly.

**Why this role exists**

AI is already part of how Jupiter works. Our product team uses an in-house assistant that reads our Confluence, Figma, Amplitude, Databricks and support tickets to answer questions and draft PRDs, right inside Slack. Engineering has a bot that turns a Jira ticket into a draft pull request. Marketing has a creative studio that designs ads, critiques its own work against a checklist and tells us what every run cost.

Those started as tools for us. The next step is bigger: putting AI in front of customers in a product that handles their money, where a confident wrong answer is not a small bug. We are looking for a PM who wants to own that problem, with the judgement to know where AI helps and the discipline to prove it before it ships.

**What you will do**

* **Find the problems worth solving with AI.**
  Explaining a declined payment, making sense of a card bill, help that actually closes the ticket, a Money tab that answers questions in plain words. You will also say no to the ideas where a better screen would do the job.
* **Own products end to end.**
  Problem, PRD, evals, launch, and the numbers after launch. You stay with it until it works for customers, not until it is merged.
* **Write the evals before the feature.**
  Define what good looks like with real examples, build the test sets with engineering, and decide the score that is good enough to ship. When the model changes, you know within a day whether things got better or worse.
* **Design for the moments AI gets it wrong.**
  What the assistant says when it does not know, when it hands over to a person, and how a customer corrects it. These moments decide whether people trust us.
* **Keep it safe and compliant.**
  Work with compliance, risk and our partner banks so everything we build respects RBI guidelines, the DPDP Act and our partners' policies. Customer data stays where it belongs.
* **Treat cost and speed as product decisions.**
  Know what each conversation costs, pick the right model for each job, and cut what does not earn its keep.
* **Raise the bar for the whole team.**
  Help other PMs, designers and analysts use AI well in their own work, and keep improving the internal tools they already rely on.

**Your first 90 days**

* **By day 30:**
  you use Jupiter every day, have read a few hundred support conversations, have sat with ops and compliance, and know our internal AI tools by using them.
* **By day 60:**
  you have picked one customer problem, made the case for it with real data, and put a working prototype in front of colleagues.
* **By day 90:**
  you have an eval set, a launch plan with guardrails, and a small rollout to real customers with one clear success metric.

**You will do well here if you**

* Have 4 to 8 years in product, with at least one AI or ML product shipped to real users. A demo does not count; something people used does.
* Can explain in plain words how language models fail (making things up, prompt injection, behaviour shifting between model versions) and how you would design around each.
* Are comfortable writing prompts, reading a model's outputs in bulk and spotting the pattern in what went wrong.
* Use data without being asked. You can write SQL, build a funnel in Amplitude, and tell a real change from noise.
* Write clearly. Your PRDs are short, specific and something an engineer can build from.
* Care about the person on the other side of the screen, especially when the subject is their money.

**Good to have**

* Experience in fintech, payments, lending or another regulated space.
* You have built with the Claude or OpenAI APIs yourself, even on a side project.
* Hands-on time with retrieval (RAG), agents that use tools, or eval tooling.
* You can sketch a flow in Figma before a designer picks it up.

**What you will work with**

* Claude and other frontier models through our AI gateway, and MCP to connect agents to our systems.
* Amplitude, Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Figma and Sense UI, our design system.
* A React Native app, and engineers, designers and analysts who like to move quickly and measure what they ship.

**How we work**

* Small teams own outcomes, not tickets.
* Decisions are written down with the reasoning, so anyone can pick up the thread later.
* We are honest about results. If a launch did not work, we say so and fix it.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Aspora**
People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.
  
  
Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.
  
  
We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.
  
  
**About The Role**
People build lives across borders, and Aspora helps the Indian diaspora send money home and grow wealth in India. Growth here is won in a user’s first three months: a friend’s referral, a first transfer, a return next month. This role exists to turn that journey into a growth engine that compounds with every new cohort. You will own growth for our product, working closely with design, engineering, data and our CLM team.
  
  
You decide which bets to make, how big they should be, and when to stop one that isn’t working. What you build will shape how fast Aspora grows, and the growth playbook we take into every new market
  
  
Location
  
  
In Office || Bangalore
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* This is a role with full ownership of the journey at the heart of Aspora’s core business.
* Diagnose where growth leaks. Go deep into funnels on every launch and older bet, and publish insights the whole team acts on.
* Own the number and the path. Check the numbers daily, hold a clear view on opportunity areas, and open new growth threads.
* Grow referral and activation. Ship reward constructs and product bets that bring more users in and get them to a first transfer.
* Make new users stay. Lift retention in the first three months by turning a first transfer into a monthly habit.
* Size every bet to matter. Set the payback before launch, read the result honestly, and call it early when a bet isn’t working.
* Build trust after every transfer. Shape the post-transfer experience so customers feel informed and in control, even when timing slips.

What We’re Looking For
  
  
You’re not someone who measures a quarter by features shipped. You measure it by the number you moved, and you can show exactly how.
  
  

* You’ve moved a growth number. You owned an acquisition, activation or retention metric in a consumer app and can walk through what moved it.
* You live in the data. You write your own SQL or analytics queries and read an experiment properly: control groups, sample checks, significance.
* You’ve run rewards with a payback. You designed referral, cashback or incentive programmes with the unit economics worked out before launch.
* You ship experiments end to end. Hypothesis, launch, readout and the next iteration, more than once, on dates you agreed and kept.
* You go to the source. You’ve turned user calls, session replays or research into a product decision that changed what shipped.
* You know consumer products. You’ve built product or growth at a consumer app, and Indian consumer fintech experience is a strong plus.
* You own the goal, not the task. You hold the number, the path to it and the next thread to pull, without waiting to be asked.
* Most importantly, you want a number that is clearly yours, in a business where every cohort you keep compounds.

Why Aspora?
  
  

* Own growth end to end, the core of Aspora’s business, with a number that is clearly yours.
* Set the growth playbook Aspora carries into new markets and the products we build on top of remittance.
* Full ownership from day one, not a slice of someone else’s roadmap.
* Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and ESOPs aligned with Aspora’s long-term vision.

jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Specialist Product Manager
  
  
Senior Product Manager, Business Experimentation & Optimization
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing cutting-edge products and services that help our customers. Focused on thinking big and scaling quickly around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse global customer base including issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation (Test & Learn), and data-driven information and risk management services.
  
  
As a member of the Business Experimentation Product Management team, you will build industry-leading experimentation software which brings sophisticated analytic techniques to businesses and users around the world. We are rapidly building new products, evolving products in the age of AI, and expanding the ways we deliver Test & Learn to our clients. We are looking for AI native PMs who can execute and evolve our product strategy and help us build the AI enhanced version of Test & Learn.
  
  
Role
  
  
Product Manager for Mastercard’s Test & Learn product, an analytic platform used by the world's largest organizations to make multi-million-dollar decisions.
  
  
Develop product strategy derived from user research, market trends, customer pain points, and commercial priorities.
  
  
Translate a deep understanding of our users into an actionable roadmap. Leverage user research, market research, sales/marketing expertise, and usage data to inform priorities.
  
  
Own end-to-end feature development. Identify and prioritize problems, define use cases, design solutions, write requirements, support development and testing, and measure impact to inform future decisions.
  
  
Work as a part of a cross-functional product team to bring ideas to life. Work together with UX designers, engineers, and other product managers to improve our products.
  
  
Unlock the power of AI. Define how and where AI technology enhances the measurement and optimization of business initiatives.
  
  
**All About You**
Can work closely with cross-functional partners like engineers, designers, sales, marketing, and users.
  
  
A quick learner with the ability to multi-task in a team environment, not afraid to ask questions and make decisions. Enthusiastic, effective team member and mentor.
  
  
Broad strategic thinking skills, adept in translating product vision/strategy into an actionable roadmap.
  
  
Creative problem-solver, can balance competing needs and prioritize thoughtfully.
  
  
Strong professional presence. Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
  
  
Experience building with AI or using AI to enhance an existing software application
  
  
5+ years of professional experience in a similar role, or equivalent.
  
  
Corporate Security Responsibility
  
  
Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security. All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And Therefore, It Is Expected That The Successful Candidate For This Position Must:
  
  
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  
  
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  
  
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  
  
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.description:
**What You'll Do**

* Own the vision and the roadmap :
* Turn the company vision into a product strategy and a roadmap the whole company can plan against.
* Help us prioritize opportunities as we expand the product, go up-market, and explore new possibilities.
* Own product metrics end to end : turnaround time, accuracy, coverage, adoption and revenue per product line.
* Develop and execute the product strategy and roadmap to move the needle on ARR, Retention, and ACV, in collaboration with the GTM teams.
* Stay close to customers and regulators :

**Job Description:**

The Chase Consumer & Community Bank Operations organizations provide support for businesses serving more than 61 million consumers and 4 million small businesses across Consumer, Business, and Mortgage Banking, Card Services, Auto Finance, and U.S. wealth management. You will deliver recurring management reporting and prepare monthly senior management materials that clearly articulate financial performance and strategy. You will also drive reporting and process efficiency improvements while ensuring data integrity, accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to internal compliance policies and business reporting requirements.

jobs.title: Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
WE'RE HIRING! | Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager.

We are hiring a banking professional who can open, run and protect To The Moon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking relationships: INR pay-in, payout, virtual accounts, CMS and API banking for a crypto trading platform.

* **Department:** Strategic Partnerships (Banking & Payments)
* **Reports To:** Founder & CEO
* **Location:** Lucknow
* **Travel:** Regular travel to Mumbai, Delhi NCR & Bengaluru for bank meetings
* **Experience:** 5+ years in Banking or Fintech
* **Required Expertise:** Digital Banking, API Banking, CMS & Virtual Accounts
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Seniority:** Senior Executive to Manager, based on experience

**About ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd**

ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd is an FIU-IND registered Indian cryptocurrency exchange, headquartered in Jaipur and operating since 2021. We run spot and futures trading plus OTC on-ramp and off-ramp services for Indian users. INR flows, deposits, withdrawals and settlements, sit at the center of our business, and they depend on strong, compliant banking partners.

**Role purpose**

You will own ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking ecosystem end to end. That means finding and onboarding banks, getting API banking, virtual accounts and CMS live, and keeping every relationship healthy. You will also build backup banking so no single bank or payment rail can stop INR deposits or withdrawals.

**Key responsibilities**

1.Bank partnerships and onboarding

a. Find, pitch and onboard private, small finance, cooperative and new-age banks for current accounts, escrow/nodal accounts, pay-in and payout.

b. Present ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's business model, FIU-IND registration, AML/KYC framework and risk controls to bank product, risk and compliance teams.

c. Lead the bank's due diligence: documents, questionnaires, site visits and onboarding

paperwork.

2. API banking, virtual accounts and CMS

a. Set up and expand virtual account (VAN) structures for user-wise INR deposit collection

and auto-reconciliation.

b. Get API banking live for IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and UPI payouts, plus balance, statement and

status APIs.

c. Set up CMS for collections and bulk payouts, and drive integration with our tech team

through UAT and go-live.

d. Work with UPI collect, payment aggregator and PSP partners as extra deposit rails.

3. Relationship management

a. Act as the single point of contact for every banking partner, from relationship managers

up to senior leadership.

b. Handle account freezes, lien marks, LEA and cyber-cell requests, chargebacks and

transaction holds with the bank and our compliance team.

c. Run regular reviews of volumes, TAT, success rates and issues with each bank.

4. Negotiation and commercials

a. Negotiate pricing, transaction limits, float terms, MDR, payout charges and SLAs.

b. Review and close banking agreements, API terms and SLAs with our legal team.

5. Business continuity

a. Always keep at least two live banking partners for pay-in and payout, with tested

failover.

b. Spot risk early, regulatory changes, a bank's appetite for VDA business and line up

alternatives before they are needed.

6. Compliance and internal coordination

a. Work with compliance, finance, operations and tech so bank requirements under PMLA,

FIU-IND and RBI guidelines are met.

b. Keep partner dashboards, MIS and documentation current for management.

**Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years in banking or fintech, with hands-on work in digital banking, API banking, CMS and

virtual accounts.

* Has managed these products for a corporate client, a fintech platform, a stockbroker, a payment

aggregator or a crypto exchange from the bank side or the client side.

* Has taken at least 2–3 bank integrations (VAN, payout API or CMS) from first meeting to go-live.

* An active network of decision-makers in transaction banking, CMS, digital/API banking and

fintech partnership teams at Indian banks.

* Clear understanding of INR payment rails: IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, UPI, NACH, and escrow/nodal

account structures.

* Working knowledge of KYC/AML, PMLA, FIU-IND and RBI rules relevant to banks serving fintechs

and VDA businesses.

* Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

* Graduate in any field; MBA in Finance, Banking or Business preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Banking Products:** Knowledge of current, escrow and nodal accounts; virtual accounts; CMS collections and payouts; API banking; UPI collect and payout.
* **Technical Fluency:** Ability to read API documentation and understand webhooks, callbacks, reconciliation files and UAT; comfortable coordinating with developers and bank technology teams.
* **Negotiation:** Ability to negotiate pricing, transaction limits, SLAs and agreements while maintaining strong banking relationships.
* **Communication:** Strong presentation and email-writing skills; confident in meetings with bank CXOs, risk and compliance heads.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Ability to align compliance, finance, technology and operations teams around bank integration timelines.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to resolve account freezes, failed payouts, settlement delays and reconciliation gaps quickly.
* **Ownership:** Self-driven, works independently and takes complete responsibility for follow-through until go-live.
* **Integrity:** Handles confidential banking and customer data with utmost discretion.

**Good to have**

•Earlier work in a bank's transaction banking, CMS, digital banking or fintech alliances team.

•Experience at an Indian crypto exchange, stockbroker, payment gateway, PSP or NBFC.

•Has onboarded a VDA or high-risk business with a bank and understands the bank's concerns.

•Exposure to payment aggregator rules, cross-border payments or stablecoin on/off-ramp flows.

•Familiarity with reconciliation tools, MIS reporting and Excel-based analysis.

Pay: ₹444,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Date live: 11/17/2026

Business Area: USCB Operations

Area of Expertise: Banking Operations

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000134989

  

Step into the role of Operations Analyst at Barclays where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. Join us in our mission to safeguard our business and our customers from financial crime risks.

  
  

* Have the ability to work in a “permanent night shift”, work in office 5 days a week through training and period to full production which is four to six months. (Note: The USCB Bank Operation works in the window from 4 PM IST to 5 AM IST next day across 7 days a week)
* Need to have understanding of US credit card product knowledge across US Consumer Banking.
* Review and process customer requests by conducting in-depth due diligence, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and safeguarding our clients and organization with expertise and care.
* Analyze documents received via mail, fax, and digital uploads and ensure correct action and routing.
* Identify the nature and purpose of documents and initiate appropriate actions, including case creation where required.
* Locate and validate customer accounts using enterprise systems including Salesforce, TSYS, MetaStor, and ActiveStore.
* Verify customer identity using parameters such as name, address, account number, and additional security details.
* Open, update, and close cases accurately in Salesforce with detailed audit‑ready notes.
* Ensure all cases are processed within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) across multiple partner queues.
* Identify risk indicators such as account status issues or fraud flags and route cases to relevant teams as required.
* Compliance with internal policies and audit standards
  

  
  

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

  
  

This role is based out of Noida**.**

**Purpose of the role**

To support business areas with day-to-day processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution.

**Accountabilities**

* Support various business areas with day-to-day initiatives including processing, reviewing, reporting, trading, and issue resolution.
* Collaboration with teams across the bank to align and integrate operational processes.
* Identification of areas for improvement and providing recommendations in operational processes.
* Development and implementation of operational procedures and controls to mitigate risks and maintain operational efficiency.
* Development of reports and presentations on operational performance and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments to implement best practice in banking operations.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To meet the needs of stakeholders/ customers through operational excellence and customer service
* Perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard
* No people leadership roles at this grade.
* Execute work requirements as identified in processes and procedures, collaborating with and impacting on the work of team members.
* Identify escalation of policy breaches as required.
* Take responsibility for customer service and operational execution tasks.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Gain and maintain an understanding of own role, how the team integrates to achieve overall objectives, alongside knowledge of the work of other teams within the function.
* Work within well-defined procedures that may involve a variety of work routines.
* Demonstrate an understanding of the procedures.
* Evaluate and select the appropriate alternatives from defined options.
* Make judgements based on the analysis of factual information.
* Build relationships with stakeholders and customers to identify and address their needs, in support of a smooth operating process, handling sensitive issues as required.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.title: Manager Digital Product Management
jobs.description:
Global Servicing (GS) oversees consumer travel and concierge experiences, all customer service functions supporting the company's global consumer, banking, merchant, and commercial customers, as well as the critical enablement capabilities that power our products and services. GS is committed to delivering the world's best customer experience every day by building on American Express's legacy of service excellence, leveraging innovative technologies to drive transformation, and bringing a human touch to every customer interaction.

We are seeking an innovative and forward-thinking **Digital Product Manager, Global Servicing Automation** to help transform how we work through automation, emerging technologies, and intelligent process design.

This role will serve as a Product Owner for Global Servicing Automation, supporting the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and delivery of capabilities that simplify operations, reduce manual effort, improve quality, and enhance customer and colleague experiences.

The successful candidate will bring a passion for innovation, strong product ownership skills, and a continuous improvement mindset. As an automation ambassador, they will develop expertise in enterprise automation platforms, including the Automation and Case Management Ecosystem (ACE), while exploring emerging AI and non-AI capabilities to identify scalable, reusable solutions.

This is an opportunity for a curious, independent thinker who challenges the status quo, thrives in ambiguity, and enjoys turning innovative ideas into meaningful business outcomes.

  

* 3+ years of relevant experience in digital product management, product ownership, automation, process improvement, customer servicing, technology, or related disciplines.
* Experience translating business requirements into product features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs.
* Working knowledge of Agile product development methodologies and experience partnering with business and technology teams to deliver solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and independently drive results.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and overcome barriers in a matrixed organization.
* Strong communication, organizational, and presentation skills with a high degree of initiative, ownership, and accountability.
* Passion for innovation, emerging technologies, automation, and challenging the status quo to improve how work gets done.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience serving as a Product Owner or Digital Product Manager supporting an enterprise technology platform.
* Experience implementing automation solutions, including workflow automation, case management, robotic process automation, or AI-enabled capabilities.
* Knowledge of customer servicing processes and experience in a large-scale contact center environment.
* Experience redesigning processes to improve efficiency, quality, and customer experience.
* Experience working in financial services or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience developing business cases, managing complex initiatives, or supporting Agile product delivery.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, or a related field; equivalent professional experience considered.  

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will be a trusted Product Owner and automation ambassador who brings innovative ideas to life, makes timely decisions, and works effectively across teams to deliver meaningful results.

They will help Global Servicing move beyond automating existing tasks to **reimagining how work gets done** —creating simpler, smarter, and more scalable processes that empower colleagues and elevate the customer experience.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

  

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Business Analytics Analyst
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Cards & Wealth Analytics & AI Enablement Specialist (C11)**
-------------------------------------------------------------

**Who We Are**
--------------

Within Citi’s **Analytics & Information Management (AIM)** group, you will do meaningful work from Day 1. Our collaborative, inclusive, and forward-looking culture empowers professionals to grow and make a tangible impact across one of the world’s leading financial institutions.

The **AIM Cards & Wealth** organization acts as the strategic intelligence engine across our credit card portfolios and wealth management franchises. We power customer acquisition, card spend stimulation, portfolio deepening, and wealth advisory insights. We actively integrate **modern data architectures, customer analytics, and Generative AI productivity frameworks** into our day-to-day operations to deliver hyper-relevant business insights, actionable customer intelligence, and optimized strategies for our cardholders and affluent wealth clients.

**What the Role Is**
--------------------

We are hiring a **Cards & Wealth Analytics & AI Enablement Specialist (C11)** to join our **Cards & Wealth Analytics, Insights & Optimization** team.

In this role, you will be the analytical owner and insight lead across Credit Card products (Acquisition, Spend Stimulation, Revolving, Balance Transfer, Loyalty/Rewards) and Wealth Management offerings (Investment Products, Wealth Advisory, Mortgages, FX, Time Deposits, and Digital Banking). You will combine **core data extraction, customer analytics, experimentation, and portfolio optimization** with **applied AI enablement**—leveraging modern GenAI tools, prompt and context engineering, knowledge base setup, retrieval optimization, Text-to-SQL assistants, and NLP to uncover high-impact growth opportunities, evaluate business performance, and accelerate analytical workflows.

As a C11-level specialist, you will bridge the gap between business stakeholders and data platforms, maintaining rigorous data governance while championing AI-assisted productivity and analytical optimization within the team.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **AI-Augmented Data Practitioner:** You actively leverage modern GenAI tools, conversational assistants, context engineering, and prompt design to supercharge analytics, code generation, and business insights.
* **Cards & Wealth Analytical Problem Solver:** You excel at translating complex business questions into high-performance queries using **SQL, PySpark, and Python**, analyzing spend patterns, portfolio balances, and customer lifecycle journeys to maximize business ROI.
* **Experimentation & Optimization Champion:** You apply structured analytical techniques—such as customer funnel diagnostics, test-versus-control lift analysis, and cohort evaluation—to uncover performance drivers across card products and wealth tiers.
* **Workflow Innovator:** You proactively automate repetitive processes—using AI for Text-to-SQL generation, automated insight summarization, knowledge base curation, and communication variant ideation.
* **Disciplined & Version-Controlled:** You manage analytical assets, queries, and automation scripts using **Git / GitHub** for robust code collaboration and version control.
* **Process & Controls Oriented:** You uphold strict data quality standards, customer privacy regulations, and risk/compliance controls across all analytical deliverables.

**What You Do (Core Responsibilities)**
---------------------------------------

**1. Data Extraction & Analytical Pipeline Management**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Partner with Cards and Wealth Product Managers, Marketing, and Segment teams to translate business priorities and strategy objectives into robust technical logic.
* Develop, test, and execute data extraction queries and analytical pipelines using **SQL, PySpark, and Python** to generate high-quality analytical datasets and customer segment pools across big data environments.

**2. Cards & Wealth Analytics, Experimentation & Optimization**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* **Portfolio & Customer Funnel Analytics:** Analyze customer lifecycle funnels (Acquisition ➔ Activation ➔ Spend/Investment Engagement ➔ Balance/NNA Deepening ➔ Retention) across Card and Wealth portfolios to diagnose drop-offs and identify revenue-generating opportunities.
* **Experimentation & Lift Measurement:** Design and execute test-versus-control experimental frameworks and A/B test splits to isolate incremental product conversion, spend lift, revolving behavior, and Net New Assets (NNA).
* **Spend, Balance & Channel Optimization:** Analyze transactional patterns, merchant categories, revolving balances, and channel touchpoints (Mobile App, Online Banking, Direct, RM outreach) to recommend strategy refinements and targeting optimization.
* **Interactive Visualizations:** Build and maintain interactive performance tracking dashboards and diagnostic tools in **Tableau / Power BI** with automated underlying data aggregation feeds.

**3. GenAI Enablement, Context Engineering & Workflow Automation**
------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Context Engineering & Knowledge Base Setup:** Organize, structure, and curate internal analytics rules, data dictionaries, card/wealth product taxonomies, and strategy playbooks into searchable knowledge bases to enable high-accuracy AI retrieval and team knowledge sharing.
* **Retrieval Optimization:** Optimize data retrieval contexts and prompt structures to ensure conversational AI and retrieval-augmented tools deliver precise, hallucination-free analytical outputs and code.
* **Text-to-SQL & Natural Language Processing (NLP):** Apply Text-to-SQL interfaces and NLP techniques to accelerate ad-hoc data exploration, query generation, and unstructured client feedback/interaction analysis.
* **AI-Assisted Code Acceleration:** Utilize GenAI coding tools to rapidly draft, optimize, and debug complex SQL queries, PySpark data transformations, and Python scripts.
* **Automated Insights Summarization:** Leverage GenAI pipelines to generate executive narrative summaries, performance commentary, and anomaly explanations from card and wealth portfolio data.
* **Content & Message Variant Ideation:** Assist business partners by using Generative AI to generate personalized messaging copy variations, email subject lines, and client engagement talking points tailored to specific cards and wealth tiers.

**4. Code Collaboration, QA & Data Governance**
-----------------------------------------------

* Manage and version-control all analytical scripts, SQL queries, and configuration files using **Git / GitHub**.
* Perform thorough Quality Assurance (QA) validations—such as row count reconciliations, schema validations, null checks, and deduplication—before delivering datasets and insights to stakeholders.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of data definitions, analytical assumptions, and data lineage.

**Key Deliverables**
--------------------

* **Analytical Datasets & Customer Segments:** Validated, high-precision datasets and customer target pools structured for business strategy and product analysis.
* **Cards & Wealth Optimization Decks:** Analytical insight decks isolating incremental lift, spend trends, revolving behavior, Net New Assets (NNA), and channel efficiency.
* **Interactive Analytics Dashboards:** Automated Tableau / Power BI dashboards for product funnel monitoring, portfolio KPIs, and stakeholder self-service.

jobs.title: Client Consulting Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The core client segments of VCA include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Role Summary:

The Analyst for Digital, Strategy and AI supports the delivery of digital transformation, strategy and artificial intelligence (AI) engagements across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

  

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

* Defining business, segment, channel and functional strategies, such as digital banking, affluent banking, loyalty, open finance, stablecoins and artificial intelligence.

Ideation:

* Supporting the innovation agenda of clients through foresight, strategic trends research and co-creation activities.

Value proposition design:

* Developing holistic offerings, including products, services and customer experience, for strategic consumer, business and corporate customer segments.

Customer experience and engagement:

* Developing best-in-class digital customer journeys and engagement strategies, including digital onboarding, end-to-end digital journey transformation, digital channel benchmarking and user interface and user experience enhancement.

Performance analytics:

* Improving client performance and process efficiency by deploying data, digital and AI tools.

Digital delivery:

* Supporting clients with the implementation of digital strategies, including the design and development of digital channels, generative AI (GenAI) use cases and proofs of concept.

Key Responsibilities:

* As an Analyst, you will work within project teams under the guidance of senior consultants and managers, contributing to research, analysis and the development of client deliverables.
* Support the delivery of digital, strategy and AI projects across the GCC, from scoping through to final recommendations.
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research, including benchmarking and trends analysis, to inform client recommendations.
* Gather, clean and analyze data from Visa and industry sources to generate insights that support client recommendations.
* Contribute to the problem-solving process, including structuring analytical frameworks and developing insight-driven recommendations.
* Build business cases and financial models that measure business performance and quantify return on investment (ROI).
* Prepare clear and compelling client presentations and reports that communicate findings and recommendations.
* Support the preparation and running of client workshops and stakeholder sessions, and document findings, decisions and next steps.
* Track project workplans and deliverables, and keep the project leadership informed of progress, risks and issues.
* Collaborate with Visa Account Executives and the Product, Value-Added Services (VAS), Marketing and other internal teams to deliver integrated solutions as One Visa.
* Contribute to proposals and responses to requests for proposal (RFPs), as well as practice thought leadership, points of view and case studies.
* Help build reusable toolkits, templates and best practice documents that can be applied across the VCA practice.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* At least 2 years of work experience in management consulting, preferably on financial services, payments, digital or AI projects.
* Degree from a leading university, preferably in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including building clear and compelling presentations, financial models and data analyses.
* Strong curiosity about AI, including GenAI and agentic AI, with hands-on experience using AI tools for research, analysis or content creation and an understanding of how to use them responsibly.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience working on projects in the GCC region.
* Exposure to digital transformation, strategy or digital banking projects.
* Knowledge of banking products, services, operations; payment schemes, services, card issuing and marketing initiatives.
* Strong interest in fintech and payments.
* Proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

What You Will Need to Be Successful:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex problems and work with large data sets.
* Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear and compelling presentations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the financial indicators used to measure business performance.
* A collaborative, diplomatic and flexible working style, with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to deliverables quality.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines at the same time.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn, take on feedback and develop new skills quickly.
* Ability to build strong working relationships with clients and colleagues.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**About Us**
------------

Our team consists of 25,000 colleagues, spread across 35 countries. We believe in transformation – embracing agile and new ways of working together, which helps us to truly ‘think client’ and serve millions of our affluent and emerging affluent clients, across the world. Our clients include individuals and small businesses, and we support them with a range of traditional banking services, including investment, credit and wealth planning solutions.

We offer career opportunities for relationship managers, customer service specialists, product and segment management, sales and wealth planning.

  

**If you’re looking to unlock new job growth opportunities, Standard Chartered Bank is the place for you. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.**

  

**About Wealth and Retail Banking**

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 11 million clients in many of the world’s fastest-growing markets. Our client continuum spans from Mass Retail to Affluent, including high-net worth clients served by our Private Bank. We leverage digital banking channels with a human touch to provide clients with differentiated products and services such as deposits, payments, financing, wealth management and personalised advice. We also support small business clients with their business banking needs.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Conduct market research to understand customer needs, market trends, and competitive landscape with respect to Products and Solutions (Structured Products and other CMPS Products as may be assigned)
  
• Analyse data to identify opportunities and threats.
  
• Develop a clear product vision that aligns with the bank's overall strategy and goals.
  
• Create and maintain a product roadmap that outlines the key features, timelines, and milestones.
  
• Communicate product strategy, progress, and changes effectively to all stakeholders.

**Business**  
• Revenue management
  
• Drive new business and strategic initiatives across different business segments within Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB)
  
• Drive product and platform innovation.
  
• Portfolio management

**Processes**  
• Business owner in all related product platform
  
• Drive platform usage, client penetration efforts.
  
• Accountable for delivery of all product enhancements, project deliveries in terms of championing as business lead
  
• Manage operations, IT and middle office resources indirectly in terms of driving changes, delivery and strategy.

**Risk Management**  
• Responsible for overseeing end to end product process through the product life cycle, including all risk management initiatives.

**Governance**  
• Owns and responsible for Country Product Programme/Addendum and ensure alignment to the Group Product Programme
  
• Ensure compliance to internal and external governance standards and regulatory requirements.
  
• Participate in audits, manage regulatory incidents and communications on product and drive the process, product and system changes to minimise regulatory breaches.

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation** , one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* **In line with our Fair Pay Charter** , we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance** , with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* **Time-off** including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

jobs.title: Implementation Director
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa is transforming the future of banking and payments through Pismo, Visa's cloud-native core banking and issuer processing platform. Built to help financial institutions modernize legacy infrastructure, launch innovative products faster, and scale securely in real time, Pismo is enabling the next generation of digital banking experiences across the globe.

As an Implementation Director, you will lead the successful delivery of some of Visa and Pismo's most strategic client transformation programs. Working with leading banks, fintechs, and financial institutions, you will be responsible for orchestrating large-scale platform implementations that redefine how clients issue cards, process transactions, manage accounts, and deliver modern payment experiences to their customers.

This is a highly visible leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, payments, and transformation. You will act as the executive sponsor for complex implementation programs, partnering with senior client stakeholders and cross-functional Visa and Pismo teams to drive delivery excellence, mitigate risk, and accelerate value realization.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, executive stakeholder management, and deep program leadership capabilities to guide clients through critical modernization journeys, helping them move from legacy platforms to cloud-native infrastructure that supports future growth and innovation.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

* Lead end-to-end implementation and transformation programs for strategic Pismo clients, from contract signature and mobilization through go-live and post-launch stabilization.
* Serve as the primary executive point of contact for client leadership teams, building trusted relationships with C-suite, business, operations, technology, and transformation stakeholders.
* Drive governance, delivery strategy, program execution, dependency management, and risk mitigation across complex multi-workstream initiatives.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Client Success, Information Security, Risk, and Commercial teams to ensure successful delivery against client commitments.
* Establish executive steering committees and governance forums, providing clear visibility into program progress, milestones, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.
* Navigate complex organizational environments to align stakeholders, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain momentum across large-scale transformation programs.
* Champion implementation excellence while ensuring clients achieve measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, and accelerated time-to-value.
* Support clients through change management, platform adoption, and operational readiness as they transition onto Pismo's cloud-native infrastructure.
* Capture lessons learned and implementation best practices to continuously strengthen Visa and Pismo's delivery frameworks.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD

  

* Over 15 years of experience in technology-driven financial services, with a strong focus on leading large-scale implementation and transformation projects for global fintech's and banks.
* Detailed technical knowledge of payments ecosystem in GCC countries, more specifically implementation and certification of Jaywan and AEP Switch in UAE
* Technical knowledge of payments and banking platforms operating in the cloud in a microservice architecture, with REST/JSON API’s and data streaming.
* Educational background in solutions architecture and software engineering. Cloud certifications are a plus.
* Having completed a core banking, payments transformation implementation from contract signature to production live.
* Expertise in building and scaling high-performing teams, with a hands-on leadership style that emphasizes mentorship, empowerment, and a culture of accountability.
* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-market projects on time and within scope, leveraging advanced project management methodologies (Agile, Lean, and hybrid models) and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
* Recognized for forging strong, trust-based relationships with C-level executives, clients, and cross-functional partners, ensuring alignment and transparency throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Adept at translating business strategy into actionable plans, optimizing processes, and driving continuous improvement through data-driven decision-making and KPI management.
* Russian speaker is highly desirable

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
