jobs.title: Senior Analyst, MENA Treasury
jobs.description:
***Company Description***

*We’re**Checkout.com**. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*

*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.*  
  
*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*  
  
*If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*  
  
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*

**The role**
------------

We are looking for an analytical and organised Senior Analyst to help deliver the MENA Treasury team’s safeguarding and operational responsibilities. Working closely with the Senior Associate, you will take ownership of defined daily processes, including safeguarding calculations and reconciliations, payment and funding activity, exception investigation, and management information. You will use your judgement to resolve routine issues, identify emerging risks, and escalate material or complex matters promptly.

This is a hands-on role in a regulated payments environment, with scope to improve the quality and resilience of Treasury processes. You will apply a strong control mindset and sound technical skills across safeguarding, cash management, liquidity, and Treasury operations, while helping translate policies into consistent day-to-day execution.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Own the preparation and review of daily safeguarding calculations and reconciliations for assigned MENA merchant funds, ensuring they follow regulations, approved policies, account structures, and controls.
* Analyse balances and supporting data, investigate breaks and aged reconciling items, coordinate resolution with relevant teams, and escalate potential shortfalls, control failures, or unusual activity promptly to the Senior Associate.
* Instruct and monitor approved safeguarding, funding, settlement, and intercompany transfers within delegated authority; perform appropriate checks and maintain clear evidence in line with control requirements.
* Monitor bank accounts, payment flows, and funding positions; analyse variances and follow through on operational queries with internal teams and banking partners.
* Produce and maintain accurate daily Treasury records, reconciliations, trackers, and management information; investigate data-quality issues and highlight meaningful trends or exceptions.
* Prepare recurring reporting and analysis for Treasury management and governance forums, ensuring information is accurate, timely, and clearly explained.
* Maintain procedures, process maps, control evidence, and supporting documentation for assigned processes; identify control gaps and recommend practical process improvements or automation.
* Coordinate evidence and responses for internal and external audits, regulatory reviews, and information requests; track actions to closure and escalate matters requiring interpretation or management input.
* Analyse payment flows and assess potential safeguarding and operational impacts of product, market, or regulatory changes; document findings and recommendations for review.
* Build effective working relationships with Treasury colleagues and partner teams across Finance, Operations, Product, Compliance, and Legal to resolve issues and deliver reliable execution.
* Provide cover for other MENA Treasury activities when required, operating within documented controls and delegated authority.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* Typically 3–5 years’ experience in Treasury, payments, banking, finance operations, or a related financial-services role; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.
* Experience with reconciliations, payment operations, cash movements, or financial controls in a high-volume or regulated environment.
* Working knowledge of safeguarding and customer-funds protection, including segregation, reconciliations, fund flows, and escalation of exceptions.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, investigate discrepancies, explain findings, and maintain accurate records.
* Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills and confidence working with operational systems and reporting tools; experience with a Treasury management system is an advantage.
* A control-minded, organised approach and the confidence to raise a concern when something does not look right.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work constructively across teams and manage competing daily priorities.
* Fluent English; Arabic is an advantage but not essential.

**It would be useful if you also have**
---------------------------------------

* Exposure to a regulated payments provider, Electronic Money Institution, bank, or similar financial institution.
* Familiarity with UAE payments or safeguarding requirements, including the CBUAE framework.
* Exposure to cash management, liquidity monitoring, FX, or Treasury systems such as Kyriba or FXall.
* Experience documenting procedures, supporting audits, or improving and automating operational processes.

**How you will contribute**
---------------------------

You will deliver accurate and timely Treasury processes, provide dependable analysis and control evidence, and ensure exceptions are understood and acted on promptly. You will bring ownership to defined areas of activity and help strengthen the team’s operational resilience across MENA safeguarding and Treasury.

**Additional Information**

**Bring all of you to work**

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

**Life at** **Checkout.com**

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely.

We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees.

  

**Physical Access Control Solutions (PACS):**

  

HID PACS, located in multiple development locations across the world, is recognized as the global leader in the design, manufacture and supply of access control security technology. HID Global, the provider of trusted identities to the world's people, places and things. A leader in the commercial security industry, this established company designs and manufactures physical access control systems.

  

**As our Pre-Sales Engineer- Access Control Biometrics , you’ll support HID’s success by:**

  

* Provide technical presales support for biometric access control opportunities across the MEA region.
* Gather customer requirements and design biometric access control solutions tailored to business, operational, and security needs.
* Deliver technical presentations, product demonstrations, workshops, and PoC evaluations.
* Support RFIs, RFPs, tenders, compliance requirements, and technical proposals.
* Advise customers on biometric authentication, enrollment workflows, liveness detection, template storage options, privacy, and cybersecurity best practices.
* Support integrations with Physical Access Control Systems (PACS), identity management platforms, Time & Attendance and visitor management systems.
* Deliver technical training and enablement programs to consultants, partners, and customers.
* Provide remote and on-site technical support during evaluations, deployments, and customer engagements.
* Collaborate with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Technical Support teams.

* Work closely with Engineering on customer-specific product customizations (CPOs), feature requests, and solution development initiatives.
* Maintain accurate records of customer engagements, technical activities, and opportunity progress, with regular reporting to stakeholders

* Gather market intelligence, customer feedback, and competitive insights to support business growth and product strategy.
* Demonstrated ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new technologies, industry verticals, and market trends.

* Ability to interpret technical specifications, integration guides, and industry standards to support solution design and customer engagements
* Represent the company at customer meetings, exhibitions, conferences, and industry events.
* Support customers and partners across the MEA region remotely, extending beyond your primary territory as business needs require.
* Ability to travel extensively throughout the MEA region

  

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related discipline.

* Strong knowledge of the Middle East & Africa (MEA) market, including experience engaging with key end users, consultants, system integrators, and strategic verticals such as government, critical infrastructure, transportation, banking, smart cities, healthcare, and oil & gas.

jobs.description:
Job Description

  

Responsibilities

  

Qualifications

**JOB SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION**

To support the Global Treasury, Trade & Tokenization Client Solutions team in originating, structuring and delivering transaction banking solutions for Wholesale Banking Group clients, with primary focus on Real Estate & Hospitality clients. The role will partner with Coverage, Product and control functions to analyze client needs, prepare and execute Cash Management, Liquidity, Trade Finance and digital-channel solutions, and contribute to revenue, CASA, wallet-share and client-experience objectives within First Abu Dhabi Bank’s risk appetite and governance framework.
  
The role is developmental and is expected to progress greater ownership as technical and client capability develops.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Client and opportunity analysis: Analyze client business models, project and operating cash flows, transaction journeys, working-capital cycles, existing bank utilization and competitor positioning to identify Cash, Trade, Liquidity and digital opportunities.
* Sector-focused origination: Support calling plans and account strategies for Real Estate & Hospitality clients, including developers, contractors, property managers, hotel owners and operators, within the assigned Real Estate & Hospitality portfolio.
* Solution development: Work with Coverage and Product teams to design customer-focused solutions across payments, collections, virtual accounts, escrow and project accounts, liquidity and liabilities, host-to-host/API connectivity, cards, core trade, guarantees, open-account trade, Supply Chain Finance and Receivables Finance.
* Client engagement: Prepare client briefs, presentations, proposals, product comparisons, meeting materials and call reports; participate in client meetings, product demonstrations and solution workshops, and maintain disciplined follow-up on agreed actions.
* RFP and proposal management: Coordinate timely, accurate and commercially compelling responses to RFPs, service enquiries and pricing requests, ensuring that solution design, operational readiness, legal terms, economics and implementation requirements are aligned.
* Pipeline and portfolio discipline: Maintain opportunity pipelines, client activity records and management information; track mandates, revenue, CASA, facility utilization, digital penetration, implementation progress and outstanding actions, escalating gaps or delays.
* Transaction execution: Coordinate credit, pricing and product approvals, documentation, implementation readiness and hand-offs with Product, Implementation, Operations, Credit, Legal, Compliance, Finance and other stakeholders.
* Onboarding and service delivery: Support account opening, KYC and due-diligence requirements, documentation follow-up, implementation and resolution of client issues to deliver a timely and high-quality client experience.
* Commercial outcomes: Contribute to growth in transaction banking revenue, CASA and operating balances, trade utilisation, fee income, digital adoption and overall GTx wallet share, with appropriate attention to risk-adjusted returns and pricing discipline.
* Risk and control: Comply with applicable Credit, Compliance, AML, sanctions, fraud, operational-risk, conduct, data-privacy and information-security requirements; identify and escalate exceptions, control issues and client concerns promptly.
* Market and product insight: Monitor sector developments, competitor activity and client trends; share practical insights and identify opportunities for new products, improved structures and better client journeys.
Process improvement and learning: Build strong technical and sector knowledge, support improvements to workflows and reporting, and complete required learning, coaching and on-the-job development activities.  

**REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum qualification: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Commerce or a related discipline.
* Transaction banking knowledge: Basic understanding of cash management, payments, collections, liquidity management, trade finance and digital banking solutions, with the ability and commitment to develop deeper technical knowledge. The role is developmental and is expected to progress greater ownership as technical and client capability develops.
* Client orientation: Professional, responsive and service-focused, with the confidence to support client meetings and follow through with reliably on commitments.
* Communication and presentation: Strong written and verbal English, with the ability to prepare concise proposals, presentations and management updates.
* Stakeholder management: Collaborative and able to coordinate effectively across Coverage, Product, Implementation, Operations, Credit, Legal, Compliance and external client stakeholders.
* Execution discipline: Organised, attentive to detail and able to prioritise multiple tasks, maintain accurate records and deliver against deadlines in a controlled environment.
* Digital and systems capability: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to learn CRM, workflow, digital-banking, pipeline and reporting systems. The role is developmental and is expected to progress greater ownership as technical and client capability develops.
* Curious, accountable, adaptable and commercially minded, with a willingness to learn and operate under pressure while maintaining strong conduct and control standards.
* Must be a strong team player who is eager to learn and has good communication skills.
Must be organized, reliable, and able to work under a manager's guidance.  

**Preferred / Beneficial**

* Experience: Graduate or early career profile; 0-2 years of relevant experience in banking, transaction banking, client service, sales support, operations or a related area is preferred.
* Arabic capability is advantageous.

  

About Us

**About Us:**

  

First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) is the largest bank in the UAE and one of the world's largest and safest financial institutions. We offer a comprehensive range of personal and private banking services, including credit cards, Islamic banking, investments, loans, and mortgages. Our commitment to excellence and innovation drives us to provide top-tier financial solutions to our clients.

  

**Life at FAB:**

  

Working at FAB means being part of a team of talented and passionate individuals with a shared vision to support the ambitions of our stakeholders to "Grow Stronger." We embrace the needs of our customers across the globe with a sense of responsibility and confidence driven by extensive expertise that can only be delivered by an ambitious world-class organization

  

**Career Development:**

  

FAB offers unique career choices, a chance to innovate, craft solutions for the future, and express yourself in a performance-based culture that will unleash the best in you. Whether you are an experienced professional or just starting your career, FAB provides a range of learning and development initiatives to support all employees through training and skill development.

  

**Our Values:**

  

At FAB, we place our customers at the core of our activities, live our values each day in every way, celebrate achievements, and empower each other to deliver leading solutions. We have structured plans for the recruitment and career progression of Emirati talent to enable them to make a mark in the financial and banking sector both regionally and globaly that rewards your hard work and dedication.

  

Join our team and be part of a journey to shape the future of banking.

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
You will run Capital.com's day-to-day social presence across the Middle East and North Africa. Social is often the first place a trader in the region meets our brand, so the work you publish shapes how people understand trading, risk and the platform before they ever open an account. You will sit in the MENA marketing team in Dubai, working with content, performance, compliance and product to turn market moments into clear, useful posts in Arabic and English. Our mission is to give traders clarity and technology they can rely on, and this role carries that into the feed every day.

### **What you will do:**

* Own the weekly content calendar for MENA channels: Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Snapchat and Telegram.
* Write and publish posts, captions, stories and short-form scripts in Arabic and English that explain markets plainly.
* React to market events (rate decisions, oil moves, earnings, gold) with timely, accurate content within agreed turnaround times.
* Brief the Video Editor and designers, review drafts and keep output on brand.
* Route every post through financial promotions review and keep required risk warnings in place.
* Manage community replies and DMs, escalating client issues to Customer Support and complaints to Compliance.
* Report weekly on reach, engagement, follower growth and social-sourced registrations, and act on what the numbers show.
* Work with the performance team so organic content supports paid campaigns and regional launches.

### **What you bring:**

* 3+ years managing brand social channels, or an equivalent portfolio that shows you grew an audience.
* Native-level Arabic and fluent English, with the judgment to write for Gulf and wider MENA audiences.
* Hands-on experience with native platform analytics and a scheduling tool such as Sprout Social, Hootsuite or Later.
* Comfort editing short-form video and graphics in CapCut, Canva or Adobe Express.
* Accuracy under time pressure: you check facts and figures before anything goes live.
Clear written communication and the ability to take feedback from Compliance without losing pace.  

### **Nice to have:**

* Experience in fintech, brokerage, banking or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of financial promotion rules (SCA, FCA COBS 4 or CySEC).
* Familiarity with UAE Media Council advertising and influencer requirements.
* Interest in markets and trading, and an understanding of CFDs.
* Experience with creator or influencer partnerships in the GCC.

### **What you will get in return:**

* **Competitive Salary:** We believe great work deserves great pay! Your skills and talents will be rewarded with a salary that makes you feel valued and motivated.
* **Work-Life Harmony:** Join a company that genuinely cares about *you*—because your life outside of work matters just as much as your time on the clock.
* **Annual Performance Bonus:** Your hard work doesn’t go unnoticed! Celebrate your achievements with a well-deserved annual bonus tied to your performance.
* **Generous Time Off:** Need a breather? Our annual leave policy lets you recharge and enjoy life outside of work without a worry.
* **Employee Referral Program:** Love working here? Share the love! Bring your talented friends on board and get rewarded for growing our awesome team.
* **Comprehensive Health & Pension Benefits:** From medical insurance to pension plans, we’ve got your back. Plus, location-specific benefits and perks!
* **Workation Wonderland:** Live your digital nomad dreams with 30 extra days to work remotely from anywhere in the world (some restrictions apply). Adventure awaits!
* **Volunteer Days:** Make a difference! Take two additional paid days each year to support causes you care about and give back to the community

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**You are the brain behind our work …**

At Citi, we do not just adapt to change – we drive it. Our Full Time Technology Analyst Program is where forward-thinking talents meet unparalleled opportunities. This is your chance to innovate, influence, and make an impact on the most global financial institution!

Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilizing a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high-performance enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.

**We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed…**

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The 2-year Analyst Program starts in July and begins with a robust training program. Here at Citi, rotational programs are intended to help you build a broad skillset and accelerate your career growth by gaining exposure to more than one team. Our rotational program will help you discover the best fit for your skills and long-term career goals at Citi.

**Your time here will look like this...**

You will work in an agile software development environment, developing quality and scalable software solutions using leading-edge technologies. Based on business requirements, you will develop code consistent with quality standards and offer support during testing cycles and post-production deployment. To ensure defect-free programming, you will use the appropriate tools to test and debug code and participate in the review of peer coding. You have additional support, too. You join a cohort of other new hires and go through training together to learn about our company, our tools and processes, and the technical skills you will need to succeed.

  
  

While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, some developers will have exposure within the following categories:

* **Back-End Development:** Java, Python, Spring Framework
* **Front-End Development:** Web (React, TypeScript, Angular, HTML5) and Mobile (Swift, Kotlin)
* **Generative AI & AI Agents****:** GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)
* **Data Analytics:** Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.
  

  

No matter your team placement, as a member in our program, you can expect:

* **Global Exposure**: Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.

* **Continuous Learning:** Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programs that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills.

* **Real Impact**: Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.

**To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria:**

* Graduation between Dec 2026 and July 2027.

* Educational background: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.

* A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions.

* Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.

* Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.

* Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.

* Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.

* Work Authorization: Authorized to work in Bahrain without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future.

**Who we think will be a great fit...**

A steadfast dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As global industries continue to evolve, we are seeking professionals who bring a global perspective to the future of banking and are eager to make an impact at the corporate level using AI. We value diversity and so do you.

This program is ideal for those who:

* Are ambitious, with a relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

* Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation.

* Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.

**Job Family:**

-

Full time

------------------------

Please see the requirements listed above.

-

-------------------------

As we continue to build upon our successes, we are looking for ambitious individuals who are passionate about the banking and finance industry and the markets in which CBD operates. jobs.title: Director - AI Delivery Product
jobs.description:
**About Firstsource**
Firstsource Solutions Limited, an RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group company (NSE: FSL, BSE: 532809, Reuters: FISO.BO, Bloomberg: FSOL:IN), is a specialized global business process services partner, providing transformational solutions and services spanning the customer lifecycle across Healthcare, Banking and Financial Services, Communications, Media and Technology, Retail, and other diverse industries. With an established presence in the US, the UK, India, Mexico, Australia, South Africa, and the Philippines, we make it happen for our clients, solving their biggest challenges with hyper-focused, domain-centered teams and cutting-edge tech, data, and analytics. Our real-world practitioners work collaboratively to deliver future-focused outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a commercially astute and technically visionary Director to own and scale Firstsource's AI & Cloud product portfolio across multiple product lines. You will set product strategy, engineering standards, and investment priorities across the portfolio, while mentoring a team of Associate Directors and engineering leaders. With 18+ years of experience, you bring deep Python and Generative AI expertise, enterprise cloud architecture mastery, and the executive presence to shape AI product strategy at the CXO level.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio Strategy & Architecture**

* Define multi-year product strategy and investment roadmap across the AI product portfolio.
* Set enterprise architecture standards and reference patterns embedding Generative AI and agentic workflows across all product lines.
* Approve major architecture decisions and technology bets across product engineering teams.
* Represent product strategy to executive leadership and, where relevant, the board.

**Engineering Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead a portfolio of product engineering teams (20–40 engineers) across geographies via Associate Directors and Senior Managers.
* Own portfolio-level P&L, resourcing, and executive-level roadmap reporting.
* Establish org-wide delivery governance, quality, and risk frameworks.
* Champion enterprise-wide adoption of AI coding agents and agentic delivery practices.

**Generative AI & Intelligent Automation**

Analytical platforms and services, including Snowflake, Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, together with OLTP and operational database services such as Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle and Azure Cosmos DB.

**Leadership profile**
A technically credible platform leader who can translate business demand into product capabilities, influence vendors and stakeholders, and grow adoption across the enterprise.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Cloud Data Platform Product & Engineering Leader is accountable for the full lifecycle of enterprise data and database platform services. The role combines deep technical leadership with product ownership, service management and commercial influence. **Hiring: Head of Technology / VP Engineering**

**Company:**
KGIL Fintech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (SwipeLoan)

Hinjawadi, Pune | Work from Office

10–15+ years in Technology, Software Engineering, Architecture and Engineering Leadership

₹18–24 LPA, depending on experience and technical expertise

**Reporting to:**
Founder & CEO

**About KGIL**

KGIL is building a diversified technology ecosystem with products spanning fintech, digital lending, credit solutions and emerging consumer internet businesses.

Through SwipeLoan and our expanding portfolio of digital platforms, we aim to develop and scale technology-driven businesses across multiple industries.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on technology leader with
**CTO-level capabilities**
who can take complete ownership of technology strategy, architecture, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity and product development across our growing ecosystem.

This is not a conventional IT management role.

The selected candidate must be capable of independently evaluating new business concepts, selecting appropriate technology stacks, designing scalable systems, building engineering teams and delivering end-to-end technology solutions.

We are looking for a technology generalist with deep engineering expertise who is comfortable working across different programming languages, frameworks, architectures and business domains.

The candidate should have the technical judgment and leadership ability to build products using both existing and emerging technologies, without being restricted to any single programming language or framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Technology Ownership**

* Own the complete technology function across existing and future KGIL platforms.
* Define long-term technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering roadmaps.
* Independently translate business ideas into technical requirements, architecture and execution plans.
* Take responsibility for technology decisions from product conceptualisation to development, deployment, scaling and maintenance.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the Founder & CEO.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, development timelines, resource requirements and infrastructure costs for new businesses.
* Ensure all platforms are secure, scalable, reliable and commercially efficient.

**2. Multi-Technology & Full-Stack Engineering Leadership**

Lead engineering across multiple technology stacks, including but not limited to:

* **Backend:**
  PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Python, Django, FastAPI, Java, Spring Boot, Go and other relevant technologies.
* **Frontend:**
  React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular and modern frontend frameworks.
* **Mobile Applications:**
  Flutter, React Native, native Android and iOS development.
* **Databases:**
  MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and other SQL/NoSQL technologies.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:**
  AWS, cloud-native architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless systems and CI/CD.
* **Integrations:**
  REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, third-party APIs, payment gateways and external services.
* **AI & Automation:**
  AI/ML integrations, LLM-based applications, intelligent automation and data-driven product capabilities.

The candidate is not expected to write production code in every language personally but must possess sufficient architectural and technical depth to evaluate, guide and manage engineering teams working across different technology stacks.

**3. New Product Development & Technology Expansion**

* Lead technology development for new businesses across fintech and non-fintech industries.
* Evaluate new product ideas and recommend the most suitable technology stack for each business.
* Design and deliver MVPs, scalable applications and enterprise-grade platforms.
* Lead development of consumer applications, marketplaces, subscription platforms, SaaS products, social networking applications and e-commerce solutions.
* Build reusable technology components, shared services and APIs wherever commercially appropriate.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, third-party platforms and outsourcing opportunities.
* Ensure new product launches meet defined timelines, budgets and quality standards.
* Support rapid experimentation, prototyping and product-market validation.

**4. Technology Architecture & Scalability**

* Design scalable, secure and high-performance application architectures.
* Make informed decisions between monolithic, modular and microservices architectures.
* Establish standards for API design, database architecture, system integrations and data management.
* Implement performance optimisation, caching, monitoring and system observability.
* Plan infrastructure capacity for high-volume applications and rapid user growth.
* Ensure appropriate system resilience, backup, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements.
* Identify and resolve technical debt and architectural limitations.

**5. Engineering Team Leadership & Recruitment**

* Lead existing backend, frontend, mobile, QA, DevOps and AI/ML teams.
* Independently recruit developers, architects and technical specialists based on business requirements.
* Build and manage multiple engineering teams working on different products simultaneously.
* Establish clear reporting structures, engineering ownership and accountability.
* Define development standards, code review processes and technical documentation requirements.
* Conduct technical interviews and assess candidate capabilities across different technology stacks.
* Mentor engineering leads and develop future technology leaders.
* Manage internal development teams, freelancers, technology vendors and outsourced partners.

**6. DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Cybersecurity**

* Own cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, production environments and system monitoring.
* Manage AWS infrastructure and evaluate alternative cloud services where appropriate.
* Establish robust CI/CD, release management and automated testing processes.
* Implement cybersecurity controls, vulnerability management, access controls and secure development practices.
* Oversee incident response, disaster recovery and infrastructure reliability.
* Coordinate technical security requirements relating to ISO 27001, applicable data protection laws and regulatory obligations.
* Ensure company-controlled access to source code, repositories, servers, cloud accounts and technology assets.
* Monitor infrastructure expenditure and implement cost optimisation initiatives.

**7. Fintech & Third-Party Integrations**

* Oversee technology integrations with banks, NBFCs, credit bureaus, KYC providers, Account Aggregators, payment gateways and other financial technology service providers.
* Ensure reliability, security and performance of partner APIs.
* Support lending journeys, credit eligibility systems, subscription payments and automated financial workflows.
* Coordinate with business and compliance teams on technology-related regulatory requirements.

**8. Product, Business & Leadership Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Founder & CEO to evaluate and execute new business opportunities.
* Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Finance, Business Development and Operations teams.
* Provide technical recommendations in business planning and strategic discussions.
* Prepare technology budgets, development roadmaps and resource allocation plans.
* Communicate technical risks, dependencies and investment requirements clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Take independent ownership of technical execution while keeping management informed of major decisions.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Mandatory**

* 10–15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 4–5 years in engineering leadership or architecture roles.
* Strong hands-on software engineering background with experience designing and scaling production app

jobs.title: Manager, IT Delivery
jobs.description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Manager, IT Delivery is responsible for leading high-performing data and technology teams and delivering strategic data initiatives that generate measurable business value.
  
  
This role combines people leadership, product delivery, stakeholder management, and operational oversight. The manager will lead teams operating across data engineering, data platforms, data warehousing, data lakes, data governance, data quality, and analytics.
  
  
The manager will have end-to-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products. The successful candidate will bring strong leadership and communication capabilities, experience managing product-oriented teams, and a sound understanding of modern data ecosystems. The role requires the ability to translate business priorities into executable delivery plans, develop engineering talent, manage delivery commitments, and ensure the scalability, quality, security, and reliability of data solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop high-performing data and technology teams, including hiring, performance management, workforce planning, and talent development.
* Drive delivery of strategic initiatives across data engineering, data warehousing, data lakes / lakehouses, data integration, data governance, data quality, analytics, and business intelligence.
* Partner with business, product, architecture, and engineering stakeholders to translate priorities into product roadmaps, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead product-oriented teams with end-to-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products.
* Drive Agile practices, including intake management, backlog prioritization, estimation, sprint and release planning, and delivery governance.
* Manage capacity planning, resource forecasting, delivery commitments, risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies to enable predictable execution.
* Ensure data solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, reusable, and compliant with applicable technology, risk, privacy, and information security standards.
* Promote effective data governance, data quality, metadata management, lineage, ownership, and stewardship practices.
* Monitor delivery, quality, and operational health through relevant metrics, and provide clear, concise updates to stakeholders and leadership.
* Foster strong stakeholder relationships and communicate complex data and technology topics effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Promote automation, standardization, engineering excellence, cost optimization, and modern data practices, including cloud and AI-enabled capabilities.
* Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and business-outcome ownership.
* Provide leadership during major incidents and critical production events, partnering with support and engineering teams to drive timely resolution, stakeholder communication, and service recovery while ensuring operational continuity.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 10+ years of experience in technology delivery, software engineering, data platforms, or IT services, including people leadership experience.
* Proven experience leading teams in a product-based environment with responsibility for delivery execution and stakeholder management.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery practices, backlog management, sprint planning, and Jira.
* Experience leading data-focused technology initiatives, including data engineering, analytics, data quality, governance, or modern data platforms.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution, manage ambiguity, solve complex problems, and lead organisational change.
* Ability to understand technical concepts and effectively partner with engineering teams to deliver business outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries.
* Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and AI-enabled technology initiatives.
* Agile, Scrum, PMP, SAFe, or related certifications preferred.
* Experience leading cloud data platform, data modernization, or platform transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing geographically distributed or cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with industry-standard cloud, data engineering, analytics, governance, and data quality technologies.

**Key Success Factors**

* Experience in data-centric technology environments.
* Ability to build, scale, and lead high-performing teams.
* Sound understanding of data engineering, data platforms, governance, quality, and analytics.
* Strong product and Agile delivery leadership.
* Effective capacity planning, forecasting, and execution management.
* Ownership and accountability for delivery and operational outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication.
* Ability to connect data and technology investments to business outcomes.
* Ability to operate effectively in a complex, cross-functional environment.
* Commitment to engineering quality, operational excellence, risk management, and continuous improvement.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the business to provide a comprehensive view.

As an Executive Director in model risk governance and review within International Consumer Banking, you will serve as the review lead and be accountable for independent model reviews and model governance. You will be accountable to the International Consumer Banking Model Risk Officer for these independent reviews and governance activities. You will also serve as the Consumer and Community Banking and International Consumer Banking India lead, accountable to the line of business head. You will work with senior business, model development, and risk partners.

**Job responsibilities**

* Lead as review lead for International Consumer Banking and be accountable for the quality, consistency, and timeliness of independent model reviews.
* Set review priorities, allocate reviews, and approve review findings and conclusions covering conceptual soundness, assumptions, inputs, testing, and implementation; personally lead the most complex or high-risk reviews.
* Discuss findings and required actions with model owners and senior stakeholders, and resolve differences on review conclusions.
* Oversee the review of proposed enhancements to existing models and extensions of model scope, and provide approvals as required.
* Oversee the assessment of risks from advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning models, including generative artificial intelligence and agentic artificial intelligence, and ensure required model review and governance processes are followed.
* Oversee model risk lifecycle activities, including model inventory accuracy, ongoing performance monitoring, annual status assessments, and model change control; ensure these activities are completed accurately and on time.
* Maintain robust model risk controls for International Consumer Banking models and serve as the primary point of contact; proactively identify and escalate issues to ensure resolutions are sound and timely.
* Serve as the Consumer and Community Banking and International Consumer Banking India lead, accountable to the line of business head.
* Prioritize training and career development for team members; coach and mentor staff at all levels, set clear expectations, and give regular feedback.
* Contribute to model risk governance and review priorities and initiatives.
* Stay informed about changes in consumer banking, artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques (including generative artificial intelligence and agentic artificial intelligence), products, markets, models, risk practices, and industry standards; use this knowledge to guide review priorities and identify emerging risks.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with a strong quantitative background (PhD, Master's degree, or equivalent) in Statistics, Economics (with Econometrics), Data Science, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a quantitative science.
* Knowledge of both statistical/econometric methodologies and machine learning modeling methodologies.
* Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, SAS, or R.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with ability to interface with stakeholders on model-related issues.

**Product Manager, Input Zone**

  

**About our Team:-**

DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

  

**About the Role:-**

The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

  

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.

* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.

* Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.

* Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).

* Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.

* Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

**Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle**

* Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders.

* Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes.

* Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope.

* Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow.

* Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria.

* Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD).

* Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering.

* Participates in product discovery and process improvement, and contributes to prototypes (for example, content provider manifest ingestion and PDF identification).

* Is familiar with SDLCs identified by management, for example agile processes.

**Strategy & Commercial Acumen**

* Contributes to the strategy and development plans for ingestion and technical onboarding, shared across the roles carrying the Onboarding Technical Liaison responsibility.

* Understands the operating cost and effort involved in onboarding a new content provider or source.

* Makes links between personal goals and the team and business strategy.

**Technical Skills**

* Understands the Input Zone's data and technical architecture — publisher drop zones, ingestion validation, and the downstream handoff — well enough to liaise credibly with engineering.

* Uses technologies to assist day-to-day tasks (Excel, SQL, Jira, Confluence; familiarity with Salesforce/Snowflake rights data flows and sFTP/S3 publisher landing zones).

* Has working experience with generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows (for example prompt design, specification-to-code generation, AI-supported testing) and understands their limitations, including accuracy, data confidentiality, and publisher-content handling.

* Ability to engage developers to understand technology constraints.

**Competencies**

**Personal Capability**

**Practices Self-Development**

* Is curious and keen to learn and develop new ideas, skills, and knowledge.

* Acts on feedback to improve him/herself.

* Looks for developmental opportunities in day-to-day work.

* Invests time and energy in self-development (professional qualifications, relevant reading, networking, keeping up with AI-assisted product and development practices).

**Solves Problems and Analyses Issues**

* Is able to ask effective questions and collect facts from multiple sources in order to solve problems.

* Is able to effectively identify and analyse problems and propose solutions.

* Effectively manages day-to-day issues and problems without intervention.

**Innovates**

* Brainstorms with others to look for different approaches to current processes and tasks.

* Looks for opportunities to develop new ideas or thinking within own role.

* Experiments with new ideas, including applying AI and SDD to onboarding and ingestion workflows, and shares what works with the team.

**Interpersonal Skills**

**Communicates Powerfully and Prolifically**

* Demonstrates effective conversational skills, including active listening and questioning.

* Shares information relevant to own role.

* Participates in team presentations.

**Collaboration and Teamwork**

* Develops co-operative working relationships within the team.

* Considers how own style affects others and tailors interactions accordingly.

* Looks for ways to develop mutually beneficial relationships across teams.

**Builds Relationships**

* Is approachable and friendly.

* Asks for opinions of others.

* Participates in formal and informal gatherings to meet new people and develop new relationships.

jobs.description:
**Product Manager, Input Zone**

  

**About our Team:-**

DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

  

**About the Role:-**

The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

  

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.

* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.

* Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.

* Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).

* Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.

* Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

**Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle**

* Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders.

* Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes.

* Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope.

* Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow.

* Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria.

* Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD).

* Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering.

* Participates in product discovery and process improvement, and contributes to prototypes (for example, content provider manifest ingestion and PDF identification).

* Is familiar with SDLCs identified by management, for example agile processes.

**Strategy & Commercial Acumen**

* Understands the operating cost and effort involved in onboarding a new content provider or source.

* Makes links between personal goals and the team and business strategy.

**Technical Skills**

* Uses technologies to assist day-to-day tasks (Excel, SQL, Jira, Confluence; familiarity with Salesforce/Snowflake rights data flows and sFTP/S3 publisher landing zones).

* Has working experience with generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows (for example prompt design, specification-to-code generation, AI-supported testing) and understands their limitations, including accuracy, data confidentiality, and publisher-content handling.

* Ability to engage developers to understand technology constraints.

**Competencies**

**Personal Capability**

* Is curious and keen to learn and develop new ideas, skills, and knowledge.

* Acts on feedback to improve him/herself.

* Looks for developmental opportunities in day-to-day work.

* Invests time and energy in self-development (professional qualifications, relevant reading, networking, keeping up with AI-assisted product and development practices).

jobs.title: Vice President - Business Management, Design Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Our Business Management team acts as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and optimizes business performance by helping to drive key initiatives. We act as a counterweight to business and group heads and are responsible for identifying, escalating, and mitigating business risks. The role is dynamic and can vary from business to business, in line with the priorities of different lines of business. This is a time-pressured and high-profile position, instrumental in assisting and advising senior management. You will help coordinate the deployment of corporate resources to address strategic and tactical objectives.

Job summary

As a **Business Management** professional within the **Business Management team**, you will help drive strategic and tactical objectives by coordinating corporate resources and advising senior management. You will implement new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms by aligning partners across Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, and Compliance. You will optimize bottom-line performance by driving key initiatives related to fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization. You will identify, escalate, and mitigate business risks that could impair the ability to do business, including legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, and extraordinary transaction costs. You will partner across functions to define future workflows and implement related technology and infrastructure projects to support an evolving market structure.

Job responsibilities

* **Implement** new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms, including aligning department and support groups (Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, Compliance)
* **Optimize** bottom-line business performance by driving key initiatives (fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization)
* **Identify** business risks that could impair the ability to do business and **escalate and mitigate** those risks (e.g., legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, extraordinary transaction costs)
* **Analyze** financial performance, including expenses; **identify** productivity initiatives and **drive** implementation
* **Partner** with the business, Operations, and Technology to define future workflows and **implement** related technology and infrastructure projects to prepare for evolving market structure requirements
* **Partner** with relevant external service and infrastructure providers
* **Represent** the business in internal and external working groups

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or other related area
* Previous product knowledge and/or prior Business Management or Chief Operating Officer experience
* Energetic and dynamic style
* Highly motivated self-starter with excellent time management and prioritization skills
* Ability to present well to senior and global business heads
* Ability to forge strong internal relationships across a broad range of functions
* Self-motivated, tenacious, and able to work with a high degree of independence
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Ability to define and deliver a strategic agenda across multiple groups
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including ability to analyze large data sets and present conclusions concisely
* Excellent project management and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail and a logical thought process

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

  

Global Finance & Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.

Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).

The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will help in migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Keep up to date with the Group’s business strategy (incl. SC Ventures) and ensure the IRRBB frameworks are aligned to that.
  
• Partner with Global Head of IRRBB in developing and recommending risk mitigation strategies based on the findings from stress tests and scenario analyses. Ensure that these strategies are effectively communicated and implemented across relevant business units.

**Business**  
• Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates, with a focus on the Group’s participation in the Digital Assets and platforms space.
  
• Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
  
• Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

**Processes**  
• **Analytics:** Support the newly developed IRRBB analytics capabilities on a regular basis, including operating the RCO IRRBB calculation engine to run bespoke scenarios and extracting and analysing the results, covering key metric including, but not limited to, Weekly NIIS Flash, Hedging Strategy Assessments, Corporate Plan NII impact simulations and PV01 analysis. This will also involve working with CPM and Finance closely to prepare MI slides for relevant committees like GALCO, ALCO and IRRBB Steering Forums.

* **Strategy:** Support IRRBB strategy by engaging Treasury Markets on NII sensitivities, hedging performance and P&L forecasting. Support investor relations for quarterly results, including GALCO/ALCO hedging updates, and contribute to annual disclosures through slide preparation, briefing notes, Q&A drafting and investor query responses.

* **Framework & Governance:** Support IRRBB governance through preparation of monthly GALCO/ALCO packs with commentary, review of risk metrics and monitoring of group, solo and local limits. Lead regulatory submissions and challenge returns, oversee MAT and risk appetite reviews, maintain IRRBB policies, support disclosures and audits, escalate emerging topics and drive regulatory engagement and interpretation.

* **Modelling & Methodology** : Apply and maintain IRRBB models per regulatory requirements, including PTR and CASA assumptions. Review and update IRRBB and structural hedging policies, maintain standards, and perform annual forecasts of NII, EBE, and P2A. Conduct policy effectiveness, self-assessment, gap and impact analyses, harmonize models with group, and run simulations and scenario analyses to support regulatory and corporate planning.

* **Structural Hedging:** Support the structural hedging in planning, executing, and monitoring hedges, including P&L sign-off and capacity management. Support group IRBB hedging programs, assess available instruments, forecast and quantify hedge requirements, run analytics and simulations, and provide MI for GALCO discussions to drive informed hedging decisions.

* **Stress Testing:** Support IRRBB stress testing including ICAAP and Pillar 2 assessments, NMD parameter stress, country/cluster ICAP, and reverse stress testing. Conduct basis risk evaluations, Pillar 2 charge reviews, and prepare Pillar 3 disclosures. Support IRBB-related GIA and audit reviews, ensuring all stress testing aligns with ORF requirements and regulatory expectations.

* **IRRBB Technology Journey:** Support delivery of new system rollouts, enhancements and data fixes by providing requirements, validating functionality, and ensuring data accuracy. Collaborate with stakeholders to implement changes efficiently, maintain alignment with IRRBB policy and reporting standards, and drive continuous improvement of systems and processes.

• Lead by example in reinforcing the appropriate culture and values of the function.
  
• Contribute to ongoing training and development of team members.

**Risk Management**  
• Oversee enterprise-wide interest rate risk in the banking book ensuring alignment with risk appetite and regulatory requirements. Monitor, measure and manage exposures, set limits, and perform scenario analysis and stress testing. Maintain robust frameworks, policies and governance, validate models, provide insights for strategic planning and support senior management, GALCO/ALCO and regulators on risk mitigation, reporting and capital optimisation.

**Governance**

• Understand the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

**Senior Manager, BG&C**
========================

Req ID: 124671

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Manager, Business Governance & Controls (BG&C), leads the first-line operational risk and control agenda for the Bengaluru GCC. The role establishes a consistent and effective risk and control environment aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite and enterprise risk framework, while ensuring business and functional leaders retain clear ownership of their risks and controls.

  

As the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, the role provides independent-minded advice and constructive challenge, strengthens risk culture and operational resilience, and enables well-informed business decisions. The role also leads the continuous improvement of control testing, assurance insights and governance reporting across the GCC.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Full Time, Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Manager, BG&C, you will:

  

* Develop and execute the GCC first-line risk and control strategy, aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite, enterprise risk framework and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Establish and maintain a consistent GCC-wide approach to identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring and reporting operational and compliance risks, with clear business ownership of risks and controls.
* Act as the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, providing timely advice, evidence-based insights and constructive challenge to support informed decision-making.
* Lead GCC-wide risk assessments across operational, technology, cyber, data, third-party, people, conduct, regulatory and change risks, ensuring material exposures and emerging themes are identified and addressed.
* Oversee the GCC operational resilience agenda, including first-line oversight of critical operations, material service providers, intra group arrangements, business continuity and key dependency or concentration risks.
* Coordinate GCC implementation of relevant enterprise and regulatory risk requirements, including PACT, NFR framework changes and CPS 230-related obligations, in partnership with Group Risk and specialist teams.
* Lead the design, uplift and consistent application of control testing methodologies, quality benchmarks, documentation standards and review practices across GCC teams and portfolios.
* Champion data-led and automated testing approaches where appropriate, ensuring enhancements are well governed, scalable and improve the quality and efficiency of assurance outcomes.
* Synthesise risk assessments and control testing outcomes into clear, prioritised insights for the GCC Leadership Team and relevant governance forums, including transparent escalation of material weaknesses, systemic issues and non-compliance risks.

* Oversee the quality and progress of remediation, challenging whether actions address root causes and provide sufficient evidence of sustainable closure, while retaining accountability with the relevant business owner.

* Build a strong risk and compliance culture by coaching leaders, strengthening accountability and promoting open, transparent engagement across businesses, functions, second line, Audit and other key stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the BG&C team, ensuring effective resourcing, clear priorities and the skills and capability required to meet current and future GCC needs.
* Drive continuous improvement of the GCC risk and control environment, supporting business, process, systems and automation changes while ensuring associated risks are understood and appropriately managed.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------
