jobs.description:
Join us as a Gen AI Product Engineer
  
  

* In this key role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and scaling Generative AI (GenAI)-powered products and features that deliver tangible business value
* We’ll look to you to bridge product thinking and engineering execution, translating user needs into robust, production-ready AI solutions while driving innovation in the application of GenAI capabilities
* This is an opportunity to design and deliver production-grade GenAI solutions, including AI agents, conversational AI, and automation, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance
* We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do
  
  
As a Gen AI Product Engineer, you'll design, build, and deploy production-grade GenAI products and systems that turn user and business needs into secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. You'll also translate product and user requirements into scalable technical solutions, balancing model quality, latency, system complexity, and long-term maintainability, while building and integrating large language model (LLM) capabilities using modern frameworks and application programming interfaces (APIs).
  
  
This will include working across orchestration layers, retrieval pipelines, system integrations, prompt and context engineering, and model evaluation.
  
  
**You'll Also Be**

* Converting ambiguous product requirements and research concepts into robust technical architectures, balancing model capability, latency, cost, complexity, and maintainability
* Ensuring all GenAI solutions meet enterprise security, governance, responsible AI, and risk management standards, with appropriate controls, escalation, and mitigation built into delivery
* Developing and operating LLM solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, agent workflows, orchestration, prompt and content engineering, and model integration patterns
* Integrating GenAI capabilities into existing platforms through internal APIs, services, event flows, and data pipelines, ensuring resilience, observability, and maintainability in production environments
* Defining and applying approaches to model evaluation, benchmarking, monitoring, and continuous optimisation to improve quality, accuracy, reliability, and user outcomes
* Identifying and managing real-world AI system failure modes, including hallucinations, retrieval failures, tool-call errors, degraded model performance, and unsafe or non-compliant outputs
* Supporting production operations, including service monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and on-call responsibilities where required for business-critical GenAI systems

The skills you'll need
  
  
We're looking for someone with proven experience designing, building, and operating production-grade GenAI software systems, with strong capabilities in Python, front-end design frameworks, distributed systems, API design, cloud-native engineering, observability, and performance-critical workloads. You should also bring experience translating ambiguous research concepts, emerging AI capabilities, user needs, and product requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable production systems within fast-moving product or research-led environments.
  
  
To succeed in this role, you'll need experience delivering GenAI or LLM-powered products beyond the prototype stage, including self-hosted model inference with frameworks such as vLLM, OpenAI-compatible serving patterns, orchestration layers, software development kit integration, and production systems. You must also bring a practical understanding of LLM application architecture, including prompt and context engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG pipelines, agent workflows, tool-calling patterns, memory and context management, and the mitigation of real-world AI system failure modes.
  
  
**You'll Also Demonstrate**

* An understanding of model training, fine-tuning, adaptation, inference, and serving pipelines, including trade-offs in model selection, performance, cost, reliability, scalability, and operational complexity
* Experience evaluating, monitoring, and optimising AI systems, with working knowledge of responsible AI, model risk, security, governance, and operational controls in enterprise or regulated environments
* Hands-on experience deploying small language models for latency-, cost-, privacy-, or domain-specific use cases

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager (AI)-2
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Product Manager (AI)-2
  
  
**About The Team**
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a Lead Product Manager (AI) for the Operational Intelligence Program within the B&MI group. This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for an AI agent platform that serves
  
  
Mastercard issuers and acquirers - enabling non-technical financial operations teams to surface insights, investigate anomalies, and act on reconciliation data through natural language. You will define what gets built, sequence when it gets built, and ensure every decision is grounded in measurable customer and business value. You work at the intersection of customer discovery, AI capability, and compliance - and you are comfortable making hard prioritization calls in all three dimensions simultaneously.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end product strategy for the AI agent platform: define the vision, articulate the roadmap, and maintain a prioritized backlog that reflects real customer need, business impact, and delivery

feasibility.
  
  

* Drive customer discovery alongside forward deployed engineers - conduct structured interviews with issuers and acquirers, synthesize operational workflow pain points into validated product requirements, and

distinguish symptoms from root causes.
  
  

* Translate PoC findings and field signal into scoped, shippable product briefs: clearly written requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that engineering teams can build against without returning to you

for clarification.
  
  

* Define and own the agent capability roadmap - which workflows get automated, in what sequence, at what level of AI autonomy - balancing customer readiness, data availability, and compliance constraints.
* Set and track outcome-oriented success metrics for each agent and platform capability; ensure the team is measuring actual customer impact (time saved, errors reduced, queries resolved) not just activity.
* Partner with engineering leads to make build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions; understand enough about how AI systems work to evaluate feasibility claims honestly without being captured by engineering

enthusiasm or conservatism.
  
  

* Own the compliance and governance interface: work with legal, security, and risk teams to ensure product decisions account for data classification, audit requirements, and approval gates - and translate those

constraints back into product requirements without losing velocity.
  
  

* Manage stakeholder expectations across business, technology, and customer-facing teams; communicate roadmap trade-offs clearly and defend prioritization decisions with evidence.
* Define the agent maturity model - the progression from informational to insight to recommendation to action - and own the criteria that determine when a capability is ready to advance to the next tier.
* Identify platform-level patterns across individual agent builds and advocate for shared infrastructure investments that accelerate future delivery rather than optimizing only for the next release.
* Contribute to pre-sales and commercial conversations as the product authority - set honest expectations on what AI can deliver today, what requires a roadmap investment, and what is out of scope.

**All About You**

* Master's or bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience in product management for data, analytics, or AI products.
* Proven track record owning and shipping AI or data products in enterprise B2B environments - you can point to products you defined that are in production and delivering measurable value.
* Deep understanding of the AI product lifecycle: from discovery and PoC through productization, compliance review, and post-launch iteration. You know which phase you are in and what the exit criteria are.
* Strong customer instinct: you have run discovery sessions with non-technical domain experts, translated messy operational workflows into clean product requirements, and caught requirements that sounded right but would not generalize.
* Comfortable with the economics of AI products - inference cost, latency trade-offs, model capability ceilings, evaluation rigor - well enough to make roadmap trade-offs without deferring every technical question to engineering.
* Experience managing products in regulated industries (financial services, payments, or comparable); you understand what compliance and data governance constraints actually mean for product scope, not just as a checkbox.
* Strong written communication: your PRDs, briefs, and roadmap documents are clear enough that stakeholders and engineers reach different parts of them for different reasons - and both find what they need.
* Sharp prioritization discipline: you can say no to a well-articulated customer request, explain why, and offer a path forward that serves the underlying need without expanding scope.
* Experience working in a platform-and-application product model: you understand the tension between shipping agent-specific features and investing in platform capabilities, and you make that trade-off deliberately.
* Collaborative leadership style with an ability to influence without authority - across engineering, design, data science, sales, and compliance functions that each have their own priorities.
* Familiarity with agentic AI concepts (tool use, retrieval, reasoning loops, guardrails, safety) at a level sufficient to write meaningful acceptance criteria and evaluate whether an implementation actually

meets the product intent.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Solution Architect -VP
jobs.description:
Join us as a VP - Solution Architect at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.

Excellent senior stakeholder engagement and technology leadership, including mentoring architects, influencing roadmaps, and driving cross functional alignment.
  
  
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.

jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title: Technology Lead - Tribe Passport & Cloud Engineering**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Corporate Title: VP**
**Role Description**

* The Technology Lead will provide hands-on technical leadership across Cloud Platform Engineering and Tribe Passport within the Architecture & Technology Office (ATO). The role will lead the design and delivery of reusable cloud engineering, automation and DevOps capabilities, and provide senior technical ownership of Tribe Passport, a strategic ATO platform for engineering and management insights.
* This hands-on Vice President role combines cloud platform engineering, software engineering, solution architecture, DevOps, automation and technical leadership. The successful candidate will take complex engineering challenges from concept to production, delivering secure, resilient and reusable solutions for adoption across multiple teams and applications.
* The role requires the ability to set technical direction and define architecture while remaining hands-on in code reviews, complex troubleshooting, design validation and critical implementations.

**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
  
  

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Platform Engineering & Automation**

* Lead complex cloud platform engineering and automation initiatives across ATO, translating recurring engineering challenges into reusable capabilities, patterns and self-service workflows.
* Design and deliver automation for areas such as landing-zone provisioning, infrastructure-as-code, environment setup, CI/CD, policy/control automation, application onboarding and operational readiness.
* Develop reusable Terraform modules, engineering templates, APIs and automation frameworks that standardize delivery while reducing manual engineering effort.
* Lead the design and adoption of reusable DevOps capabilities across GitHub Actions, Jenkins and TeamCity, reducing unnecessary platform-specific dependencies.
* Develop reusable CI/CD workflows supporting applications deployed across Google Cloud and on-premises environments, incorporating standard security, testing, release and deployment controls.
* Drive release and deployment automation, reducing lead time while maintaining OSS vulnerability, audit, segregation-of-duties and change-control requirements.
* Establish reusable approaches for dependency and software lifecycle management, enabling security and OSS fixes to be propagated consistently across application portfolios.
* Provide hands-on engineering leadership for complex cloud onboarding, remediation and migration activities involving GCP, container platforms, databases, CI/CD and infrastructure automation.
* Identify opportunities for developer self-service and engineering productivity improvement, using automation to remove repetitive manual activities and operational toil.

**Tribe Passport**

* Provide senior technical ownership for Tribe Passport, including solution architecture, engineering standards, code quality, release readiness, resilience and production stability.
* Evaluate engineering requirements and translate them into architectural designs, delivery plans, epics and technical work packages, identifying dependencies and trade-offs early.
* Lead the continued evolution of Tribe Passport across the UI, APIs and backend services, data ingestion, data stores and reporting capabilities using relevant Google Cloud services.
* Define scalable integration patterns with enterprise sources including GitHub/Bitbucket, Jira, ServiceNow, Waltz, SonarQube and organizational / workforce data.
* Partner with Product and stakeholders to evolve Tribe Passport's capabilities around engineering productivity, DORA/flow metrics, software quality, SDLC controls, estate transparency and AI engineering adoption.
* Ensure Tribe Passport remains maintainable, supportable and aligned with appropriate security, data privacy, resilience and operational controls.
* Provide solution architecture leadership for complex technical initiatives, balancing security, resilience, observability, operability, cost, performance and regulatory requirements.
* Promote the responsible use of AI-assisted engineering tools to improve developer productivity, automation and engineering quality, while protecting confidential information and validating generated outputs.

**Expected outcomes**

* Reusable cloud engineering and automation capabilities reduce manual effort, onboarding time and delivery lead time across multiple ATO teams and applications.
* Cloud provisioning, deployment and operational workflows become increasingly automated, repeatable, secure and self-service.
* Common Terraform, CI/CD and platform patterns achieve adoption across multiple workloads rather than remaining application-specific solutions.
* Tribe Passport remains a secure, resilient, maintainable and strategically relevant engineering-insight platform.
* Complex platform and application engineering problems move efficiently from architecture to production, with clear ownership and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Engineering controls covering security, OSS, deployment and operational readiness are embedded in engineering workflows rather than evidenced manually afterwards.
* Cloud and platform capabilities are designed for reuse and scale, reducing duplication and reliance on platform-specific implementation knowledge.
* Engineering teams benefit from clear technical standards, mentoring and reusable patterns that allow them to deliver more independently.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Extensive hands-on software and/or platform engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership of complex enterprise applications, cloud platforms or engineering capabilities.
* Strong development capability in Java and/or Python, with the ability to review code and designs, troubleshoot complex issues and contribute directly when required.
* Deep practical Google Cloud experience, ideally across GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL/PostgreSQL, Secret Manager, IAM/service accounts, networking, load balancing and observability.
* Strong infrastructure-as-code and automation experience, particularly with Terraform, including the development of reusable modules, templates and engineering patterns.
* Strong DevOps and platform engineering expertise across CI/CD technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins and TeamCity, including reusable pipeline and workflow design.
* Experience designing automation and self-service engineering capabilities for use across multiple applications and engineering teams.
* Good understanding of containerized workloads, APIs, distributed systems, event-driven integration, messaging, caching and resilient cloud design patterns.
* Practical SRE and observability knowledge, including SLI/SLO design, logging, monitoring, alerting, operational dashboards, capacity and production-support practices.
* Working knowledge of software quality and security controls, including OSS vulnerability management, SonarQube or equivalent tooling, secrets management, IAM/entitlements, data privacy and audit evidence.
* Experience with engineering and operational technologies such as Liquibase, Kafka and New Relic, or comparable technologies.
* Ability to integrate with enterprise platforms such as Jira, ServiceNow, GitHub/Bitbucket and organizational data sources to enable automation and reliable engineering insights.
* Proven delivery leadership covering architecture, backlog and dependency manage

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Context Engine
jobs.description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Director of Product Management, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the capabilities that let Teradata's Enterprise Context Engine understand customer data on its own: schema and ontology discovery, natural language processing, and AI driven workflow and policy extraction. The Context Engine extracts, curates, and continuously improves metadata and business context, grounded in Teradata's industry knowledge models, so that human analysts move faster and AI agents are grounded in trusted enterprise meaning.
  
  
You will serve as the Context Engine's senior product leader in the region and partner closely with local engineering, data science, and architecture teams along with product and engineering leaders across the US. You will set direction, make prioritization decisions, and hold your team accountable for customer outcomes, from discovery and design through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy, Roadmap & Outcomes**

* Own the roadmap knowledge graph completion / Ontology Learning, Reflexion-based memory extraction, and reinforcement learning-focused feature sets within the Context Engine portfolio. Translate customer needs and business priorities into clear requirements, prioritization decisions, and success criteria.
* Act as the primary touchpoint and evangelist for Context Engine to customers, executives, and field teams in the APJ region.
* Define how these capabilities are reusable by and drive value across Teradata products, personas, and business domains, and across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Shape the competitive position and differentiation of the Context Engine against competitors such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, Google, and emerging AI data platform and semantic layer vendors.

**Automated Workflow Assembly**

* Define the product vision for automatically assembling workflows from discovered schemas and semantics, including data preparation, mapping, validation, enrichment, and publication of context, without hand-built pipelines for each customer.
* Specify how agents plan, compose, and execute these workflows, including reusable workflow templates, orchestration, approval checkpoints, and rollback.
* Set requirements for observability, explainability, and auditability so that customers can see why a workflow was assembled the way it was and trust what it produced.
* Define how workflows and discovered context are exposed to external agents and frameworks through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other open agent interfaces.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Customer adoption and production deployments of semantic extraction and automated workflow capabilities, including successful agent and application consumption of the context they produce.
* Discovery and mapping quality: accuracy, coverage, and confidence calibration of discovered schemas, relationships, and semantic mappings, and the share accepted by stewards without correction.
* Automation outcomes: reduction in time and manual effort to onboard a new customer data estate and reach usable context, and the share of workflows assembled and run without hand-built pipelines.
* Platform usability as measured by targeted KPIs and customer sentiment.
* Pipeline influence, win-rate contribution, and analyst and customer perception of Teradata's context and trusted-AI position.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of experience, including 6+ years in product management or equivalent technical product leadership, with 4+ years on enterprise NLP, search, or metadata and data discovery platforms.
* Hands-on experience with NLP and LLM-based applications such as entity and concept extraction, semantic matching, embeddings, and natural language grounding to structured data, including how to evaluate them.
* Experience with BPMN 2. 0 structured workflows, and a demonstrable record of bringing agentic AI solutions from concept to production.
* Working familiarity with ontology and knowledge graph concepts, and with how graph-based context is consumed by retrieval and agent systems.
* Experience with utilizing agent self-learning approaches such as Reflexion, Reflective learning (ERL), or similar approaches to verbal reinforcement learning to improve agents in response to events and encounters in production systems.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Join Barclays as AVP - Control Finance, where core responsibility is to execute design assessment and operating effectiveness testing of controls in accordance with testing plans and aligned to relevant policies, procedures and quality standards providing assurance to Management that the processes and controls within the reviewed Business Unit are effectively designed and operating to mitigating the identified risks. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.

  

To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:

  
  

* Experience in risk management or controls assurance or internal audit.
* Understanding of SOx and Risk Management practices including but not limited to Internal Audit.
* Ability to communicate internal control concepts clearly, in a business context.
* Verbal and written communication skills to deal with internal and external stakeholders. Keeps stakeholders up to date with the progress of the audit work, observation status, etc.
* Understand on Investment banking products and had exposure to Banking & Markets division.
* Understanding of Markets finance functions.
  

  

Some other highly valued skills may include below:

  
  

* Knowledge of internal control and regulatory requirements & practice e.g. Sarbanes-Oxley, COSO, Basel IV regulations.
* Proficient in use of MS Office packages (Outlook, Word, Excel, Power-point).
* Understanding on data analytics skills used in control testing.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

  
  

The role is based out of Gurugram.

**Purpose of the role**

To partner with the bank, to provide independent insurance on control processes and advise on improvements to ensure the efficiency and effectiveness of the bank’s internal controls framework.

**Accountabilities**

* Collaboration across the bank to maintain a satisfactory, robust, and efficient control environment through the execution of ad-hoc assessments and testing on the design and operational effectiveness of the internal controls, aligned to control policies and standards.
* Development of detailed test plans and procedures to identify weaknesses in internal controls and other initiatives aligned to the bank’s control framework to mitigate any potential risks and issues, prioritised by its severity to disrupt bank operations, potential losses, and reputational impact.
* Communication of key findings and observations to the relevant stakeholders and business units to improve overall control efficiency and provide corrective actions to senior managers. Collaboration with other control professionals to resolve complex issues and ensure consistent testing methodologies across the bank.
* Development of a knowledge centre containing detailed documentation of control assessments, testing on design and operational effectiveness of procedures, findings, and the distribution of material on internal controls to train and upskill colleagues within the bank.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.description:

#R-00287384

  

**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------

In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.

**Job description**
-------------------

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.

Join us as a Gen AI Product Engineer

  
  

* In this key role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and scaling Generative AI (GenAI)-powered products and features that deliver tangible business value
* We’ll look to you to bridge product thinking and engineering execution, translating user needs into robust, production-ready AI solutions while driving innovation in the application of GenAI capabilities
* This is an opportunity to design and deliver production-grade GenAI solutions, including AI agents, conversational AI, and automation, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance
* We're offering this role at vice president level
  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

As a Gen AI Product Engineer, you'll design, build, and deploy production-grade GenAI products and systems that turn user and business needs into secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. You'll also translate product and user requirements into scalable technical solutions, balancing model quality, latency, system complexity, and long-term maintainability, while building and integrating large language model (LLM) capabilities using modern frameworks and application programming interfaces (APIs).

This will include working across orchestration layers, retrieval pipelines, system integrations, prompt and context engineering, and model evaluation.

  
  

You'll also be:

  
  

* Converting ambiguous product requirements and research concepts into robust technical architectures, balancing model capability, latency, cost, complexity, and maintainability
* Ensuring all GenAI solutions meet enterprise security, governance, responsible AI, and risk management standards, with appropriate controls, escalation, and mitigation built into delivery
* Developing and operating LLM solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, agent workflows, orchestration, prompt and content engineering, and model integration patterns
* Integrating GenAI capabilities into existing platforms through internal APIs, services, event flows, and data pipelines, ensuring resilience, observability, and maintainability in production environments
* Defining and applying approaches to model evaluation, benchmarking, monitoring, and continuous optimisation to improve quality, accuracy, reliability, and user outcomes
* Identifying and managing real-world AI system failure modes, including hallucinations, retrieval failures, tool-call errors, degraded model performance, and unsafe or non-compliant outputs
* Supporting production operations, including service monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and on-call responsibilities where required for business-critical GenAI systems
  

  

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------

  
  

We're looking for someone with proven experience designing, building, and operating production-grade GenAI software systems, with strong capabilities in Python, front-end design frameworks, distributed systems, API design, cloud-native engineering, observability, and performance-critical workloads. You should also bring experience translating ambiguous research concepts, emerging AI capabilities, user needs, and product requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable production systems within fast-moving product or research-led environments.

  

To succeed in this role, you'll need experience delivering GenAI or LLM-powered products beyond the prototype stage, including self-hosted model inference with frameworks such as vLLM, OpenAI-compatible serving patterns, orchestration layers, software development kit integration, and production systems. You must also bring a practical understanding of LLM application architecture, including prompt and context engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG pipelines, agent workflows, tool-calling patterns, memory and context management, and the mitigation of real-world AI system failure modes.

  
  

You'll also demonstrate:

  
  

* An understanding of model training, fine-tuning, adaptation, inference, and serving pipelines, including trade-offs in model selection, performance, cost, reliability, scalability, and operational complexity
* Experience evaluating, monitoring, and optimising AI systems, with working knowledge of responsible AI, model risk, security, governance, and operational controls in enterprise or regulated environments
* Hands-on experience deploying small language models for latency-, cost-, privacy-, or domain-specific use cases

Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.

For our business, for clients, and for you

**DevSecOps Engineer**

**CI/CD security integration, automation and operational support**

**Job Posting Title**

**DevSecOps Engineer**

**Department**

Information Security - Application Security

  

**Employment Type**

Permanent

  

**Management Level**

Assistant Vice President 1

  

**About Apex**

Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003, is a global financial services provider. With 50 offices worldwide and 12,000 employees upon the close of announced acquisitions, Apex delivers an extensive range of services to asset managers, capital markets, private clients and family offices.

The Group has continually improved and evolved its capabilities to offer a single-source solution through establishing the broadest range of services in the industry, including fund services, digital onboarding and bank accounts, depositary, custody and super ManCo services, business services including HR and Payroll, and a pioneering ESG Ratings and Advisory service for private companies.

We look to recruit bright, articulate and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge. We value people who work hard, care about what they do and are prepared to innovate.

Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today. As we grow, that contribution becomes even more important. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to help you thrive.

  

**About the Role**

We are looking for a DevSecOps Engineer to implement and operate security checks in Azure DevOps and related delivery workflows. You will help engineering teams receive timely, accurate feedback on code, dependencies, secrets, infrastructure and deployed applications while maintaining the reliability of the supporting automation.

The role combines pipeline engineering, troubleshooting, tool configuration, evidence automation and developer support. It is ideal for someone who enjoys making security controls usable and repeatable.

  

**Location:** Hyderabad, India. This is an office-based position and is not available as a remote role.

  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* Implement and maintain Azure DevOps YAML templates, pipeline tasks, scripts and configuration for approved security capabilities.

* Configure SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, container, DAST and API security checks at the pipeline stage defined by the control design.

* Onboard repositories and pipelines, verify prerequisites and permissions, test integrations and record coverage evidence.

* Troubleshoot scan failures, agent issues, network or authentication problems, API errors, timeouts and configuration drift.

* Normalise and route results to the correct application and owner; support deduplication, suppression review and ticket creation.

* Work with AppSec engineers to confirm which findings require manual triage, remediation tracking or validation.

* Collect baselines for report-only controls, analyse false positives and performance impact, and support pilots for risk-based blocking.

* Implement approved quality-gate rules and exception data; verify that bypasses are visible, authorised and time-bound.

* Maintain dashboards and evidence for tool health, adoption, coverage, scan outcomes, ageing findings and exceptions.

* Write clear onboarding guides, troubleshooting steps and FAQs; provide practical support to product engineering teams.

* Assist tool evaluations and proofs of concept by building integrations, running test suites and documenting detection and operational results.

* Apply version control, peer review, testing, secrets management and least privilege to security automation.

Identify repetitive manual work and propose safe automation or reusable templates.  

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

* Typically 2-5 years in DevOps, software engineering, cloud engineering or security engineering, with hands-on CI/CD experience.

* Practical knowledge of Azure DevOps repositories and YAML pipelines, or strong experience with a comparable platform and the ability to transfer quickly.

* Scripting ability in Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar, including use of REST APIs and structured data formats.

* Experience with at least two of code scanning, dependency scanning, secrets detection, IaC scanning, container scanning, DAST or API testing.

* Understanding of Git workflows, build artefacts, dependencies, environment variables, credentials and least-privilege access.

* Systematic troubleshooting skills and the ability to document a problem, evidence and resolution clearly.

* Collaborative communication with developers and security reviewers.

Fluent English, spoken and written.  

  

**Additional Practical Experience**

* Azure, Kubernetes, container registry or infrastructure-as-code experience.

* Experience creating dashboards or integrating findings with work-management or vulnerability-management systems.

* Familiarity with SBOMs, package ecosystems, licence risk or supply-chain security concepts.

* Practical experience delivering cloud, DevOps or security automation projects.

Experience in financial services or another regulated environment.  

  

**Candidate Expectations**

* Build automation that is readable, tested and supportable by others.

* Investigate the cause of control failures rather than normalising bypasses.

* Balance fast feedback with accurate results and predictable pipeline performance.

* Escalate potential production impact, privilege concerns or policy ambiguity early.

* Work collaboratively and consistently from the Hyderabad office.

Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a senior DevSecOps security engineer to design and lead scalable security controls across source, build, artefact and deployment workflows, with a strong focus on Azure DevOps. The role turns AppSec policy into reliable engineering guardrails that provide fast feedback and progressively prevent material risk.

You will own the technical integration and operating quality of security capabilities in CI/CD. You will partner with AppSec, platform and product engineering teams, but you will not take ownership of application or enterprise architecture decisions.

  

**Location:** Hyderabad, India. This is an office-based position and is not available as a remote role.

  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* Define and implement the DevSecOps control architecture for Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines, including reusable templates, service connections, permissions, policies, artefact handling and evidence capture.

* Integrate and operate SAST, SCA, secrets detection, IaC scanning, container scanning, DAST and API security testing at appropriate pipeline stages.

* Design a staged report-to-blocking rollout: baseline current exposure, tune results, define risk thresholds, pilot with representative teams, measure disruption, establish exception paths and expand safely.

* Create policy-as-code and quality-gate logic that accounts for severity, exploitability, asset criticality, reachability, fix availability, new-versus-existing debt and approved risk decisions.

* Build reliable result ingestion, deduplication, ownership routing, suppression governance and links back to source, build and deployment context.

* Partner with AppSec engineers to align pipeline rules with secure development requirements, review evidence and remediation validation.

* Engineer controls for pull requests, dependencies, secrets, build provenance, container images and infrastructure definitions without creating avoidable delivery bottlenecks.

* Monitor scanner availability, agent capacity, latency, licensing, coverage, false-positive rate and integration failures; define support procedures and service objectives.

* Design controlled bypass and exception mechanisms with expiry, approval, rationale, compensating controls and complete audit trails; do not allow silent bypasses.

* Automate dashboards and evidence for coverage, policy outcomes, blocked builds, ageing findings, exceptions and adoption while protecting sensitive finding data.

* Lead structured tool evaluations and proofs of concept covering detection efficacy, language and platform coverage, API quality, deployment model, usability, scalability, security and cost.

* Provide developer-facing documentation, reference pipelines, troubleshooting guides and enablement; use feedback to reduce friction without weakening risk controls.

* Collaborate with architecture and platform owners on design constraints and integration patterns without assuming their decision accountability.

Coach DevSecOps and AppSec engineers, review changes, and apply secure engineering practices to the security automation itself.  

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

* Typically 6+ years in DevOps, platform engineering, software engineering or security engineering, including substantial ownership of CI/CD security controls.

* Deep practical experience with Azure DevOps repos and pipelines, YAML templates, service connections, agents, permissions and branch or pull-request policies.

* Hands-on integration experience across several of SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, container, DAST and API security capabilities.

* Strong scripting or programming skills and experience building maintainable automation using APIs, version control, testing and peer review.

* Understanding of software supply-chain risk, dependency and licence risk, secrets handling, artefact integrity, container security and cloud infrastructure definitions.

* Experience tuning tools and designing risk-based gates that developers can understand and operations teams can support.

* Ability to diagnose pipeline failures across network, identity, agent, tool and configuration layers.

* Strong stakeholder communication and the ability to lead adoption across multiple engineering teams.

Fluent English, spoken and written.  

  

**Additional Practical Experience**

* Experience with Azure, Kubernetes, registries, signing or attestation, SBOMs and software supply-chain frameworks.

* Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform, Bicep, ARM, Helm or similar.

* Experience with commercial AppSec platforms, vulnerability-management integrations or enterprise developer portals.

* Hands-on experience operating Azure DevOps, cloud or Kubernetes security controls at enterprise scale.

Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-availability environment.  

  

**Candidate Expectations**

* Optimise for reliable controls and developer adoption, not tool deployment alone.

* Use data and pilots before introducing blocking changes that could disrupt delivery.

* Engineer explicit, expiring exception paths rather than informal workarounds.

* Treat security automation as production software with tests, monitoring, change control and support ownership.

* Lead hands-on from the Hyderabad office and build strong partnerships across global engineering teams.

**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!

Our people make all the difference in our success.

-

**About us:**

Analytics Information management (AIM) is a global community that is driving data driven transformation across Citi in multiple functions with the objective to create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. We are a fast-growing organization working with Citi businesses and functions across the world.

**What do we offer:**

FCDO team manages the implementation of best-in-class data quality measurement programs across globe in retail consumer bank. The critical areas we support:

* **Data Governance**: Standardization of data definitions and ensuring consistency in usage as per definitions across systems/products/regions.
* **Meta Data Management**: Leveraging data lineage, data discovery initiatives and creation of enterprise level meta data for all retail consumer products
* **Data Ownership**: Identifying trusted data sources, data owners and consumers across process and products
* **Issue Management**: Identifying defects and investigating root causes for different issues. Following up with stakeholders and creation of plan for resolution as per SLA
* **Audit Support**: Identifying cases on control gaps, policy breaches and providing data evidence for audit completion
* **Data Certification**: Developing procedures on data certification and certifying as per fit for purpose criteria

**Expertise Required:**

Data/Information Mgt Sr Analyst is responsible for ensuring the organization’s data is accurate, complete, consistent, and reliable to support strategic planning and operational efficiency. This role involves profiling data to identify flaws, authoring data quality rules to prevent issues, monitoring data pipelines, managing metadata and remediate data concerns. This person will also be responsible to design, develop, and deploy scalable AI-powered solutions that enhance enterprise workflows and decision-making. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering skills with hands-on experience in machine learning and generative AI systems, including LLM-based applications and AI agents.

**Metadata Management and Data Governance**

* **Maintain Data Catalog/Dictionary:** Document and maintain business, technical, and operational metadata, including data lineage, definitions, and data standards.
* **Data Lineage Mapping:** Utilize metadata to map data lineage, understanding how data flows from source systems to downstream reporting to identify potential impact areas.
* **Policy Compliance:** Ensure all data assets adhere to defined data governance policies and data privacy regulations.

**Data Profiling and Analysis**

* **Profiling Execution:** Perform deep profiling of large datasets to understand data structure, patterns, and content, identifying hidden anomalies or missing information.
* **Root Cause Analysis (RCA):** Investigate data quality issues to determine the root cause, distinguishing between upstream processing errors and data entry errors.
* **Data Assessment:** Evaluate critical data elements (CDEs) for accuracy and completeness.

**Data Quality Rule Creation and Authoring**

* **Rule Definition:** Collaborate with business stakeholders to define and validate business rules for data validation (e.g., completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity).
* **Rule Authoring/Implementation:** Develop and implement data quality rules, checks, and preventative/detective controls using SQL, Python, or specialized DQ tools.
* **Validation Logic:** Document validation logic and exception-handling procedures for critical datasets.

**Data Monitoring and Reporting**

* **Continuous Monitoring:** Actively monitor data pipelines, ETL processes, and dashboards to proactively identify DQ issues and operational anomalies.
* **DQ Dashboards/Scorecards:** Develop and maintain data quality metrics and scorecards to report on data accuracy trends to leadership.
* **Alerting:** Set up automated alerts for breach of data quality thresholds.

**Data Concern Remediations**

* **Issue Resolution:** Identify, document, and triage data quality issues through a tracking system.
* **Remediation Action Plans:** Develop and execute remediation plans, including data cleansing efforts and automated corrections.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with data stewards, IT, and developers to resolve data issues and implement long-term solutions.

* Proficient in Python, SAS, SQL, Teradata, Collibra
* Experience with prompt engineering
* Experience building LLM-based applications, AI agents, or autonomous workflows
* Exposure to LangChain / LangGraph frameworks
* Exposure to creating multi-agent orchestration
* Exposure to BI tools and technologies – example: Tableau

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The role of Director Strategy and Chief of Staff would be a leadership role at Medtronic Engineering Innovation Center (MEIC) reporting to VP, MEIC. The individual would be accountable for strategic planning and site level operations working closely with various functions at the center to ensure smooth streamlined outcomes. The role would involve driving governance and review for VP creating more comprehensive strategic utilisation and optimisation of site capabilities and impact.
  
  
The individual would also be responsible for special projects/ engagements as assigned by the VP MEIC and on his behalf as applicable for relationship with government and confederation of Industry in close partnership with Finance leadership at Site. The individual would partner closely with communications leader at MEIC for Site for matters related to both internal and external communications by VP MEIC.

The role of **Director Strategy and Chief of Staff** to VP MEIC would strengthen strategy, governance, prioritization, and alignment across the site in partnerships with the OUs and enterprise functions. In addition, the role will evolve to be accountable for external eco-system partnerships.

  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties as may be assigned and would work closely with the Vice President MEIC**

* Collaborate with the leadership of VP MIEC on initiatives / strategic discussions
* Ensure readiness for VP meetings at Site level; viz, MEIC QBR , Quarterly MEIC Board of Advisors Meeting and all meeting where VP would be presenting representing the Site for internal medtronic or for external partnerships / forums

Be part of planning, execution of all infrastructure needs in collaboration with MEIC LT and finance  

  

The ideal candidate is one who had past experience in leading cross functional team, PMO and exposure/ experience in CoS / Strategy role. The individual should be a critical thinker who should be able to collaborate across the disciplines. The individual must be able build strong relationships across the matrix. The individual must be a thought and a strategic leader; a self-starter and should be able to strongly influence and provide inputs and have the capability to improve the existing processes and systems using significant conceptualizing, reasoning, interpretation and AI.

jobs.description:
**Principal Investor Relations Officer**

**Job #:**

req39473

  

**Organization:**

IFC

GH

Open-Ended Staff (OPEN-OP)

International Recruitment

**Required Language(s):**

English

  

**Preferred Language(s):**

Relevant local language required (French, Spanish, German, Cantonese/Mandarin, Japanese, Portuguese, Hindi)

  

**Closing Date:**

11/30/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree or MBA, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience of increasing complexity and responsibility in institutional investor relations, capital markets, private markets, asset management, investment banking, or related areas.
* Extensive experience developing and managing senior-level relationships with institutiona

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About
**Bright Money**

Bright Money
is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi’s Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India.

**What is the role about?**

Bright is looking for a Director - Engineering to lead and scale a core part of our engineering organisation in Bengaluru, reporting to the CTO. You will own delivery and technical direction for the systems behind Bright’s consumer app, credit decisioning, and AI products, and you will build the leadership layer that runs them.

This is a leader-of-leaders role. You will manage engineering managers and leads, shape architecture and platform strategy for your area within the CTO’s technical direction, own headcount, budget, and cloud spend for your teams, and partner with Product, Data Sciences, and the wider leadership team on what gets built next.

Bright is profitable, scaling fast in the U.S. market, and building AI into both the product and how the company runs. The systems are distributed, data-heavy, and carry real money and credit decisions, so engineering quality is a business outcome here, not an internal metric.

**What will you do?**

* Lead your organisation: Own and scale a multi-team group, with engineering managers and leads reporting to you; set the operating rhythm, standards, and performance bar across your teams.
* Build the leadership layer: Hire, coach, and retain senior engineers, leads, and managers, and develop the next line of engineering leadership beneath you.
* Technical strategy: Shape and execute architecture and platform strategy across services, data, and developer tooling for your area, in line with the CTO’s technical direction, and make the build-versus-buy and platformisation calls that shape how fast your teams can ship.
* Delivery at scale: Own end-to-end delivery of distributed, data-heavy systems - roadmap commitments, release predictability, and the trade-offs between speed and durability.
* Reliability & risk: Own availability, performance, security, and the engineering side of compliance obligations for the systems your teams run in a U.S. consumer-lending business.
* AI & ML in production: Partner with Data Sciences to productionise ML and Gen AI systems-serving, monitoring, and retraining - and raise engineering leverage through AI tooling across the org.
* Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Data Sciences, Infrastructure, and business teams on priorities, sequencing, and the commitments engineering makes to them.
* Planning & budget: Own annual and quarterly planning for your area - headcount, vendor decisions, cloud cost and TCO, and the resourcing choices behind them.
* Reporting & visibility: Report clearly to the CTO and the wider leadership team on progress, risk, capacity, and investment, and contribute to leadership reviews as needed.

**Ideal candidate profile**

**Experience & Background:**

* Experience: 12+ years in engineering, with 5+ years in engineering leadership and at least 2 years managing managers or leads.
* Organisation scale: Has led a multi-team group of 20+ engineers, and has grown a team through a period of rapid scaling.
* Systems depth: Deep hands-on background in distributed, high-throughput, data-heavy systems; still able to go deep in a design review and hold a credible technical argument.
* Architecture & platform: Proven ownership of architecture, platformisation, and developer tooling, with evidence of the delivery gains those investments produced.
* ML & AI in production: Experience productionising ML or Gen AI systems in partnership with data science teams.
* Commercial ownership: Experience owning engineering budgets, cloud cost and TCO, vendor decisions, and resource planning.
* Hiring record: A strong track record of hiring and developing senior engineers and engineering managers.
* Domain: Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or another regulated, high-reliability consumer business is a strong plus.
* Location: Based in Bengaluru, or willing to relocate.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Ownership: Takes accountability for outcomes beyond their own remit, not only for their teams’ deliverables.
* Technical credibility: Earns the respect of senior engineers through judgment and depth, not position.
* Strategic thinking: Connects technical choices to business outcomes and can defend the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.
* Builder of leaders: Measures success by the strength of the managers and engineers they develop.
* Pace: Thrives in a high-growth environment where structure is still being built, and brings clarity rather than waiting for it.

**Non-Fit Profiles**

* Individual contributors or architects without sustained people-leadership experience.
* Managers who have led a single team, without experience managing managers or leading a group through scale.
* Leaders who have moved fully away from technical depth and cannot hold their own in architecture and design discussions.
* Candidates from large, process-heavy environments who need established structure, and are uncomfortable in a fast-moving, ambiguous setting.
* Delivery or programme managers without hands-on engineering ownership.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale - liquidity potential at $1-3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You own delivery and technical direction for a core part of the platform, with a direct line to the CTO.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Benefits: Excellent benefits package in line with sector best practice.

jobs.description:
**Head of Marketing / Head of Growth**

**AppsForBharat | Bengaluru | 10+ Years Experience**

**About AppsForBharat**

At
**AppsForBharat**
, we are building Sri Mandir, a leading devotional and spiritual platform that helps millions of devotees connect with their faith through technology.

Our ecosystem brings together three businesses:

* **Sri Mandir:**
  An app and website offering Puja, Chadhava, Seva, devotional content, music and temple information.
* **Sri Mandir Store:**
  An online store offering spiritual products such as Rudraksha, gemstones, bracelets, idols and more.
* **Kundli Guide by Sri Mandir:**
  A platform offering personalised astrology reports and expert consultations.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a
**Head of Marketing / Head of Growth**
who can build and lead the overall growth strategy across these businesses.

**The Role**

We are looking for a business-focused marketing leader who knows how to acquire customers, drive revenue and build long-term customer engagement.

This is not just a traditional marketing or brand-building role. You will be responsible for driving business growth by bringing together performance marketing, product, customer acquisition, content and retention.

You will work closely with the Product and Business teams to make Sri Mandir an app first platform, acquire more users, improve their experience and encourage them to engage with and purchase multiple services across our ecosystem.

**What You Will Do**

**1. Own Overall Marketing and Business Growth**

* Build and lead the overall marketing and growth strategy across Sri Mandir, Sri Mandir Store and Kundli Guide.
* Drive growth in new users, customer acquisition, transactions and overall revenue.
* Identify new opportunities to expand our user base and reach new customer segments.
* Take ownership of key business metrics such as customer acquisition cost, marketing returns, revenue and customer lifetime value.

**2. Build an App-First Growth Strategy**

* Make mobile apps a primary channel for customer acquisition, engagement and transactions across business categories.
* Develop strategies to increase app downloads, registrations, active users and purchases.
* Work closely with Product teams to improve app onboarding, user journeys and purchase experience.
* Identify opportunities to introduce users to multiple services within the Sri Mandir ecosystem.

**3. Drive Performance Marketing and Customer Acquisition**

* Lead performance marketing across platforms such as Google, Meta and other relevant digital channels.
* Build scalable customer acquisition strategies while maintaining efficient marketing spends.
* Continuously experiment with campaigns, audiences, creatives and channels to improve results.
* Build a strong understanding of what drives conversions and revenue, beyond just app installs or website traffic.

**4. Drive Customer Retention and Repeat Purchases**

* Develop strategies to bring existing users back to the platform and encourage repeat transactions.
* Build strong CRM and lifecycle marketing capabilities through push notifications, WhatsApp, email and other channels.
* Use customer insights and behaviour to create relevant and personalised communication.
* Work towards improving customer retention, repeat purchase rates and lifetime value.

**5. Build Content-Led Growth**

* Use content as a strong driver of customer acquisition, engagement and retention.
* Identify opportunities to leverage devotional, spiritual and astrology-related content to attract and engage users.
* Build content strategies that contribute to business growth and platform engagement, beyond just brand awareness.

**6. Build and Lead the Marketing Team**

* Build a strong marketing organisation across performance marketing, growth, CRM, content and other relevant functions.
* Develop a culture of experimentation, accountability and data-driven decision-making.
* Work closely with Business, Product, Design, Analytics and Technology teams to drive overall company growth.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 10+ years of experience in marketing, growth or performance marketing, preferably in consumer internet, technology, e-commerce, D2C or mobile-first businesses.
* Strong experience in scaling customer acquisition and driving measurable business growth through performance marketing.
* Experience in growing a mobile app, with a strong understanding of app downloads, user activation, engagement, conversion and retention.
* Experience working closely with Product teams to improve customer journeys, app experience and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of performance marketing platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads and other digital acquisition channels.
* Experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, customer retention and repeat purchase strategies.
* Ability to use data and customer insights to identify growth opportunities and make business decisions.
* Experience in building and leading high-performing marketing teams.
* Understanding of content as a tool for customer acquisition and engagement.

**Who May Not Be a Good Fit**

* Candidates whose experience is primarily in traditional brand marketing, PR or communications.
* Professionals whose work has largely focused on large-scale brand campaigns and awareness initiatives.
* Candidates with only campaign execution or paid advertising experience, without ownership of business growth metrics.
* Candidates with no experience in mobile app growth or working with Product teams.

**Why Join AppsForBharat?**

This is an opportunity to build the growth engine for a large and evolving consumer platform. You will have the opportunity to shape how millions of users discover, experience and engage with devotional and spiritual services through technology.

You will own a significant business mandate, work closely with leadership and build a marketing organisation that directly contributes to the company's growth.
