jobs.title: Customer Service Executive – Customer Support & Loan Servicing
jobs.description:
**Company:** Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited  
**Department:** Customer Service & Operations  
**Designation:** Customer Service Executive  
**Location:** Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Office-based  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Reporting To:** Customer Service Manager / Head of Operations  
**Salary:** As per experience and suitability (Fixed + Performance Incentive)

1. About Loan2grow Fincap

Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited is a growing lending and financial services company focused on providing responsible, accessible and technology-enabled credit solutions to underserved customer segments.

The company offers financing solutions across multiple customer categories and is expanding its digital lending and financial services operations.

At Loan2grow, we believe that a good customer experience is central to responsible lending. We aim to make financial services accessible, transparent and convenient through technology-enabled platforms and responsive customer support.

2. About the Role

We are looking for customer-oriented and proactive professionals to join our Customer Service & Operations team as Customer Service Executives.

The selected candidates will be responsible for handling customer queries, providing assistance throughout the loan application and servicing journey, resolving customer complaints and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.

The role will involve handling inbound and outbound customer calls, responding to service requests, guiding customers through digital processes and maintaining accurate records of customer interactions.

The Customer Service Executive will serve as an important point of contact between the company and its customers, ensuring that customer concerns are addressed professionally, efficiently and within defined timelines.

This is a full-time, office-based role involving regular telephone-based customer interaction and coordination with internal departments.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Customer Support & Query Management

* Handle inbound and outbound customer calls relating to loan products and financial services.
* Respond to customer queries regarding loan features, eligibility, application procedures and documentation requirements.
* Provide information on loan application status, approval, disbursement and repayment schedules.
* Assist customers in understanding their loan accounts, outstanding balances, EMI obligations and payment timelines.
* Provide accurate information regarding applicable interest rates, processing fees, charges and other loan-related terms.
* Ensure that customer queries are addressed in a professional, courteous and timely manner.
* Escalate complex queries to the appropriate internal teams.

B. Loan Application & Customer Onboarding Support

* Assist prospective customers with the digital loan application process.
* Guide customers through KYC verification, documentation and other onboarding requirements.
* Help customers resolve issues related to application submission, document uploads and verification.
* Follow up on incomplete applications and pending documentation.
* Coordinate with Credit and Operations teams to track application progress.
* Keep customers informed about application status and pending requirements.
* Assist customers in navigating the company's digital platforms and applications.

C. Loan Servicing & Repayment Support

* Handle customer queries relating to loan disbursement, repayment schedules and EMI deductions.
* Assist customers with repayment-related issues, including failed transactions, incorrect deductions and payment confirmation.
* Guide customers on approved repayment channels and payment procedures.
* Coordinate with Finance and Collections teams to resolve payment reconciliation issues.
* Support customers in obtaining loan statements, repayment schedules and other account-related information.
* Track and follow up on unresolved loan servicing requests.
* Ensure that customer concerns relating to loan servicing are addressed within defined timelines.

D. Customer Complaint & Grievance Resolution

* Receive, register and track customer complaints and service requests.
* Understand the nature of customer grievances and identify the appropriate resolution mechanism.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve complaints.
* Follow up on pending complaints until closure.
* Maintain accurate records of complaints, actions taken and resolution timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or sensitive customer grievances to the reporting manager.
* Ensure that customer complaints are handled in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Customer Relationship & Communication

* Maintain professional and positive relationships with customers.
* Communicate loan-related information in simple, clear and understandable language.
* Proactively contact customers regarding pending documentation, application updates and service requests.
* Provide appropriate guidance to customers throughout their loan journey.
* Handle dissatisfied customers and difficult conversations with patience and professionalism.
* Ensure transparency in all customer communications.
* Never make unauthorised commitments regarding loan approvals, interest waivers, settlements or changes in repayment terms.

F. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with Sales and Business Development teams for customer acquisition and onboarding-related queries.
* Work with Credit teams to obtain updates on loan applications and pending verifications.
* Coordinate with Operations for documentation, disbursement and loan servicing issues.
* Work with Collections teams on repayment-related customer queries and payment confirmation.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment reconciliation and account-related discrepancies.
* Ensure timely communication and closure of customer requests across departments.

G. Customer Service MIS & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of customer calls, queries, complaints and service requests.
* Update customer interactions and service request status in the CRM or designated systems.
* Maintain daily customer service reports covering:
* Total inbound and outbound calls.
* Customer queries received.
* Customer requests registered.
* Complaints received and resolved.
* Pending service requests.
* Average query resolution time.
* Escalated complaints.
* Customer follow-up status.
* Share daily and weekly performance updates with the reporting manager.
* Identify recurring customer issues and highlight opportunities to improve service delivery.

4. Qualifications & Experience

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in customer service, customer support, telecalling, contact centres or customer relationship management.
* Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and basic English.
* Comfortable handling inbound and outbound customer calls.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and customer management systems.
* Ability to handle multiple customer queries and service requests simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience in banking, NBFCs, fintech, digital lending, microfinance or other financial services organisations.
* Experience handling loan-related customer queries and servicing requests.
* Familiarity with loan application processes, KYC documentation and digital onboarding.
* Experience resolving EMI, repayment and payment-related queries.
* Experience working with CRM, LOS or LMS platforms.
* Exposure to complaint management and customer grievance resolution.

5. Key Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication and listening skills.
* Customer relationship management.
* Problem-solving and query resolution.
* Professional telephone etiquette.
* Patience and empathy in customer interactions.
* Ability to handle difficult customer conversations.
* Follow-up and service

jobs.title: Sales & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Company:**

DigieSign is a Bengaluru-based legal-tech and fintech company building a connected suite of products that help lenders digitise the full lifecycle of a loan — from signing the agreement to recovering dues and resolving disputes. Our customers are NBFCs, banks and financial institutions across India.

Our product suite:

* DigieSign – Aadhaar and DSC-based eSignatures and digital document execution for loan agreements, sanction letters and other lending documents.
* Serve – End-to-end legal notice dispatch: multilingual notice generation, digital delivery (email, SMS, WhatsApp) and physical dispatch via India Post, with tracking and court-ready delivery reports.
* Collect – Collections automation that helps lenders reach delinquent borrowers at scale and improve recovery rates.
* Resolve – Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for faster, cheaper resolution of lending disputes through arbitration, conciliation and mediation. We already work with leading NBFCs, and we are now building city-level teams to grow faster. Bengaluru is our home city and the first of these hubs.

**Role Overview**

As City Manager – Sales & Operations, Bengaluru, you will own our business in the city end to end. You will bring in new NBFC and bank customers, and you will make sure that every customer we sign is onboarded smoothly, served well and keeps growing with us. You will run the city like a business unit: pipeline, revenue, delivery quality and client satisfaction are all yours.

This role suits someone who enjoys being in front of credit, legal and collections leaders at lending institutions, and who also likes making operations run cleanly behind the scenes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Sales & Business Development (approx. 60%)**

•Find, prospect and acquire new NBFCs, banks (private, small finance, cooperative), HFCs and MFIs headquartered or with major operations in Bengaluru and Karnataka.

•Build and manage a healthy pipeline: research target accounts, map decision-makers (Heads of Collections, Legal, Credit Operations, Risk, IT/Digital) and run multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

* Run product demos and discovery meetings, and position the full suite: DigieSign, Serve, Collect and Resolve.

* Build proposals, commercial quotes and pricing in line with company guidelines; negotiate and close agreements.

* Handle procurement processes, vendor empanelment, RFPs, information security questionnaires and legal/compliance reviews at client institutions.

* Cross-sell and upsell across the suite to existing accounts (for example, moving a Serve customer onto Collect or Resolve).

* Meet monthly and quarterly targets for new logos, revenue and pipeline.

* Keep the CRM up to date and share accurate forecasts with leadership.

* Represent DigieSign at BFSI industry events, NBFC forums and legal-tech meetups in the city.

**B. City Operations & Client Delivery (approx. 40%)**

* Own client onboarding for the city: account setup, user training, template configuration, data upload formats and go-live.

* Oversee day-to-day delivery for Bengaluru clients, including legal notice dispatch batches, India Post coordination, eSign volumes and ODR case flows, so that SLAs and turnaround times are met.

* Coordinate with internal product, tech, legal and support teams to resolve client issues and escalations quickly.

* Make sure clients receive timely MIS and delivery reports, and review account health with them regularly (monthly reviews and QBRs).

* Track usage, wallet/billing status and collections on invoices for city accounts, and follow up on receivables.

* Manage local vendors and partners (printing, dispatch, courier and field partners) where needed.

* Capture client feedback and feature requests and pass them to the product team in a structured way.

* As the city grows, hire, train and lead a small team of sales and operations executives.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* New NBFC and bank customers signed per quarter

* Revenue and pipeline value against target

* Time from signature to go-live for new clients

* SLA adherence for notice dispatch, eSign and ODR delivery

* Client retention, expansion revenue and cross-sell across products

* Receivables collected on time

**Requirements Must have**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA preferred.

* 3–6 years of experience in B2B / enterprise sales, account management or operations in BFSI, fintech, legal-tech or SaaS.

* A proven record of selling to NBFCs and/or banks, with an existing network among collections, legal, credit or operations leaders.

* Understanding of the lending lifecycle in India — loan origination, documentation, collections, NPA recovery and legal/recovery processes (SARFAESI, Section 138 NI Act, arbitration).

* Comfort managing operational processes, SLAs and client escalations.

* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills in English; Kannada and/or Hindi strongly preferred.

* Comfortable with CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets and preparing MIS reports.

* Willing to travel within Bengaluru and Karnataka for client meetings. Good to have

* Experience selling eSign, eStamp, legal notice, collections or ODR solutions.

* Exposure to RBI digital lending guidelines and outsourcing norms for regulated entities.

* Experience setting up or scaling a city or regional business from an early stage.

* Experience hiring and leading a small team.

**What We Offer**

* A chance to build and own a city business at an early-stage, fast-growing legal-tech company.

* Direct work with the founding team and real influence on product and go-to-market.

* Competitive fixed pay plus a performance-linked incentive plan.

* A clear growth path to Regional / Zonal Head as we expand to more cities.

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹110,000.00 per month

### **About Appwork IT Solutions**

Appwork IT Solutions is a technology-driven company focused on building innovative software solutions that help businesses streamline operations, improve customer engagement, and accelerate digital transformation.

We are looking for a driven and strategically minded Enterprise Sales Development Representative / Manager to spearhead outbound sales development for our AI-powered solutions, with a primary focus on the BFSI, NBFC, banking, and fintech sectors.

### **Role Overview**

The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, researching, and engaging potential enterprise clients, building a strong sales pipeline, and generating qualified business opportunities through strategic outbound outreach.

This role requires someone who understands enterprise B2B sales cycles and can confidently engage with senior-level decision-makers, including Founders, CEOs, CXOs, Business Heads, Operations Heads, and Technology Leaders across BFSI and NBFC organizations.

You will work closely with the leadership team, participate in strategic sales conversations, and play a key role in converting target accounts into meaningful business opportunities.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Enterprise Prospecting:** Identify and research high-potential enterprise accounts, particularly NBFCs, banks, lending institutions, and fintech companies.
* **LinkedIn Outreach:** Leverage LinkedIn and Sales Navigator to identify key decision-makers, build targeted prospect lists, and initiate personalized conversations.
* **Outbound Lead Generation:** Execute structured outbound campaigns through LinkedIn, cold emails, cold calling, and other relevant channels.
* **Decision-Maker Engagement:** Establish connections with senior stakeholders, including Founders, CEOs, CXOs, Business Heads, and Department Heads.
* **Appointment Setting:** Generate qualified meetings and product demonstrations with relevant enterprise prospects.
* **Account-Based Prospecting:** Develop account-specific outreach strategies instead of relying solely on bulk lead generation or generic sales campaigns.
* **Lead Qualification:** Understand prospect requirements, business challenges, buying intent, and potential use cases to qualify opportunities effectively.
* **Sales Collaboration:** Work directly with the founders and senior leadership team during initial prospect meetings, product demonstrations, and business discussions.
* **Pipeline Management:** Maintain accurate prospect databases, outreach records, follow-ups, and opportunity tracking through CRM tools.
* **Market Intelligence:** Research industry trends, competitor offerings, target accounts, and potential business opportunities within the BFSI and fintech ecosystem.
* **Revenue Contribution:** Build a consistent pipeline of qualified enterprise opportunities and contribute towards the company's overall business development goals.

### **Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in B2B Sales Development, Enterprise Sales, Business Development, or Outbound Sales.
* Prior experience selling or prospecting SaaS products, software solutions, fintech solutions, or technology services.
* Strong understanding of the BFSI, NBFC, banking, lending, or fintech ecosystem.
* Hands-on experience with LinkedIn prospecting and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
* Proven ability to identify and engage senior-level decision-makers in enterprise organizations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, relationship-building, and presentation skills.
* Experience with cold outreach, lead qualification, appointment setting, and enterprise pipeline development.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms, sales automation tools, and lead research tools.
* Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

### **What Makes This Opportunity Different?**

* Work directly with the founders and leadership team rather than operating in a large, script-driven SDR setup.
* Own strategic prospecting initiatives targeting a focused list of enterprise accounts.
* Get exposure to AI-powered solutions and real-world enterprise use cases.
* Participate in actual enterprise sales conversations and product demonstrations.
* Opportunity to grow into an Enterprise Account Executive / Enterprise Sales Manager role as the business scales.

### **Preferred Candidate Profile**

Candidates with experience in enterprise SaaS, fintech, NBFC technology, lending technology, KYC solutions, collections technology, conversational AI, or customer experience platforms will be preferred.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* The Executive Director – Global Head, Margin and Collateral Operations is accountable for the global end-to-end delivery, control and transformation of the Bank’s uncleared margin and collateral franchise across non-centrally cleared derivatives, repo, securities borrowing and lending, structured financing, commodities, precious metals and other collateralised businesses.
* The role owns Initial Margin, Variation Margin, Independent Amount, portfolio reconciliation, dispute management, collateral allocation, settlement, interest, static data, reconciliations, reporting and exception management across the full lifecycle—from legal-agreement and counterparty onboarding through daily exposure calculation, margin exchange and collateral return.
* The role ensures compliance with applicable uncleared margin, segregation, portfolio-reconciliation, dispute-reporting, client-asset, liquidity and books-and-records obligations across all relevant jurisdictions and legal entities, and is accountable for timely, evidenced delivery of regulatory, audit, assurance and risk-remediation commitments.
* The role leads the global target operating model, people strategy and investment roadmap to deliver upcoming global and local margin regulations, maintain compliance with existing requirements through adequate preventive and detective controls, and resolve conflicts between global standards and local regulatory, legal-entity, currency, custody and settlement obligations. The role is accountable for evolving MARS into the Bank’s strategic straight-through and zero-touch collateral management solution, enabling artificial intelligence and effective integration with industry utilities and vendors, including TriOptima and AcadiaSoft, while supporting digital-currency margining, Prime Crypto and other new-business requirements across Asia and the wider Bank.

Strategy
  
  

* Define and execute the global strategy for uncleared Margin and Collateral Operations, aligned with Global Markets Operations, business growth, counterparty credit-risk mitigation, liquidity objectives and risk appetite.
* Own the forward regulatory roadmap for global and local margin reforms, translating emerging rules into coordinated legal, client, model, process, technology, custody, settlement, finance and control deliverables while sustaining compliance with existing regulations.
* Establish a scalable target operating model with global process ownership, follow-the-sun delivery, resilient location strategy, clear service segmentation and effective capacity planning.
* Set the strategic direction for MARS as the Bank’s authoritative collateral management platform, delivering end-to-end straight-through processing and zero-touch processing across calculation, margin exchange, allocation, settlement, reconciliation, reporting and exception management.
* Own the multi-year transformation and investment roadmap for standardisation, artificial intelligence, real-time settlement transparency, collateral optimisation, common data, strategic platform integration and controlled decommissioning of legacy processes and systems without service or control degradation.
* Establish strategic partnerships and interoperable solutions with global vendors and industry utilities, including TriOptima and AcadiaSoft, to increase automation, strengthen portfolio reconciliation and dispute management, and support exception-led operations.
* Set measurable outcomes covering regulatory compliance, margin timeliness, settlement success, disputes, reconciliations, risk reduction, productivity, resilience, client service, collateral utilisation, funding efficiency and financial-data accuracy.
* Anticipate regulatory, market, product and infrastructure developments and ensure the operating model remains controlled, scalable and fit for global flow business and complex local or bespoke requirements.

Business
  
  

* Act as the senior global Operations owner for uncleared margin and collateral services, maintaining effective service across products, legal entities, regions and client segments.
* Partner with Trading, XVA, Treasury, Repo, Prime, Product, Sales and Client Coverage to enable new clients, products, markets and bespoke structures with transparent operational readiness, risk assessment, approvals, capacity and controls.
* Lead the operational enablement of digital-currency margining, Prime Crypto, crypto spot, crypto derivatives and other emerging business propositions, ensuring appropriate agreement structures, segregated or cross-service margin treatment, settlement, custody, valuation, reconciliation, reporting and risk controls.
* Support the Bank’s growth across diverse Asian markets by delivering scalable solutions for local currencies, local custodians, domestic settlement infrastructure, country-specific collateral rules and bespoke regulatory margin requirements.
* Protect the Bank from counterparty credit, liquidity, market, conduct, operational, regulatory and reputational impacts arising from ineffective margining, collateralisation, disputes or settlement.
* Maximise utilisation of the Bank’s collateral inventory through eligibility, concentration, substitutions, intragroup margining, cross-product opportunities and cheapest-to-deliver allocation, while ensuring optimal funding, liquidity, legal-entity and regulatory outcomes.
* Represent Margin and Collateral Operations in senior business, client, risk, governance, audit and investment forums, providing clear decisions and escalation on material matters.

**Processes**

* Own the global control and service framework for agreement onboarding and static data; trade and valuation feeds; IM, VM and Independent Amount calculation; SIMM; margin issuance and response; dispute investigation; collateral selection and movement; interest; substitutions; returns; reconciliations; and reporting.
* Ensure margin calls and collateral movements are complete, accurate, timely and consistent with legal terms, credit requirements, settlement instructions, eligibility schedules, thresholds, minimum transfer amounts, haircuts and concentration limits.
* Deliver change for new and amended global margin regulations and local addenda, including impact assessment, requirements interpretation, controls, documentation, client repapering, model approval, custody and settlement readiness, testing, training, implementation and post-go-live assurance.
* Design and operate a defensible framework for conflicting global and local requirements, with documented rule hierarchy, legal and compliance interpretation, country-specific configurations, approvals, traceability and evidence that each applicable obligation is met.
* Enhance MARS and its upstream and downstream interfaces to enable STP and ZTP processing, AI-supported ingestion and exception analysis, real-time connectivity with TriOptima and AcadiaSoft where appropriate, and controlled handling of clients or markets that cannot use industry utilities.
* Provide real-time or near-real-time settlement status for cash and securities, with end-to-end acknowledgement, fail management, aged-item escalation and reconciled views across MARS, settlement platforms, custodians, triparty agents, nostro and ledger records.
* Ensure complete, accurate and timely feeds of collateral positions, valuations, movements, interest, encumbrance and accounting attributes to Finance, Aspire and other downstream liquidity, ledger, regulatory and management-reporting systems, supported by controls and reconciliations.
* Maintain a robust portfolio-reconciliation and dispute-management model with risk-based prioritisation, ageing, escalation, regulatory reporting and accountable root-cause remediation.

Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.

**Job Description**
As Investor Services India Lead you lead Investor Services in India. You build the team, bring each specialist team live with the right controls in place, and run India to our global service levels as part of one team across India, Europe, Asia and the US.
  
  
You are the senior Investor Services voice in India and a partner to Investor Services leaders in other locations, Compliance and our transformation programme.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Leading Investor Services India**

* Own performance of every India specialist team against our service levels, quality measures and capacity targets, and report monthly.
* Plan capacity and growth with the Regional Head and partner hubs, including cover when other hubs are stretched.

**Building and launching**

* Recruit, onboard and assess the India team.
* Bring each specialist team live once the systems, routing and reporting it needs are in place.
* Run interim arrangements and parallel running until then; nothing is switched off before its replacement works.

**Controls and risk**

* Run India to a high-risk control standard: separation of duties, independent quality checks in another hub, documented sign-off and a complete audit trail.
* Own business continuity for India: take over live cases within 24 hours when needed, and test it twice a year.
* Lead India's part in audits and regulatory reviews, and close findings on time.

**Working as one global team**

* Run handovers with hubs in Europe and Asia so cases keep moving around the clock.
* Route work between hubs so every team member can build the experience they need.
* Make sure escalations follow the right compliance route for each country.

**People and culture**

* Lead the India team and build a culture of quality, ownership and growth.
* Own engagement, retention and succession for Investor Services India.

**Transformation**

* Represent India in the design of our end-to-end KYC process, the Fenergo roadmap and the wider Investor Services programme.
* Drive improvements that remove manual handoffs and shorten the time investors wait.

**How You Grow**
Our people build their careers by moving through ten KYC specialisms every 6–12 months, each ending with a skills assessment and a certification. Progression is by competency, not tenure, and experienced hires are assessed on joining and start at the level they have earned.
  
  
The role is a platform for wider regional or global Investor Services leadership.
  
  
**What You Bring**
Your CV needs to show at least 10 years in KYC, AML or CDD operations, including 5 or more years leading multi-team operations; applications without this won't be taken forward.
  
  

* 10+ years in KYC, AML or CDD operations, including 5+ years leading multi-team operations in financial services.
* Experience building and scaling a team in India for global stakeholders.
* A strong control mindset: audits, regulatory reviews and operational risk.
* Data-driven management of service levels, quality and capacity.
* Excellent senior stakeholder management across Europe, Asia and the US.

**Nice To Have**

* Fund administration, transfer agency or private markets experience.
* Experience of technology-led operations change, ideally with Fenergo.

JOB DESCRIPTION Zoho Books Accountant K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons Kasaragod, Kerala Position: Zoho Books Accountant Department: Accounts & Finance Location: Kasaragod, Kerala Employment Type: Full-time Reporting To: Management / Accounts Head 1. About the Company K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons is an established cashew processing and trading company with a legacy dating back to 1945. The company is engaged in cashew kernel processing, domestic and international trading, procurement of raw cashew nuts and sale of cashew by-products. We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible accountant with practical experience in Zoho Books and GST compliance to manage our accounting operations. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Zoho Books Management - Maintain complete and accurate accounting records in Zoho Books. - Record daily sales, purchases, receipts, payments and journal entries. - Maintain customer and supplier ledgers. - Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable. - Ensure timely and accurate accounting entries. - Maintain proper documentation of all financial transactions. B. GST & Statutory Compliance - Prepare and verify GST sales and purchase data. - Coordinate preparation and filing of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B. - Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records. - Verify GST input tax credit eligibility. - Coordinate with external auditors and tax consultants. - Maintain TDS records and assist with statutory compliance. C. Banking & Financial Transactions - Perform bank reconciliations regularly. - Monitor customer collections and supplier payments. - Maintain cash and bank books. - Prepare payment schedules. - Track outstanding receivables and payables. D. Inventory & Stock Accounting - Maintain inventory records in Zoho. - Monitor raw cashew nut purchases and stock. - Track cashew kernel grades and quantities. - Maintain stock records of finished goods, packing materials and by-products. - Reconcile physical stock with accounting records. - Coordinate with factory and stores personnel for stock verification. E. Sales & Purchase Accounting - Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices and debit/credit notes. - Ensure correct GST rates, HSN codes and tax classifications. - Track customer outstanding balances. - Monitor supplier balances and payment due dates. - Maintain proper records of domestic and export transactions. F. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare periodic reports for management, including: - Daily sales and purchase reports. - Customer outstanding and ageing reports. - Supplier outstanding reports. - Stock and inventory reports. - Monthly Profit & Loss statement. - Cash flow and fund position. - Expense analysis. - Product-wise and business-wise profitability reports, wherever data is available. 3. Required Qualifications & Experience - B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification. - 2–5 years of accounting experience. - Hands-on experience in Zoho Books is essential. - Good knowledge of GST and Indian accounting practices. - Experience with inventory accounting. - Knowledge of Excel and spreadsheets. - Experience in manufacturing, processing or trading businesses will be an advantage. 4. Skills & Competencies - Strong accounting fundamentals. - High accuracy and attention to detail. - Good analytical and reconciliation skills. - Ability to independently manage daily accounting operations. - Good communication and coordination skills. - Integrity, confidentiality and accountability. - Ability to meet deadlines. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The performance of the accountant will be evaluated on: 1. Accuracy and completeness of accounting entries. 2. Timely completion of bank reconciliations. 3. Timely GST preparation and compliance. 4. Accuracy of customer and supplier balances. 5. Timely submission of monthly MIS reports. 6. Accuracy of inventory and stock reconciliation. 7. Timely identification and reporting of accounting discrepancies. 6. What We Expect We expect the accountant to take ownership of the company's accounting system, ensure that all transactions are properly recorded and reconciled, and provide reliable financial information to management for decision-making. The objective is to maintain a transparent, accurate and well-organised accounting system through Zoho Books.

Pay: ₹8,500.00 - ₹42,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

This role is suited to a high-performing HR professional who can operate at pace, manage competing priorities, and deliver with discipline in a regulated, multinational banking environment. Beyond strong execution, you will bring curiosity, sound judgement, a continuous improvement mindset and a strong stakeholder focus, helping to connect local India branch requirements with regional and global Talent & Culture practices to deliver a simple, consistent and high-quality employee experience.

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

* + all statutory and regulatory HR compliance obligations for all branch locations (Mumbai, Gurgaon, Bengaluru & GIFT City)

------------------------

* Proven experience in HR function, ideally within a multinational, regulated, or professional services environment.
* A bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Law, Commerce or a related discipline. HR qualifications, knowledge of India employment practices, and experience in banking, financial services or another regulated industry will be advantageous.

**Chief Finance and Operating Officer**

The Foundation is committed to advancing social and economic mobility for India’s most underserved communities, with a sustained focus on women, children, and youth. The Foundation does this through high-impact, scalable interventions across education, public health, and livelihoods, addressing multidimensional barriers to enable individuals to participate fully in India’s growth story. Founded two decades ago in the aftermath of the devastating Gujarat earthquake as a historic humanitarian initiative by then Prime Minister of India, Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ji, and U.S. President Mr. Bill Clinton, it has served 20.47 million lives across 35 States and Union Territories of India.

Registered as a Trust in India with an independent Board of Trustees, it adheres to rigorous financial and governance standards, ensuring transparency, accountability, and the responsible stewardship of resources. In strict compliance with Indian statutory and regulatory frameworks, is registered under 12A, 80G, and the Foreign Contribution Regulation Act (FCRA), validating the organization's institutional credibility and legal compliance.

About the Position

Seeking an accomplished, purpose-driven and financially astute Chief Finance and Operating Officer (CFOO) to provide strategic leadership to the Director/Deputy Director/Head of Finance, Procurement, Administration, Technology, Legal, Risk and Compliance. The incumbent will work closely with Programs, Fundraising and Communications leadership. The CFOO will be the enterprise-level integrator between strategy and execution, ensuring that policies, systems, processes, technology and organisational infrastructure are aligned to its strategic ambitions. This role is suited to a leader who combines strategic perspective with an exceptional execution orientation—someone who can build systems and structures while remaining close enough to operations to identify problems, solve them and drive results.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategy & Organisational Effectiveness

· Partner with the Country Director, Program Directors and Department Heads to translate it’s five-year strategy into effective operating priorities and plans.

· Lead the operational components of it’s India strategy across Finance, Procurement, Administration,

Technology, Legal, Risk and Compliance.

· Develop an integrated operating model that supports it’s future growth.

· Identify organisational bottlenecks, risks and opportunities and drive timely, cross-functional solutions.

· Ensure that policies, SOPs, systems and organisational structures remain fit for purpose as it evolves.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

· Provide organisation-wide leadership on statutory, regulatory, donor and internal compliance.

· Ensure strong implementation of applicable Indian regulatory requirements, including FCRA, CSR, taxation and labour regulations.

· Strengthen internal controls, risk-management frameworks and compliance-monitoring mechanisms.

· Ensure timely completion and follow-up of internal and external audits.

· Provide high-quality governance, risk and compliance reporting to the Country Director and Board of Trustees.

· Support the Country Director in maintaining effective governance relationships with the Board and Trustees.

Financial Stewardship

· Provide strategic oversight of financial management, planning, budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow management and financial controls.

· Lead the annual organisational planning and budgeting process in collaboration with Program, Fundraising, Communications and Functional leaders.

· Ensure timely and accurate financial and management reporting.

· Oversee financial governance, audit processes, banking, investments and organisational assets.

· Ensure that financial systems and controls are robust, transparent and scalable.

Procurement, Administration & Infrastructure

· Ensure effective, transparent and compliant procurement and vendor-management systems.

· Strengthen standardization of administrative and operational practices across field departments and program operations.

· Ensure that infrastructure and administrative systems are adequate to support program delivery and organisational growth.

· Drive operational efficiency and cost effectiveness while maintaining quality and compliance.

Technology & Digital Transformation

· Develop and lead organisation-wide technology and AI driven digital-transformation roadmap.

· Identify technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, integration, data management and decision-making.

· Lead major technology initiatives from strategy and business case through implementation, adoption and evaluation.

· Champion innovative, secure, cost-effective and scalable technology solutions across functions and programs.

· Ensure that technology investments are aligned with the strategic priorities and deliver measurable

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Description:**

This role is responsible for the ongoing monthly testing of the Quality Assurance program for all Wealth clients records in UAE. The Post Execution Quality process is a key risk indicator that is reported to the regulators monthly. The PEQ process is reviewed numerous times a year by Regulators, Internal Audit and Compliance Testing to ensure adherence to regulatory and Citi-wide policies and standards. This role is responsible to test the Post Execution Quality accuracy to ensure all KYC Quality reporting is in line with our regulatory commitments to the OCC. This role is responsible for independently testing each PEQ analyst and report all findings to the Head of Wealth KYC Quality for effective oversight of personnel.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

This role is critical in identifying any quality deficiencies immediately, raise self-identified issues for proper oversight and execution on the correction action plans in a timely manner. Without this role and process, KYC could introduce significant risks related to regulatory and internal audit findings for insufficient KYC program and controls. These results would lead to significant remediation population, remediation populations, procedures changes or even MRA (Matters Requiring Attention) if identified by a regulator.

Partner with internal units to ensure adequate due diligence process is carried out for customer accounts and documentation reviews.

Ensure all information and documentation comply with local regulation and Citi standards.

Ensure all AML risks are mitigated based on local regulation and internal procedural requirements.

Review all screening activities and making sure all true, false, and potential matches are dispositioned correctly including sanctions related activities, if applicable.

Update and review forms according to local regulation requirements and work with Compliance to expedite documentation reviews, providing clarification as needed.

Appropriately assess and verify CIP requirements based on internal and global requirements.

Strong understanding of wealth holding vehicles which includes the various structures, legality, and documentation for each type of entity.

Participate and assist with the organization of weekly meetings and calls to discuss “Sustainability and Remediation” population.

Appropriately assessing risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

  
  

**Qualifications:**

* 3-6 years of relevant experience

**Associate Director /Manager | M&A-Deal Transformation & Post Merger integration**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 116760
  
• **Location**: Bengaluru
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The team**

Businesses are continuously exploring opportunities to grow / rationalize costs and mergers and acquisitions, or carve-outs through separations and divestitures, are among the most complex business activities an organization will undertake. Deloitte’s global network of consulting

practitioner’s help clients identify and solve their most critical information and transformational challenges. With market-leading expertise in 17 industry segments, superior business transformation capabilities, and deep technical expertise, our global network of more than 33,000 consulting practitioners create unmatched market offerings to solve our clients’ toughest business issues.

Mergers & Acquisitions team helps strategize, design, and implement end-to-end solutions for successful transactions, from advance-planning to post-transaction restructuring. The team helps drive performance for businesses in every key M&A-related function: project management, commercial activity optimization, operations and supply chain, IT systems, human capital management, and finance activities. Learn more about our Strategy & Transactions Practice

  

**Your work profile**

Professionals in M&A group offer both advisory and deployment services that provide clients with comprehensive solutions to help them better manage the critical business functions.

We accomplish this mission through continued development of people in our Strategy, Risk and Transactions - M&A: Deal Transformation and Post Merger Integration

The primary role is to make direct contributions to the engagement team by assisting healthcare sector clients on Organization Readiness and integration or carve-outs in a deal / M&A scenario.

  

**Delivery of specific capability in Pharma M&A: DT & PMI**

**Organization readiness in a post deal integration:**

* Understand the integration vision and strategy set out in the deal objective
* Work with C-suite executives, business and internal firm stakeholders to identify integration guiding principles
* Identify the target operating model, organization construct and governance model for the consolidated entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100), desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans
* Contribute in Integration Management office (IMO) for end-to-end program management of workstreams involved in the Integration process
  

**Integration support for post-deal activities:**

* Program / Integration/ Transformation management office planning and readiness
* Day 1 / 100 Readiness planning
* Assess the IT landscape and identify the areas of synergies / dis-synergies
* Vendor evaluation and selection
* IT spend analysis (including vendor contract reviews for any hidden transactional costs), provide recommendations on the cost efficiencies
* Bid formulation and vendor management
* Facilitate execution of the post deal integration of IT operations and organization
  

**Carve-out and separation:**

* Develop the separation strategy and assess the separation readiness
* Evaluate financial and operational entanglements / interdependencies
* Identify the operating model, organization construct and governance model for the re-structured entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100) and desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans
* Contribute in managing the Separation Management Office (SMO) across the workstreams
* Assess the TSA requirements, prepare TSA schedules and TSA exit strategies
* Cost modelling for one-time and recurring costs due to separation (stranded cost, standalone costs etc.)
* Define step- wise separation road map
  

**Commercial and Operational Diligence and Transformation:**

* Evaluate the strategic and commercial feasibility of a deal / transaction
* Evaluate the current business capabilities and identify red flags on operational issues/risks
* Assess the Post deal consolidation and transformation opportunities
* Leverage industry best practices and Deloitte accelerators to define methodological approach to consolidation / separation
* Undertake detailed functional integration planning (e.g. Sales and Marketing, operations, Finance, IT, HR etc.) for Day 1 /100 and End state
* Support delivery of functional plans
  

**Synergy / dis-synergy assessment & delivery:**

* Identify areas of potential synergies / dis-synergies and establish the degree of integration required
* Define road map for delivery of synergies and advise on synergy benefits tracking
* Work with functional leads on Synergy realization
  

**Key skills required:**

* Candidate should be able to demonstrate experience of working on large transformations including pre-deal or post-deal M&A transactions in healthcare/pharma/hospitals space
* Candidate should possess good knowledge of healthcare chain from a business standpoint
* A strong and demonstrated interest in consulting with 8+ years of relevant experience in financial services industry preferably banking
* Relevant understanding of technology landscape of a Healthcare organization would be a key differentiator
* Excellent academic credentials for both undergraduate and graduate coursework. MBA preferred
* Strong advanced MS Excel and MS PowerPoint skills
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal
* Leadership qualities and the ability to mentor junior consultants and analysts
* Willingness and ability to take initiative and learn independently
* This role involves travelling.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer - India
jobs.description:
**Location & work modality: India , Mumbai**

**About Submer**  
  
**At Submer, we are redefining how data centers are built, integrated, and operated, with sustainability, efficiency, and innovation at the core. Our technology is designed to reduce environmental impact while improving performance and efficiency. We are a purpose-driven company with a passion for innovation and a growing global presence.**

**Your impact**

Submer India is seeking an experienced, commercially minded and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead and build the Finance function in India. This is a growth- and investment-oriented role with particular responsibility for capital strategy, fundraising and the financial architecture supporting enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion.

The CFO will own the India capital agenda within approved mandates, working with India and Group leadership to secure financing and lead transactions through financial closure. The role requires an accomplished senior finance leader with demonstrated CFO-level responsibility and a proven record of personally leading and closing capital-raising transactions, preferably within technology, infrastructure, digital infrastructure, datacentres, engineering, energy or other high-growth and capital-intensive businesses.

The successful candidate will combine capital-raising capability with strong financial stewardship, governance and compliance. The CFO must understand the complete business lifecycle, from establishment and capitalisation through growth, scaling, restructuring and potential strategic transactions and/or potential exit, and be able to operate in an entrepreneurial technology and infrastructure environment.

**What you'll do**

**1. Strategic Financial Leadership**
=====================================

* Act as a key member of the India leadership team and provide strategic financial leadership to support Submer's growth and long-term enterprise value.
* Develop and execute the financial and capital strategy for the India business, linking enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion to appropriate sources of funding.
* Partner with business and operational leadership on investments, expansion plans and commercial opportunities, providing financial insight, strategic decisions and constructive challenge.
* Build scalable financial structures, processes, controls and planning capabilities suitable for a high growth organisation
* Build long term business planning and value creation.

**2. Investment, Fundraising and Capital Raising**
==================================================

* Lead the development and execution of capital-raising strategies for Submer's India business and strategic initiatives, aligned with approved plans and funding mandates.
* Build and maintain relationships with institutional, private equity, venture capital, infrastructure and strategic investors/partners, banks, financial institutions and structured-finance providers, as relevant.
* Lead India investor and lender engagement, financial presentations and, 'fund-sourcing to fund-raising to investment' plans and subsequent discussions; *(coordinate with Group finance and support Group-led transactions under the agreed mandate.)*
* Distinguish corporate capital for enterprise growth, including growth equity, strategic investment and corporate debt, from project or asset capital, including JV/SPV equity, infrastructure debt, construction finance and project finance.
* Develop financial models, investment cases and business plans; evaluate funding structures, financing costs, dilution, security requirements and investment returns.
* Lead financial due diligence readiness, strategic investment, financial structuring and financing negotiations through financial closure, coordinating legal, tax, business and technical inputs and obtaining required approvals.
* Agree capital-raising milestones with leadership and report on funding secured, transaction progress, financing terms and deployment of proceeds; maintain appropriate investor and lender reporting.

**3. Business Lifecycle and Growth Strategy**
=============================================

Guide the business through its financial lifecycle and ensure that funding structures and financial capabilities evolve with its stage of development. This includes:

* Business establishment, entity structuring, financial planning and initial capitalisation.
* Early-stage growth, scaling, fundraising and infrastructure or project expansion.
* Financial governance, commercial growth, profitability and long-term value creation.
* Mergers, acquisitions, strategic partnerships, restructuring and business transformation.
* Transaction readiness and potential exit planning.

Align corporate growth capital, project or asset financing and subsequent refinancing or strategic transactions with business needs, risk appetite and approved return objectives.

**4. Financial Planning, Analysis and Performance Management**
==============================================================

* Lead annual budgeting, long-term financial planning, forecasts and scenario modelling.
* Monitor financial and operational performance against approved plans
* Analyze profitability, cash flow, capital requirements and investment returns.
* Track business and project performance against approved investment cases, identify variances and recommend corrective action.
* Develop management reports and financial dashboards for senior leadership, identifying risks and opportunities and enabling informed decisions.

**5. Corporate Finance and Strategic Transactions**
===================================================

* Evaluate investment and strategic opportunities through valuation, financial analysis and assessment of returns and risks.
* Lead financial due diligence and financial transaction structuring for India-led transactions; *(support Group-led transactions within the agreed mandate.)*
* Structure and financially govern joint ventures and special purpose vehicles (JVs/SPVs), including shareholder funding, debt/equity arrangements, inter-company transactions and project returns.
* Develop and oversee cash waterfalls, distributions, dividend or repatriation arrangements and investor reporting in accordance with approved agreements and applicable requirements.
* Contribute to mergers, acquisitions and strategic partnerships, working with legal, tax, banking and external advisory partners
* Support exit readiness and strategic transaction planning.

**6. Finance Operations, Governance and Compliance**
====================================================

* Establish and maintain robust financial controls, policies and governance, including oversight of capital deployment and entity-level reporting.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian accounting, taxation, corporate and regulatory requirements
* Oversee financial, accounting and statutory compliance reporting.
* Ensure timely and accurate financial management and statutory filings.
* Manage relationships with auditors, tax advisors and external consultants; *(coordinating with Group finance as appropriate.)*
* Identify and mitigate financial and business risks, including financing covenant compliance and related-party exposures.

**7. Cash Flow and Working Capital Management**
===============================================

* Lead cash flow, liquidity and working capital planning and management.
* Align liquidity and financing requirements with business growth, capital expenditure and project or JV/SPV funding commitments.
* Manage banking relationships and financing facilities
* Monitor funding availability, drawdown conditions and covenant headroom.
* Monitor capital expenditure and investment commitments and optimise the use of capital across approved business, for infrastructure- and project-based requirements.

**8. Technology and Infrastructure Business Understanding**

jobs.description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.




**Disclaimer:**
===============

  

Finastra has signed an agreement to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with completion expected end 2026 / early 2027, subject to consultation and customary closing conditions. Upon completion, this role is expected to transition to the standalone Universal Banking business, creating opportunities to support its future growth and success.

**Finastra: Who are we?**

Formed in 2017 by the combination of Misys and D+H, we provide the broadest portfolio of financial services software in the world today—spanning Lending, Payments and Universal Banking businesses.

Our solutions enable customers to deploy mission critical technology on premises or in the cloud. With our scale and geographical reach we drive valued solutions and opportunity for customers regardless of size or geography. Through our open, secure, and reliable solutions, we empower customers to accelerate growth, optimize cost, mitigate risk and continually evolve to meet their changing needs.

  

**Universal Banking business:**

In June 2026, Finastra agreed to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with the sale expected to complete in early 2027. This role is part of the CTO Leadership Team for Universal Banking and will play a critical part in shaping the engineering organization of the new Universal Banking business. You will join Finastra initially and, on completion of the sale, your employment will transfer with the Universal Banking business to its new ownership.

  

**Role Summary**

The Lending Engineering Director is a Grade 9, M4 (Director) leadership role accountable for the engineering of the Universal Banking Lending product line. Managing through others, the Director leads a multi-disciplinary engineering organization of squads and squad leads, and owns end-to-end software delivery, from requirements and design through build, test, release, deployment and production operations, using an agentic AI-first engineering model. Operating independently within business and functional policies, the Director sets engineering direction and allocates resources across programmes and services. As a member of the CTO Leadership Team, the Director partners with Product, GTM and Services, and represents Lending engineering up to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT).

  

**Role Impact**

* **Scope and direction:** Owns the Lending engineering domain and acts independently to set direction and allocate people, budget and capacity across programmes, projects and services.
* **Problem solving and standards:** Resolves complex technical, operational and organizational problems, and recommends standards and operating strategies that mitigate risk and drive growth.
* **Planning and execution:** Develops and executes plans to achieve key Lending business objectives in collaboration with senior management.
* **Influence:** Fosters collaboration across the business, influences more senior colleagues and presents to the management chain up to the ELT when required.
* **Innovation:** Brings forward new ideas, notably in agentic AI engineering, that benefit Universal Banking and Finastra as a whole.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Engineering Strategy and Agentic AI Transformation***

* Define and own the Lending engineering strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligned with product strategy, architecture and business outcomes, including modernization on Cloud, SaaS, Java and microservices.
* Lead the shift to an agentic AI-first engineering model in which AI agents and engineers work together across the full lifecycle, with clear adoption targets and measurable gains in productivity, quality and cycle time.
* Make and own decisions on resource allocation, investment, tooling and build, buy or partner options, and influence platform and architecture decisions across the CTO organization.

***AI-Enabled End-to-End Software Delivery***

* **Plan:** Use AI agents with Product to refine requirements, generate user stories and acceptance criteria, and improve estimation and backlog prioritization.
* **Design and build:** Apply AI-assisted design reviews, agentic code generation, refactoring, legacy modernization and code review using tools such as GitHub Copilot.
* **Test and secure:** Drive AI-generated test cases, test data and automated regression, with AI-assisted security and vulnerability scanning built into CI/CD (shift-left quality and DevSecOps).
* **Release and deploy:** Own CI/CD pipelines, release readiness, versioning, change approvals and deployment orchestration, including containerized deployments to Kubernetes across cloud and on-premises environments, with a high degree of automation.
* **Document and enable:** Use AI to keep technical documentation, release notes and knowledge bases current for Services, Support and implementation partners.

***SDLC/PMLC and AI Governance***

* Own the SDLC and PMLC for Lending, ensuring rigour, transparency and measurability, in alignment with the Enterprise PMO, Product Strategy and Architecture.
* Establish guardrails for the responsible use of AI agents, including human-in-the-loop review, model and prompt governance, data classification, IP and security controls, and auditability, in line with Finastra policies and regulatory requirements.
* Track delivery, quality and AI-adoption metrics (for example, DORA metrics, defect leakage and AI acceptance rates) and act on trends.

***Operations, Reliability and Service Management***

* Participate and provide product support for Production incident triage, root-cause analysis and problem management, using AIOps and AI-assisted diagnostics to reduce MTTR and recurring issues.
* Contribute to change, release, configuration and environment management, and oversee performance, scalability and capacity planning across environments.
* Partner with SRE/Platform and Infrastructure teams to meet agreed SLAs and SLOs.

***People Leadership and Stakeholder Influence***

* Lead, coach and develop squad leads and senior technical staff, building succession and AI-ready engineering skills across the organization.
* Own organization design, workforce planning, hiring and performance management within budget, and lead teams through change, including the transition to new ownership.
* Partner daily with Product, GTM, Services and shared services, act as the technical voice of Lending with customers, and present to senior leadership up to the ELT.

**Competencies / Experience:14+Years**

  

***Essential***

* Track record of leading engineering tribes or domains of 20+ smart engineers across multiple squads, managing through squad leads.
* Proven leadership of application engineering and strategy for enterprise-grade, B2B, mission-critical solutions. A background in fintech and financial services is required; lending experience is preferred.
* Strong exposure to Cloud, SaaS, Java and microservices, with hands-on experience of container-based deployment using Docker and Kubernetes (or managed services such as AKS, EKS or OpenShift), Helm and GitOps-driven release pipelines.
* Hands-on experience deploying AI engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and leading agentic AI adoption across the SDLC, with demonstrable productivity and quality outcomes.
* Has led Agile engineering transformation, with a strong understanding of SAFe and, preferably, LeSS or the Spotify model. Well versed in DevOps/DevSecOps and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Mature leader with strong communication, strategic thinking, complex problem solving and senior stakeholder

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
WE ARE HIRINGGROUP CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER (GROUP CFO)

**Honey Makhija Group**

**Location:** Katni, Madhya Pradesh / Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Experience:** 15–25 Years Preferred  
**Qualification:** Chartered Accountant (CA)  
**Position:** Full-Time | Senior Leadership

About the Role

Honey Makhija Group is looking for an experienced, ambitious and strategically capable Group Chief Financial Officer to take complete ownership of the financial functions across the entire group and its subsidiaries.

The CFO will lead all aspects of corporate finance, institutional fundraising, banking, working capital, project finance, government grants and subsidies, accounting, taxation, audits, treasury, financial controls and corporate governance.

A key objective will be to transform the group into a professionally managed, institutionally funded and financially disciplined organisation, with the goal of preparing the appropriate group entity/entities for a mainstream IPO within the next three years.

The CFO will report directly to the Group Chairman.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Corporate Fundraising & Banking**

* Raise Cash Credit (CC), Overdraft (OD), Working Capital and Term Loan facilities.
* Arrange project finance, equipment finance and structured debt.
* Develop relationships with PSU banks, private banks, NBFCs and financial institutions.
* Lead consortium banking arrangements and negotiate financing terms.
* Explore NCDs, corporate bonds, private credit and institutional funding.
* Manage loan renewals, enhancements, credit ratings and lender compliance.
* Develop and execute a group-wide fundraising strategy targeting ₹1,000+ crore in institutional funding over the medium term, subject to project viability and lender approvals.

**2. Government Grants & Subsidies**

* Identify eligible central and state government subsidy schemes.
* Apply for capital subsidies, interest subsidies and industrial incentives.
* Explore schemes for MSMEs, food processing, manufacturing, renewable energy, EV infrastructure and agro-industries.
* Coordinate with government departments, ministries, industrial development corporations and financial institutions.
* Manage applications, approvals, documentation and subsidy disbursements.

**3. Financial Planning & Management**

* Take complete ownership of group-level financial planning.
* Prepare annual budgets, financial projections and business-wise profitability reports.
* Manage cash flows, working capital and treasury.
* Optimise borrowing costs and capital allocation.
* Evaluate new projects, investments, acquisitions and expansion plans.
* Prepare detailed project reports (DPRs), financial models, IRR, NPV and DSCR calculations.

**4. Accounting, ERP & Financial Systems**

* Establish standardised accounting systems across all group companies.
* Implement ERP and centralised financial management systems.
* Develop financial SOPs, approval matrices and internal controls.
* Establish monthly MIS, consolidated financial reporting and business-wise dashboards.
* Introduce cost accounting, inventory controls and automated reconciliations.
* Build transparent and professionally managed finance operations.

**5. Audits, Taxation & Compliance**

* Lead statutory audits, internal audits and tax audits.
* Oversee GST, TDS, income tax and other statutory compliances.
* Establish audit calendars and financial reporting deadlines.
* Ensure accurate financial statements and timely account finalisation.
* Coordinate with auditors, consultants and regulatory authorities.
* Implement internal financial controls and close audit observations.

**6. IPO Readiness – Three-Year Mandate**

* Prepare the appropriate group entity/entities for a mainstream IPO within three years.
* Develop the IPO-readiness roadmap.
* Strengthen corporate governance and financial reporting.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards.
* Review corporate structures, shareholding and related-party transactions.
* Coordinate with merchant bankers, legal advisors, auditors and investment bankers.
* Prepare the organisation for financial due diligence and regulatory scrutiny.
* Evaluate listing structures, valuation and capital market opportunities.

**7. Treasury & Financial Risk Management**

* Manage group-wide liquidity and cash flow.
* Monitor debt obligations, interest costs and repayment schedules.
* Establish treasury management policies.
* Manage financial risks and optimise deployment of surplus funds.
* Ensure effective working capital management.

**8. Group-Level Financial Governance**

* Establish a centralised finance function across all group companies.
* Consolidate financial reporting.
* Monitor subsidiary performance and financial discipline.
* Build and lead professional finance, accounts, treasury and audit teams.
* Develop financial policies and reporting structures.
* Work directly with the Chairman on strategic financial decisions.

Business Exposure

The CFO will manage financial strategy across the diversified Honey Makhija Group, including:

* Rice milling, agro-processing and food industries.
* EV charging infrastructure.
* Solar and renewable energy.
* Biomass and alternative energy.
* Manufacturing and industrial projects.
* Technology, AI and software businesses.
* Logistics, hospitality and other ventures.

Candidate Requirements

* Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification mandatory.
* 15–25 years of relevant experience preferred.
* Previous CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director or senior corporate finance experience preferred.
* Strong experience in CC limits, term loans, project finance and institutional fundraising.
* Established relationships with banks, NBFCs and financial institutions.
* Experience in consortium finance and structured debt.
* Knowledge of government grants, subsidies and incentive schemes.
* Strong expertise in accounting, taxation, audits and financial controls.
* Experience in ERP implementation and financial transformation.
* Exposure to IPO preparation, capital markets and corporate governance.
* Excellent negotiation, leadership and execution capabilities.

First 180-Day Expectations

* Complete financial assessment of all group companies.
* Review existing banking facilities, loans and liabilities.
* Develop a comprehensive group fundraising strategy.
* Initiate CC enhancement and term loan proposals.
* Identify and initiate eligible government subsidy applications.
* Implement centralised MIS and financial reporting.
* Establish internal audit and financial control systems.
* Prepare the three-year IPO-readiness roadmap.

What We Are Looking For

We are not looking for someone who merely manages accounting, GST and taxation.

We are looking for a financial leader capable of building institutional relationships, raising substantial capital, structuring complex financing, obtaining government incentives, implementing professional financial systems and preparing a diversified corporate group for public-market participation.

The candidate must be execution-oriented, commercially aggressive, professionally disciplined and capable of working directly with the Group Chairman.

Application

Interested and eligible candidates are requested to share their updated CV / Resume via WhatsApp.

**WhatsApp: +91 83834 34626**

**Subject: Application – Group CFO | Honey Makhija Group**

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussions.

**Honey Makhija Group**  
Building businesses. Creating institutions.

Pay: ₹96,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

Operations & Vendor Management.

* Evaluate and manage technology vendors, blockchain providers, custodians, and strategic partners.

Enterprise Architecture & Strategic Leadership.
  
  

* Apply TOGAF and Enterprise Architecture principles to create a future-ready digital asset platform aligned with business strategy.
* Design modular, API-first, microservices-based architectures to promote flexibility and scalability.
* Drive stakeholder engagement, change management, and cross-functional collaboration across business, technology, risk, compliance, and security teams.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelors or masters degree in computer science, IT, Engineering or related field.
* 8+ years of architecture or platform engineering experience in banking, fintech or digital assets.
* Experience with custody platforms, wallets, tokenisation and stablecoin ecosystems.
* Strong knowledge of blockchain, cryptography, cloud platforms and cybersecurity.
* Expertise in API management, enterprise integration and digital banking ecosystems.

* Professional certifications in cloud, security, architecture or blockchain technologies.
