jobs.title: Head of People Transformation & Enterprise Process Excellence
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**

The Head of People Transformation & Enterprise Process Excellence will establish and lead a scalable, business-focused approach to transformation, process management and continuous improvement across a growing international organisation.

Reporting directly to the Chief People Officer (CPO) and operating as a senior member of the Human Resources leadership team, the Head will initially focus on transforming HR processes and the end-to-end employee experience. The role will establish the HR process architecture, assess current practices, design future-state processes, clarify process ownership and decision rights, and introduce meaningful KPIs, SLAs and governance frameworks.

The Chief People Officer retains accountability for the HR strategy, HR operating model and HR organisational structure. The Head will provide process-based insight to inform operating-model decisions and translate the agreed model into end-to-end processes, governance, roles, controls, measures and implementation plans.

The Head will also establish an enterprise process-excellence framework and practical methodology that can be adopted by other business functions. Working across organisational and geographic boundaries, the role will enable leaders and process owners to improve the performance, consistency, control and experience of their processes while retaining accountability within the relevant function.

The position combines strategic design with hands-on transformation delivery. It will ensure that organisational processes support continued international growth while reinforcing culture, values, regulatory obligations and commitment to fair, inclusive and high-quality employee experiences.

The role may commence as an individual contributor during the initial diagnostic and mobilisation period. Delivery of the broader enterprise mandate will require the timely establishment of a dedicated People Transformation and Enterprise Process Excellence team, supported by nominated process owners, subject-matter experts and enabling functions. The Head will define the required capability and phased resourcing model with the Chief People Officer. Scope, sequencing and delivery commitments will remain aligned with approved capacity and resources.

**Key Accountabilities**

1. Transformation Strategy & Leadership

* Partner with the Chief People Officer to define and deliver the People Transformation and Enterprise Process Excellence strategy.
* Translate business and growth priorities into a practical, prioritised and measurable transformation roadmap.
* Act as a trusted adviser to senior leadership on process, governance, transformation and organisational-effectiveness matters.
* Build senior stakeholder alignment around transformation priorities and develop evidence-based recommendations and business cases.
* Establish governance for transformation initiatives, including decision forums, escalation paths, risk management and benefits tracking.
* Provide transparent reporting on progress, outcomes and key decisions.

2. Alignment with the HR Operating Model

* Ensure process transformation aligns with the approved or evolving HR operating model.
* Provide evidence from process diagnostics, performance data, employee experience and stakeholder feedback to support decision-making.
* Translate the approved operating model into process architecture, workflows, governance, controls, measures and implementation plans.
* Clarify responsibilities through accountability frameworks and RACI models.
* Define effective process interfaces between HR, leaders, employees and enabling functions such as Finance, Technology, Compliance, Legal, Risk and Operations.
* Support the implementation of approved operating-model changes.

3. HR Process Architecture & End-to-End Process Transformation

* Establish a Group-wide HR process architecture covering the complete employee lifecycle.
* Lead discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, process mapping, maturity assessments and diagnostic reviews.
* Conduct gap analyses and identify inefficiencies, duplication, unclear ownership and control weaknesses.
* Design scalable, employee-focused and measurable future-state processes.
* Ensure processes are considered end-to-end, including workflows, systems, controls, decision points and employee touchpoints.
* Translate future-state designs into policies, procedures, controls, templates and implementation actions.
* Prioritise transformation initiatives according to business value, risk, employee impact and implementation feasibility.

Indicative HR Process Portfolio

Subject to agreed priorities, the portfolio may include:

* Position creation and requisition approval
* End-to-end recruitment and hiring
* Onboarding
* Performance management
* Learning, development and talent management
* Compensation, promotion, recognition and internal mobility
* Employee engagement
* Leave administration
* Offboarding, exit management and knowledge transfer

4. Process Governance, Documentation & Ownership

* Establish standards for process design, documentation, approval, ownership and change control.
* Create and maintain an accessible process repository.
* Establish regular process review and assurance cycles.
* Coordinate risk-based process health checks and conformance reviews.
* Partner with Internal Audit, Risk and Compliance functions to ensure appropriate control frameworks are embedded.
* Balance standardisation with local regulatory requirements.

5. Performance Excellence, KPIs & Service Levels

* Define KPIs, SLAs, targets, ownership and reporting frameworks.
* Introduce process-performance dashboards and review cadences.
* Use data and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain a continuous-improvement pipeline and benefits tracking methodology.
* Ensure measures drive end-to-end performance and employee experience.

6. Culture, Engagement, Equity & Inclusion

* Embed organisational values and leadership behaviours into people processes.
* Ensure fair, transparent and inclusive decision-making practices.
* Review people processes for potential barriers, bias and inconsistent application.
* Translate employee feedback into practical process and organisational improvements.
* Partner with HR leadership to strengthen accountability for employee experience outcomes.

7. Enterprise Process Excellence Capability

* Establish a practical enterprise process-excellence framework and methodology.
* Support business functions in defining process ownership, governance, KPIs and improvement priorities.
* Facilitate cross-functional transformation initiatives.
* Coach leaders and process owners on process management and continuous improvement.
* Develop a community of process owners and champions.
* Maintain clear accountability within business functions while providing specialist process expertise.

8. Technology, Data & Automation Enablement

* Assess current process-management, workflow and collaboration tools.
* Establish interim process-repository and governance solutions where required.
* Define business requirements for scalable BPM and process-management capabilities.
* Evaluate existing platforms and recommend fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Partner with Technology and business stakeholders to implement appropriate tools and workflows.
* Identify automation opportunities and improve data quality.
* Ensure technology decisions are driven by future-state process requirements and user needs.

9. Implementation, Adoption & Capability Building

* Translate approved designs into implementation plans with clear milestones and ownership.
* Develop communication, training and change-adoption strategies.
* Monitor adoption and address implementation challenges.
* Build internal process-management and continuous-improvement capability.
* Define future-state team structures, skills and resource requirements.
* Develop phased resourcing plans and supporting business cases.

Operations and shared services

Develop and oversee the enterprise transformation strategy and roadmap by translating the Bank’s strategic direction into prioritised initiatives, integrated delivery plans and measurable outcomes to ensure transformation objectives support growth, operational resilience, customer outcomes, regulatory expectations and long term value creation

**Transformation Management Office Governance**

Establish and manage the Transformation Management Office governance framework, including delivery standards, milestone tracking, dependency management, escalation routes, reporting disciplines and decision forums to ensure projects are governed consistently and delivered in line with approved priorities, timelines, quality expectations and risk parameters

Bachelor’s Degree from a well recognised university in Business Administration, Strategy, Finance, Economics, Project Management, Operations Management or a related discipline

* Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations for your team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.

**• Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.**  
**• Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.**  
**• Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.**  
**• Set and monitor s and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.**

**Risk Management**  
**• Ensure KYC/AML updates, proper zero error documentation.**  
**• Updating the C – Manager, adhering to the Contact Management Plan.**  
**• Ensure full awareness of all policies and procedures issued in relation to money laundering prevention and KYC.**  
**• Ensure compliance with the above policies on an ongoing basis and reported any suspicious transaction immediately to the supervising officer.**  
**• Ensure full awareness of all policies relating to operational risk, sales processes, anti-misselling, etc and comply with the same.**  
**• Read, understand and comply with all provisions of the Group Code of Conduct.**

**Our Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------

* **Experienced Sales and Relationship Manager with background in handling all Banking & Investment Products. Strong communication and negotiation skills with the ability to influence outcomes.**
* **Networking ability to manage interdepartmental deliverables.**
* **Strong inter-personal skills and leadership ability, which encourages and promotes enthusiasm and team spirit.**
* **Good understanding of the business environment in UAE preferably with direct contacts with the local HNI community.**
* **Adapting to multi-cultural environment.**
* **In-depth knowledge of capital markets and financial planning**
* **SCA certified**

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

**We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.**

**Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.**

-----------------

* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation** **, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.**
* **In line with our Fair Pay Charter** **, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.**
* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance** **, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.**
* **Time-off** **including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.**

jobs.title: Officer, Virtual Relationship Manager, Consumer Banking Group
jobs.description:
**Business Function**
As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits, investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans, to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business – they were made just right for you.
  
  
**Job Purpose**

* DBS India Consumer Banking Group including digibank (Retail Banking) and Treasures (Wealth Segment) serves over 2.6 million customers worldwide with a complete range of banking and wealth management services.
* It is a business that focuses on quality customer acquisition through multiple acquisition channels, customer-centric value propositions and innovative and efficient distribution channels.
* DBS has been at the forefront of adapting and incorporating rapid changes in technology to understand and serve customer needs better. Virtual Relationship Managers are a step in that direction.
* Thus Treasures Virtual Relationship Manager is a key role within the Consumer Banking Group Business that is responsible for engaging with clients across the geographies in India and Globally, greatly enhancing the client experience through the effective use of technology.
* A high level of customer-centricity, interpersonal relationships complemented by “multi-channel” approach to relationship management via online and digi app are critical to succeed in this role.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Acquire clients through e-boarding of the provided leads and nurture the relationship for AUM build up in a steady manner.
* Establish the Virtual Relationship Channel as a major revenue contributor through effective engagement with clients via multiple communication channels
* Ensure right balance of the product mix and balance NTB (New to Bank NR customers) with increased penetration of existing customers to deepen the wallet share.
* Drive and deliver a radical improvement in customer satisfaction scores through timely engagement and redressal of client enquiries.
* Ensure highest levels of customer satisfaction. Interact with new customers to detail & explain all features & functions of products & assist in on boarding of new clients.
* Empower DBS IN clients embrace the value delivery channels to improve transaction efficiency and effectiveness

**Job Duties & Responsibilities**

* Quality engagement with Emerging Affluent and Treasures clients to retain and developing sustainable relationships
* Ensure effective and efficient on-boarding, client coverage and client economics.
* Coordinate and drive timely investment and insurance portfolio reviews partnering with Investment / Insurance / Wealth specialists in Cluster locations.
* Establish relationships with the client’s basis opportunities identified by key acquiringchannels such as SME / CEP/IBG/ DBS Experience Centers or influencers for on-boarding the clients and ensure qualification as Treasures basis the stipulated criteria.
* Ensure service delivery by ensuring appropriate workflows and processes including digital on-boarding, upgrades, Scan / E-mail based wealth transactions, doorstep banking services, digital and remote account maintenance (Re-KYC / Risk Reviews) etc.
* Work closely with Cluster locations, Operations and other stakeholders to ensure that customer instructions are executed correctly and in a timely manner
* Improving customer experience by collating customer feedback, identifying areas to improve such as operational, administrative, processes and competitiveness of products and services
* Maintaining an awareness of relevant products and services available so as to provide the best solutions for clients as per their identified needs and aspirations
* Supporting process and product improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback on service and product offering and ensuring compliance with internal audit and regulatory requirements and quality assurance
* Adhere to DBS India and Group standards on code of conduct and controls in line with bank values and expectations

**Requirements:**

* Servicing high net worth clients at a financial institution / KPO
* While technical competence is not essential, ability to handle client requests via e-channels and versatility with digital tools would be beneficial.
* Good knowledge of wealth management products, both investment and insurance
* Customer oriented and able to capture customer financial needs
* Holder of relevant insurance, investment certification requirements (AMFI / IRDAI Composite license) would be an advantage
* Good command of spoken English and Hindi. Fluency in other regional languages (Marathi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu etc.) would be an advantage.

**Education / Preferred Qualifications**

* University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline. Postgraduation in marketing or finance or banking would be desirable

**Core Competencies**

* Selling and team influencing skills to grow customer numbers and customer product uptake
* People Management
* Communication Skills
* Drive for Action
* Ability to work in an ambiguous environment
* Excellent understanding of the Bank’s Strategy and ability to interpret this and execute effectively to grow customer wallet share
* Proven track record in execution of sales or marketing strategy that resulted in business growth

Work Relationship
  
  

* Ensuring remote coverage and engagement of customers along with Branch teams for support.
* Close interaction with Channels / Segments and Clusters to ensure consistent delivery of service and business objectives.

**DBS India - Culture & Behaviours**
DBS is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Expected value driven behaviours are:
  
  

* Demonstrate Business Performance through PRIDE 2.0 Value Based Propositions
* Ensure Customer Focus by Delighting Customers & Reduce Complaints
* Build Pride and Passion to Protect, Maintain and Enhance DBS’ Reputation
* Enhance Self Knowledge, Skills and develop Competencies aimed at continuous improvement
* Maintain the Highest Standards of Honesty and Integrity.

**Location:**
Pune-DBIL
  
  
**Job:**
Product Sales
  
  
**Schedule:**
Regular
  
  
**Employee Status:**
Full time

jobs.description:
**Business Function**
As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits, investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans, to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business - they were made just right for you.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To deliver exceptional volume and revenue performance by acquiring and engaging with DBS Treasures Private HNI clients having a total relationship value of 6cr INR & above. This role requires an experienced professional with a strong background in wealth management, exceptional leadership capabilities, and a proven track record in business development. The role will be a Revenue Generator role and carry individual targets as well
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Accountable for achieving monthly & annual sales targets for the city/market, as agreed. Ensure proper implementation & execution of relationship management & investment advisory strategies.
* Ensure proper sales spread between products. Grow the TRV of Treasures Private Client segment by acquiring and nurturing the clients having AUM => INR 6cr
* Monitoring of progress towards achieving targets is done on a weekly basis. Agree targets and take accountability for the overall achievement of CBG product portfolio performance objectives for the branch in terms of:

+ Customer Experience, Sales Growth & Income Contribution.
+ Costs performance, Employee Satisfaction, Risk and rigour management.

* Provide clear direction on business objectives, translating and prioritizing into business performance measures. Ensure balance between NTB customer acquisition & penetration of existing customers.
* Define objectives for the TPC segment. Develop & implement strategy to deepen wallet share of existing customers.
* Build and develop a high performing team through embedding performance development and coaching. Create an empowering environment for the team, encouraging individual ownership and initiative.
* Ensure coaching and feedback to achieve their maximum potential. Make reward decisions within set guidelines
* Drive and deliver a radical improvement in customer service in the local market through dynamic service leadership and the implementation of customer service strategy.
* Define progressively higher service standards for each branch aligning to DBS standards. Ensure reduction of complaints & error rates.

**Job Duties & Requirements**

* Focus on right customer segment: promoters in small, mid, and large corporate segments / Family office/HNI to improve the overall AUM.
* A significant part of the role will be leading the team to identify and secure new clients to increase AUM. This can also be achieved by bringing an existing book of clients over to transfer the AUM.
* All the functions of this role must be carried out in such a way that adheres to all compliance and regulatory requirements
* Ensure complete knowledge of all products & services through continuous skill and knowledge improvement.
* Provide feedback on market, competition, and products, suggest innovations & ideas for continuous product and service improvements
* Use financial acumen and investment expertise to review a client's information, work closely with the Research and Advisory team to provide superior investment solutions thereby helping the client reach short-term and long-term investment goals, and seamlessly align service delivery for an enhanced customer experience
* Leadership to the team to ensure that they are motivated and are able to bring their best selves to work every day. Responsible for driving performance and discipline within the team – initiate misconduct or work closely with the HR team.
* Determine and manage Training Needs Analysis and Succession plans for TPC RMs in the branch
* Working with the team to achieve sales & service through in-branch business development activities and provide feedback.
* Ensure that TPC RMs own and manage customer queries and complaints by taking ownership and resolving in a timely manner. Act as the escalation point for their unresolved queries and complaints.
* Brief staff on promotional and product launches; provide regular feedback on sales performance.
* Establish relationships with key clients or business influencers in the local area, including doing some client entertainment within overall annual budget limits.
* Support product specialists and the direct sales team in marketing of group schemes and other corporate products to local businesses.
* Ensure compliance with operations risk and rigour requirements e.g. Health & Safety standards, security of premises, KYC and anti-money laundering measures.
* Establish DBS Bank as a wealth management provider in India. Undertake frequent competitor analysis so that DBS product suite is in line with (or ahead of) competing banks. These updates to be shared with the Head CBG and Product teams at regular intervals. Also identify local promotional activities which will help reinforce the DBS brand.

* Facilitate the distribution of third-party investment products to customers, after taking into consideration the risk profile and investment objectives of the said customer.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Business Development Director / Senior Manager
  
  
SAP S/4HANA Transformation Services - Middle East
  
  
ROLE MANDATE Build the Middle East SAP transformation business through new-client acquisition, strategic account expansion, and trusted executive relationships.
  
  
Location Middle East, with flexibility across GCC markets
  
  
Travel Frequent regional travel and onsite customer presence as business needs require
  
  
Experience level 12+ years overall, including significant SAP business development, consulting, sales, or client engagement experience
  
  
Role orientation Customer-facing growth leader with an entrepreneurial and aspirational mindset
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and entrepreneurial Business Development Leader to accelerate growth across the Middle East. The role requires a customer-facing professional with proven exposure to large SAP S/4HANA transformation programs and the ambition to build a scalable regional business. The successful candidate will identify and shape opportunities, influence C-level stakeholders, expand strategic accounts, and position the organization as a trusted transformation partner.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Business Growth and Sales Leadership
  
  
Develop and execute the regional growth plan; identify, qualify, and pursue new SAP transformation opportunities; build a healthy pipeline across SAP S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, Cloud ERP, AMS, and adjacent digital services; and drive new-logo acquisition and account growth.
  
  
Customer and Executive Engagement
  
  
Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CFOs, CTOs, business leaders, and other decision-makers. Lead executive conversations, discovery sessions, value workshops, proposal presentations, and strategic account discussions.
  
  
SAP Transformation Advisory
  
  
Understand customers' business priorities and translate them into transformation opportunities. Use experience from large S/4HANA programs to support transformation roadmaps, business cases, solution positioning, and value propositions.
  
  
Opportunity Pursuit and Deal Closure
  
  
Lead opportunity qualification, RFP responses, proposals, and pursuit governance. Collaborate with solution architects, consulting, delivery, commercial, finance, and legal teams to develop compelling and commercially sound proposals.
  
  
Account Expansion and Market Development
  
  
Drive account mining, cross-selling, and upselling. Track market and industry trends, represent the organization at relevant events, and build productive relationships with SAP, hyperscalers, and alliance partners.
  
  
Onsite Presence and Regional Coverage
  
  
Maintain a strong onsite customer presence across the Middle East. Travel regularly for customer meetings, executive workshops, industry events, proposal discussions, steering sessions, and critical pursuits. Be comfortable working from customer locations for extended periods when required.
  
  
**Required Experience And Qualifications**
Must Have
  
  
12+ years of experience in SAP consulting, sales, business development, or client engagement; at least 5 years supporting or selling large SAP transformation programs; strong exposure to S/4HANA greenfield, brownfield, selective transformation, or RISE with SAP engagements; proven executive stakeholder management; experience in the Middle East or GCC market; and strong commercial and negotiation capability.
  
  
**Preferred**
Experience in industries such as Oil and Gas, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, Government, or Public Sector; understanding of SAP BTP, Cloud, Analytics, Data Migration, and enterprise integration; and experience working with SAP and strategic technology partners.
  
  
Core Competencies
  
  
Commercial Leadership
  
  
Strategic selling, opportunity qualification, negotiation, deal shaping, account planning, and revenue ownership.
  
  
Client Leadership
  
  
Executive presence, consultative engagement, relationship building, cross-cultural communication, and trusted-advisor capability.
  
  
Transformation Acumen
  
  
Understanding of SAP-enabled business transformation, S/4HANA deployment approaches, program risks, value articulation, and large-deal solutioning.
  
  
Growth Mindset
  
  
Entrepreneurial drive, resilience, market-building ambition, collaboration, adaptability, and willingness to take ownership.
  
  
Success Measures
  
  
Business Outcomes
  
  
Revenue achievement, qualified pipeline growth, conversion, new-logo acquisition, account expansion, customer retention, partner-led opportunity creation, and contribution to the regional growth strategy.
  
  
Travel and Mobility Requirement
  
  
Essential requirement: The candidate must be keen to travel frequently across the Middle East and be available to work onsite at customer locations as and when required. The individual should be adaptable to diverse cultural and business environments and able to support time-sensitive pursuits and executive engagements in person.
  
  
Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
A commercially driven and well-networked SAP transformation professional who combines knowledge of large S/4HANA programs with a passion for customer engagement and business expansion. The individual should have strong executive presence, be energized by opening new markets and accounts, and aspire to progress into broader regional sales and business leadership responsibilities.
  
  
**Get empowered by NTT DATA Business Solutions!**
**We transform. SAP® solutions into Value**
**NTT DATA Business Solutions is a fast-growing international IT company and one of the world’s leading SAP partners. We are a full service provider delivering everything from business consulting to implementation of SAP solutions, including hosting services and support.**

jobs.title: Client Analytics Business Partner
jobs.description:
**Marcus Evans**
is a global leader in business intelligence and growth partner for leading businesses worldwide, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. Since 1983, we have brought decision-makers together through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms and performance programmes, working across all sectors and regions.

Our overriding approach is one of collaboration, and our belief that "We'll be our most successful when we work together." We recognise excellence and actively develop top performers into future leaders. Our culture promotes teamwork, continuous learning and global career growth.

**About Client Analytics**

Client Analytics is a new team in Hyderabad. It partners with the Managing Directors who lead our sales offices around the world, and helps them manage every client account to a consistent standard: before an event, on site and long after it. The team works on the data and discipline behind how we keep and grow clients, so our sales leaders can spend their time in front of them.

**Job Summary**

We're hiring Client Analytics Business Partner to work alongside the Managing Directors who run our sales offices in North America, APAC and Europe. You'll own the account management rhythm for those offices. That covers the rebook plan before every event, the results after it, the clients we're trying to win back, and the health of every active account. You'll turn client data into a clear view of where each account stands and what should happen next.

This is a partnering role, not a sales role and not an administrative one. You won't sell to clients. You will be the person an MD relies on to know whether the right work has been done on every account, to prompt it when it hasn't, and to report it clearly to our senior leadership.

This is an hybrid role in our Hyderabad office. Working hours overlap with the business day of the offices you support in North America and Europe.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan & Report: Build the pre-event rebook review four weeks out, covering what we plan to offer each client and how well we know them. Check that pricing has reached the sales team in time. Run a strategy update with the MD in the final one to two weeks. Four weeks after the event, report the outcome for every client.
* Win back lost clients: Own the lost opportunity list for your offices. Categorise each account, keep it current and review it with the MD every four weeks. Run the win-back programme, including the controlled use of complimentary video meetings. Track the results of reassigned accounts.
* Know the active portfolio: Keep a live view of each client showing what we know, what we plan to offer and when we next engage them. Use CRM data, AI tools and third-party sources to build the picture, and spot where the account can grow.
* Hold the standard: Monitor adherence to the account management workflow and alert the MD when a step is missed. Track KPIs and scoring, keep the dashboard current, and flag where retraining is needed. Work with Learning & Quality to train sales teams.
* Report to leadership: Present evidence-based reviews and clear recommendations to senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO.
* Work across the business: Partner with Operations, Finance, Marketing and Technology. Direct the Account Management Coordinators who support your offices. Suggest improvements to our reports and tools, including where AI can save time.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in business, commerce, economics, statistics or a related field
* Minimum 5 years in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial analytics, account management analytics or a similar role supporting sales leaders
* Experience working directly with senior stakeholders in the US, UK or Europe, and the confidence to challenge them constructively
* Advanced Excel, plus hands-on experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce
* Able to turn data into a short, clear recommendation that a busy senior leader can act on
* Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or above)
* Highly organised and comfortable managing several stakeholders, deadlines and reporting cycles at once
* Discretion with commercially sensitive information
* Willing to work hours that overlap with North American and European offices

**Preferred**

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification
* Experience in B2B services, events, media, consulting or financial services
* Experience with dashboard tools such as Power BI or Tableau
* Experience using AI tools for research and analysis
* Familiarity with sales intelligence platforms such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo or Apollo
* Experience supporting account management, client retention or key account programmes

**Compensation**

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive base salary and performance base bonus opportunity, discussed in the hiring manager conversation

**Benefits**

* Work directly with Managing Directors and senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO's office
* Join a new team at the start, and help shape how it works
* Fast-track, transparent promotional structure, with a path to Senior Business Partner and team leadership
* Opportunity to attend Marcus Evans events
* International travel opportunities
* A friendly, dynamic and vibrant work environment

**Marcus Evans**
is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need.

jobs.title: CGT Lead
jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Various outside weather conditions
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Drive the growth of Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Cell & Gene Therapy (CGT) business by enabling and leading integrated workflow selling across businesses.
  
  
The role will identify strategic CGT opportunities, understand customers’ scientific, process-development and manufacturing workflows, and bring together capabilities from across Thermo Fisher Scientific to create differentiated, end-to-end solutions.
  
  
A critical aspect of this role is the ability to
**influence without direct authority**
. The incumbent will work across multiple businesses, commercial teams, product specialists, application scientists, marketing, service and other functions to create alignment around customer opportunities and mobilize the right capabilities to win.
  
  
The role will act as a
**CGT workflow orchestrator**
, moving customer engagement beyond individual products toward integrated solutions spanning research, process development, clinical translation and commercial manufacturing.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**CGT Workflow Selling & Business Growth**

* Develop and execute the commercial strategy for growing Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Cell & Gene Therapy business across assigned markets and strategic customers.
* Identify and develop high-value opportunities where multiple Thermo Fisher businesses can participate in the customer workflow.
* Build a strong pipeline of integrated CGT workflow opportunities rather than relying primarily on individual product opportunities.
* Understand customer programs from early research and process development through clinical translation, scale-up and commercial manufacturing to identify opportunities across the workflow.
* Connect relevant capabilities across cell biology, cell culture, cell processing, gene editing, viral vector and plasmid workflows, bioprocessing, analytical technologies, instruments, consumables, reagents and services.
* Translate customer scientific and manufacturing challenges into integrated Thermo Fisher value propositions.
* Drive penetration and share of wallet within strategic CGT customers through broader workflow adoption.
* Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline development, opportunity progression, forecasting and execution.

**One Thermo Fisher – Cross-Business Leadership**

* Serve as the commercial integrator for CGT opportunities across Thermo Fisher Scientific businesses.
* Bring together Business Units, commercial teams, Technical Sales Specialists, Application Scientists, Product Management, Marketing, Service and other relevant stakeholders around priority CGT opportunities.
* Establish a clear opportunity strategy and define how different businesses can collectively address the customer’s workflow.
* Create alignment across businesses on customer priorities, value propositions, engagement strategy and execution.
* Ensure individual product discussions are connected wherever appropriate into a broader CGT workflow and customer strategy.
* Identify gaps or overlaps between businesses and facilitate decisions that enable a coordinated One Thermo Fisher approach.
* Act as the internal voice of the CGT customer, ensuring customer workflow requirements and emerging needs are understood across relevant businesses.

**Influence Without Authority**
Success in this role will depend heavily on the ability to
**lead through influence rather than organizational authority**
.
  
  
The incumbent will:
  
  

* Build credibility and trusted relationships with commercial and business leaders across Thermo Fisher Scientific.
* Influence Business Units and sales teams to collaborate on opportunities that span organizational boundaries.
* Create alignment among stakeholders who may have different priorities, objectives and reporting structures.
* Mobilize resources across businesses without necessarily having direct control over those resources.
* Establish shared objectives and mutual accountability around strategic CGT opportunities.
* Navigate a complex matrix organization and resolve competing priorities through collaboration, data, customer insight and business rationale.
* Build internal advocacy for CGT opportunities and secure commitment from relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate decisions and maintain momentum across complex opportunities involving multiple internal and customer stakeholders.
* Demonstrate strong executive presence, stakeholder management, negotiation and influencing skills.

**Strategic Customer Leadership**

* Develop strong relationships with biotechnology, biopharmaceutical, CDMO, academic, translational research and other organizations participating in the Cell & Gene Therapy ecosystem.
* Engage senior scientists, R&D leaders, process-development teams, manufacturing leaders, procurement teams and business executives.
* Develop a deep understanding of customers’ therapeutic pipelines, technology platforms, manufacturing strategies, capacity expansion plans and long-term priorities.
* Build multi-year strategic account and workflow plans for priority CGT customers.
* Identify opportunities for broader strategic partnerships extending beyond individual product transactions.
* Lead complex, high-value opportunities involving multiple Thermo Fisher businesses and multiple customer stakeholders.
* Conduct strategic business reviews and workflow discussions with key customers.

**Scientific & Workflow Leadership**

* Develop strong understanding of evolving Cell & Gene Therapy technologies, modalities, manufacturing platforms and customer workflow challenges.
* Maintain working knowledge across cell therapy, gene therapy, gene editing, viral vectors, plasmids, regenerative medicine and other relevant advanced-therapy areas.
* Engage customers in scientifically credible, workflow-oriented discussions.
* Enable commercial teams to move from product selling to consultative, workflow-based and outcome-oriented selling.
* Translate scientific and technology developments into actionable commercial opportunities.
* Partner with Business Units, application teams, R&D and Product Management to communicate unmet customer needs and emerging workflow requirements.
* Support scientific forums, workshops, seminars, roundtables and customer innovation discussions that strengthen Thermo Fisher Scientific’s position within the CGT ecosystem.

**Commercial Enablement & Opportunity Leadership**

* Work alongside divisional and regional commercial teams to identify, qualify and progress strategic CGT opportunities.
* Coach and enable sales teams on CGT workflows, customer discovery, consultative selling and cross-business opportunity development.
* Support teams in mapping customer workflows, stakeholders, decision-making processes and competitive positions.
* Develop compelling integrated value propositions for complex customer opportunities.
* Facilitate opportunity strategy sessions involving relevant businesses and specialists.
* Establish mechanisms to track major cross-business CGT opportunities and ensure clear actions, ownership and follow-through.
* Review pipeline quality, customer engagement and competitive activity and drive corrective actions where required.

**Market Development & Strategic Insights**

* Continuously assess the CGT market, including scientific developments, therapeutic pipelines, manufacturing investments, technology shifts, funding trends and evolving customer needs.
* Identify emerging workflow opportunities and areas where Thermo Fisher Scientific can create differentiated value through its combined portfolio.
* Translate market and customer intelligence into recommendations for commercial strategy, portfolio development, marketing and customer engagement.
* Provide structured feedback to business and regional leadership regarding customer requirements, competitive threats and emerging opportunities.

jobs.description:
Some careers open more doors than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To build and grow HSBC Premier Banking relationships with high-net-worth individual (HNI) customers, acting as a single point of contact and providing comprehensive banking support and financial advisory aligned to customer needs. The role focuses on delivering against business targets while meeting Global Premier Service Standards and ensuring strong conduct and regulatory outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibility**

* Grow profit and portfolio value across Premier client relationships through new and existing business
* Deliver agreed financial targets through effective relationship management and consistent service delivery
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services
* Identify wealth review opportunities and provide tailored wealth solutions aligned to customer goals
* Build long-term client relationships that improve retention satisfaction and wallet share
* Maintain accurate client information using client relationship management tools and disciplined record keeping
* Manage a prospect pipeline and apply structured plans to deepen and expand relationships
* Embed HSBC policies and controls including KYC AML and sanctions alongside sales quality requirements

**Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.**
**Eligibility & Educational Qualifications**

* Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline with 4-7 years of relevant experience
* Substantial experience as a Relationship Manager within the Retail or Premier Banking segment
* Proven outcomes in wealth products with a record of meeting portfolio and revenue goals
* Strong wealth management technical knowledge to provide suitable recommendations and advice
* Experience building trusted relationships with high-net-worth individual (HNI) clients as a consistent point of contact
* Capability using client relationship management systems to maintain accurate timely client data
* Experience partnering with Compliance Credit and Risk and Internal Control teams to deliver balanced risk outcomes
* Required local regulatory licences and accreditations for wealth management or equivalent demonstrable experience
* AMFI IRDA NISM XXI A (PMS Certification) and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) or equivalent certification or equivalent demonstrable experience where required by the market.

**Additional Information**
Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

* Support SIT, UAT, cutover planning, production deployment, and go-live activities.
* Ensure successful migration execution within project timelines and quality standards.

* Overall IT/Core Banking experience of 5–15 years.
* Mandatory FLEXCUBE project experience.
* Experience working with FLEXCUBE versions ranging from 11.8 to 14.x.
* Strong proficiency in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.
* Hands-on experience in data extraction, transformation, loading (ETL), and data conversion.
* Expertise in source-to-target data mapping and migration strategy.
* Experience with Oracle database objects, packages, procedures, functions, and migration scripts.
* Knowledge of SQL\*Loader and data loading utilities.

* Strong understanding of Core Banking modules such as:
* CASA (Current and Savings Accounts)
* Customer Information / CIF
* Branch Operations
* Teller Operations
* Loans and Lending
* Deposits and Term Deposits
* General Ledger (GL)
* Funds Transfer and Payments
* Understanding of migration testing, mock runs, cutover, and go-live activities.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience migrating legacy banking platforms to FLEXCUBE.
* Experience in FLEXCUBE version migration and upgrades.
* Exposure to multiple Core Banking migration projects.
* Knowledge of Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), Informatica, or other ETL tools.
* Experience with Unix/Linux and Shell Scripting.

We are looking for hands-on FLEXCUBE Migration Professionals who can independently manage migration deliverables, understand complex banking data structures, execute migration activities, and ensure accurate and seamless data transition.

**Job Summary**
---------------

This role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity and completeness of financial and operational records across accounts, products and transaction platforms. The role provides critical control over the end-to-end reconciliation lifecycle by identifying, investigating and resolving breaks, exceptions and discrepancies in a timely manner, thereby reducing financial, operational and regulatory risk.

The role supports the effective operation of reconciliation processes covering Nostro accounts, General Ledger and suspense accounts, trade and position records, card and retail banking transactions, and other operational control accounts. Working across multiple business functions, the role ensures that reconciliation outcomes are achieved within agreed service levels while maintaining adherence to reconciliation policies, control standards and governance requirements.

The role also contributes to process optimisation and change initiatives by supporting system enhancements, reconciliation platform implementations, business analysis activities and automation opportunities that strengthen operational efficiency, scalability and control effectiveness.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Reconciliation Control & Exception Management**  
• Perform reconciliations across cash, Nostro, General Ledger, suspense, trade, position and retail transaction accounts to ensure books and records are complete and accurate.
  
• Investigate, analyse and resolve reconciliation breaks, exceptions and unmatched items within agreed timelines to minimise operational and financial risk.
  
• Escalate aged, material or high-risk exceptions through appropriate governance channels to enable timely resolution and management oversight.
  
• Maintain accurate reconciliation evidence, audit trails and supporting documentation to support operational control and regulatory requirements.
  
**Financial Control & Risk Management**  
• Apply reconciliation policies, operational procedures and control frameworks to ensure compliance with internal and external requirements.
  
• Identify emerging risks, recurring exceptions and control weaknesses, recommending actions that improve reconciliation effectiveness and reduce operational losses.
  
• Monitor reconciliation ageing, exception volumes and service levels, ensuring timely reporting of key control indicators and risk exposures.
  
• Support business continuity, operational resilience and risk mitigation activities, including testing and execution of contingency plans.
  
**Stakeholder Engagement & Service Delivery**  
• Collaborate with Operations, Product, Finance, Technology and country teams to resolve reconciliation issues and improve control outcomes.
  
• Manage internal and external stakeholder enquiries relating to account balances, exceptions, investigations and reconciliation status.
  
• Coordinate resolution activities across multiple teams and functions to ensure dependencies are managed and service commitments are achieved.
  
• Build effective working relationships that support issue resolution, control transparency and operational effectiveness.

**Reconciliation Systems & Change Implementation**  
**• Support business analysis and requirement gathering for reconciliation platform enhancements and transformation initiatives.**  
**• Translate operational requirements into business rules, configuration requirements and process improvements for reconciliation solutions such as TLM.**  
**• Participate in testing activities, including UAT, validation and implementation readiness assessments, ensuring changes deliver expected business outcomes.**  
**• Support production deployments, operational readiness activities and post-implementation stabilisation to minimise disruption to reconciliation processes.**  
**Process Improvement & Operational Excellence**  
**• Identify opportunities to standardise, simplify and automate reconciliation activities to improve efficiency, scalability and control effectiveness.**  
**• Analyse exception trends and operational data to recommend sustainable process enhancements and preventative controls.**  
**• Maintain process documentation, operating procedures, escalation matrices and control records to ensure operational consistency.**  
**• Contribute to migration, change and transformation initiatives that strengthen reconciliation capabilities and service delivery performance.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Priority Skills**  
**• Account Reconciliation**  
**• Banking Operations Management**  
**• Project Management**  
**• Cash Management**  
**• Certification and Accreditation**  
**• Trade Management**

**Other Skills**  
**• Risk Management**  
**• Stakeholder Engagement**  
**• Strategy Development**  
**• Talent Development**  
**• Trade Reconciliation**

jobs.description:
Meet the Team
  
You will be joining a high performing team of technocrats and customer focussed professionals handling some of the most complex IT setups in the country. The CX Team is dedicated to accelerating our customers’ digital transformation journeys by bridging vision and execution. As the trusted delivery and lifecycle engine across India’s most critical sectors—including Banking, Financial Services& Insurance (BFSI), Public Sector& Defence, Telecom/Service Providers, and Commercial Enterprises—we ensure our customers realize the full business value of their technology investments with speed, agility, and principled resilience.
  
  
**Key Strategic Focus Areas of the CX Team:**  

* Critical Transformation: Architecting, securing, and operating next-generation, AI-ready Data Center, Zero Trust Security, Converged SASE, and Campus architectures.
* Proactive Lifecycle& Outcome Delivery: Transitioning from reactive support to continuous value realization through Lifecycle Services, Cisco IQ telemetry-driven validation, and contextual risk scoring.
* Domain& Regulatory Excellence: Deep alignment with India-specific regulatory frameworks (RBI Master Directions on Cyber Resilience, CERT-In SBOM/compliance mandates) and air-gapped sovereign cloud requirements.
* One Team Culture: Fostering a high-performing ecosystem of Consulting Engineers, Technical Solutions Architects, Project Managers, and High-Touch Operations Managers partnering closely with our Sales, Product Engineering, and Certified Partner Network.

Your Impact
  
The Customer Success Manager is responsible for driving the successful adoption and utilization of Cisco technologies to ensure customer value realization and growth, proactively leading and mitigating renewal risks in alignment with the renewals team by leveraging risk insights and adoption action plans to increase retention rates and supporting customer expansion through identifying opportunities for deeper product utilization and aligning technology to evolving business needs.
  
This role will focus on the Top Banking accounts and will be based in Mumbai.
  
  
This position develops and maintains strong technical influence with customer consultative sessions to address business challenges and objectives, acts as a technology evangelist by providing feedback from customers to Cisco's product teams to inform product development and enhancements.
  
  
The role also includes creating and implementing technical adoption plans (TAPs) that align with customer goals to improve technology investments, directing customer requests to appropriate teams for resolution of adoption barriers, and collaborating with sales, customer success, delivery, renewals, and business entities to identify use cases that drive value and business outcomes.
  
Additionally, the role requires staying current with the latest Cisco technologies, including AI, ML, automation, and cloud technologies, as well as maintaining awareness of the competitive landscape and industry trends to provide guide guidance to customers.

* Acts as a liaison across accounts, regions, or functional initiatives, ensuring a “one-team” customer experience

Key Success Metrics (KPIs)
  
  

* Net Retention Rate (NRR)& Gross Retention Rate (GRR) across the assigned BFSI portfolio.
* Adoption& Feature Utilization Velocity (Percentage of licensed software capabilities active in production).
* Time-to-Value (TTV / TTFV) for new software suites and EA onboarding.
* Customer Health Score& CSAT / Net Promoter Score (NPS).
* Success Plan Execution& Executive QBR Rhythm (100% compliance across Tier-1 accounts).

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* Exposure to BFSI customers, proven skills in DC operations and infrastructure play including security platforms is essential for the candidate. Demonstrated experience in navigating C-level relationships (CIO/CTO/CISO/EVP Infrastructure) in the Indian banking ecosystem.
* Strong foundational understanding of modern enterprise architectures (ability to speak confidently on Cloud Networking, SD-WAN, Zero Trust, DC Infrastructure, SASE, and AIOps).
* Familiarity with software subscription models, Enterprise Agreements (EA), SaaS adoption lifecycle, and consumption metrics.
* Relevant technical certifications: CCNA / CCNP (Enterprise/Security/Data Center) or Cloud certifications (AWS / Azure Solutions Architect Associate).

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* undefined
* 8–14+ years of total IT industry experience, with 4+ years in BFSI as a dedicated Customer Success Manager, Service Delivery Manager, or Technical Account Management role.
* Proven track record of managing large-scale BFSI customer portfolios with high recurring revenue (ARR/ACV >$5M+).
* Cisco Certified Customer Success Manager (CCSM / DTCSM)
* Executive Presence& Storytelling: Ability to translate complex technical telemetry and adoption data into executive-level business impact narratives.
* Orchestration& Influence: Ability to lead cross-functional matrix teams (Sales, CX Delivery, Product Engineering, Renewals, and Channel Partners) without direct authority.
* Crisis Management: High emotional intelligence, composure, and structured escalation management during critical banking incidents.

This role exists to lead the overall performance, governance and customer outcomes of the branch. The role is accountable for delivering sustainable business growth, maintaining a strong risk and control environment, and ensuring customers receive consistent, high-quality banking services.

Supporting the Bank’s strategy, the role drives customer acquisition, retention and relationship deepening by ensuring the branch delivers trusted financial guidance, exceptional service and access to wealth, liability and asset solutions that meet evolving customer needs. Through effective leadership of people, operations and change initiatives, the role strengthens branch competitiveness, customer loyalty and long-term franchise growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Business Growth, Profitability & Market Development**  
• Achieve branch revenue and business targets by executing branch plans that drive customer acquisition, customer retention, relationship deepening and sustainable portfolio growth.
  
• Strengthen branch profitability by improving the deposit mix across current and savings accounts, increasing non-funded income, managing fee waivers effectively and maintaining expenditure within approved budgets.
  
• Increase customer value and product penetration by leading the branch’s growth across current accounts, savings accounts, term deposits, wealth management solutions, and secured and unsecured asset products.
  
• Improve customer retention and lifetime value by monitoring customer behaviours, identifying attrition risks and directing timely engagement that strengthens long-term banking relationships.
  
• Grow branch market share and competitiveness by championing product launches, sales initiatives, customer acquisition campaigns and local promotional activities relevant to the branch catchment area.
  
• Improve productivity and commercial outcomes by monitoring revenue, portfolio, customer, cost and sales performance indicators and taking timely corrective action.

**Customer Experience & Relationship Leadership**  
• Build customer trust, satisfaction and loyalty by establishing clear service expectations and embedding customer-focused behaviours across the branch.

jobs.title: Snr Solution Architect, UAE Enterprise
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work directly with customers in Financial Services organizations navigating complex digital transformations where the technology strategy is not yet defined and the right path forward requires both technical depth and business judgment.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will go into customer environments, understand their hardest problems, and design solutions that work — from whiteboard architecture through proof of concept to production. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and increasingly, generative AI and machine learning. You will earn trust by shipping things that matter, not by presenting slides.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, develop each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:
  
  

* Partnering with enterprise FSI customers to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes — in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

  

* Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

  

* Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning — identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

  

* Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

  

* Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

  
  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same. You might spend the morning whiteboarding a solution for a bank's leadership team, then move into a hands-on working session with an insurer's engineering team to design a resilient, low-latency payments or core banking architecture. In the afternoon you might review a colleague's proposal for a regulatory reporting data platform, write a blog post about a security and compliance pattern you found in the field, or join a call with an AWS service team to push for a feature your customer needs. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer urgency with long-term technical direction.  
  
About the team  
AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 8+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 8+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The role is responsible for the full lifecycle of the project, using hybrid methodologies, and must ensure delivery is aligned with strategic business goals of the organisation. The role works closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact transformation projects The role combines strong technical understanding with exceptional project management skills and business acumen and requires deep domain and technical awareness to successfully navigate the system's complexity.. The Regulatory banking PM role is centered on managing the implementation, transformation, or upgrade of the bank's central IT systems, which are critical to all operations.

As the Regulatory Project Manager, your responsibilities will include;

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Transformation Analyst (Business Architecture)

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Enterprise Transformation Analyst (Business Architecture)** to join the leading banking organisation in Oman.

The successful candidate will be responsible for analysing and defining business models, organisational structures, business capabilities, value streams, and end-to-end processes. The role involves translating strategic priorities into actionable transformation initiatives, developing business cases, identifying operational improvement opportunities, and ensuring measurable business benefits are achieved.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in business architecture, enterprise transformation, business analysis, and process optimisation, preferably within the banking or financial services industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Break down strategic business priorities into execution themes, initiatives, deliverables, and measurable outcomes.
* Conduct current-state, transition-state, and target-state analysis across business processes, capabilities, and organisational structures.
* Develop and maintain business capability maps and value-stream maps.
* Analyse business models and organisational structures, including roles, reporting lines, spans, and layers.
* Perform end-to-end process mapping, diagnostics, optimisation, and redesign.
* Apply BPMN, Lean methodologies, and process mining techniques to identify process improvement opportunities.
* Develop business cases, financial baselines, benefit calculations, and value contracts in collaboration with Finance and business stakeholders.
* Track and report benefits realisation, analyse variances, and recommend corrective actions.
* Identify opportunities for business growth, operational efficiency, automation, and capital release.
* Translate business architecture and target-state designs into clear business requirements for programme and delivery teams.
* Work closely with business owners, product owners, Finance, Technology, Enterprise Architecture, Risk, Compliance, HR, and Operations.
* Contribute to business architecture standards, documentation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 6–8 years of relevant experience in Business Analysis, Business Architecture, Enterprise Transformation, Strategy, Process Improvement, or Management Consulting.
* Strong experience in business capability mapping and value-stream mapping.
* Hands-on experience in BPMN and end-to-end process modelling.
* Proven experience in current-state and target-state analysis.
* Experience in business case development, financial analysis, and benefits realisation.
* Knowledge of organisational design and operating model transformation.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Banking or financial services experience is highly preferred.
* Familiarity with conventional and Islamic banking products and operations is an advantage.

**Preferred Professional Certifications**

* Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP)
* PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA)
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt
* Certified Business Architect (CBA)
* TOGAF Business Architecture

**Core Competencies**

* Business Architecture & Operating Model Design
* Enterprise Transformation & Strategic Analysis
* Current-to-Target-State Assessment
* Business Process Modelling & Optimisation

**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
We are seeking an exceptional Director of Delivery Management of Professional Services to lead our Global Delivery Centre. This is a senior leadership role for someone who is an equal parts delivery leader & growth driver — someone who does not just run a services organisation but actively multiplies its impact. You will combine deep Salesforce delivery expertise with a growth mindset, executive presence, and the relentless persistence to grow the team’s reputation as a centre of excellence.
  
  
You will be a key member of the Leadership Team of the Strategic New & Emerging Technology practice, accountable for both the quality of delivery and the strategic building & expansion of our practice. The ideal candidate brings 18+ years of consulting or professional services experience, a passion for innovation, and a proven track record of scaling teams, winning business, and driving measurable customer outcomes.
  
  
As a Director of Professional Services, you should have expertise in building strong competency in building and scaling Salesforce’s New & Emerging Technology cloud capabilities and delivering high value to customers. Should have pre-sales management experience with a deep knowledge of enterprise sales cycles. Should have Salesforce project implementation experience with the different engagement models.
  
  
**What You’ll Actually Be Doing**

* Act as a growth multiplier — raise the ceiling of what the team believes is possible, create conditions where talented people do their best work, and leave every person better than you found them.
* Build, manage, and continuously grow a world-class professional services team with the right talent and organizational structure.
* Bring a genuine sales mindset to a delivery leadership role — actively hunt for new opportunities & open doors with persistence and creativity.

* Present compelling solutions and proposals to internal and external stakeholders, including executive leadership and prospective clients.

* Hire exceptional talent and manage performance to ensure meaningful career growth opportunities.
* Embody company values and set the standard for exemplary, inclusive leadership.

* Champion an organizational AI-first delivery methodology, driving the integration of advanced AI tools, project accelerators, and agentic evaluation frameworks to optimize execution velocity and elevate consulting quality across all practice programs
* Drive a culture of continuous innovation, challenging the team to evolve delivery approaches and maximise the value of Salesforce products for clients.
* Lead through thought leadership, industry visibility, partner engagement, and a reputation for delivery excellence that makes clients want to work with us and talent want to join us.
* Champion GDC capabilities internally and externally; position the centre as a strategic asset and a differentiator in contested sales situations.
* Build and foster stronger collaboration with Regional Salesforce Professional Services teams and broader ecosystem partners.
* Drive the Product & Engineering feedback loop for Customers as OneSalesforce program by fostering stronger relationships and collaboration with Product & Engineering teams.

* Listen actively and adapt communication style to the audience; project calm and confidence in high-pressure situations and during periods of crisis or uncertainty.
* Build strong, trusted partnerships across a matrixed organisation, influencing without authority and earning credibility through expertise and integrity.
* Collaborate effectively across internal and external teams to garner alignment and achieve outsized impact.

**You’re Our Person If...**

* 18+ years of experience in a consulting firm or professional services division of a software company, delivering software-based business solutions across Sales, Marketing, Service, and Support.
